 91 |         inplanes,
 92 |         planes,
 93 |         stride=1,
 94 |         downsample=None,
 95 |         groups=1,
 96 |         base_width=64,
 97 |         dilation=1,
 98 |         norm_layer=None,
 99 |     ):
100 |         super(Bottleneck, self).__init__()
101 |         if norm_layer is None:
102 |             norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
103 |         width = int(planes * (base_width / 64.0)) * groups
104 |         self.conv1 = conv1x1(inplanes, width)
105 |         self.bn1 = norm_layer(width)
106 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(width, width, stride, groups, dilation)
107 |         self.bn2 = norm_layer(width)
108 |         self.conv3 = conv1x1(width, planes * self.expansion)
109 |         self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
110 |         self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
111 |         self.downsample = downsample
112 |         self.stride = stride
113 | 
114 |     def forward(self, x):
115 |         identity = x
116 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
117 |         out = self.relu(self.bn2(self.conv2(out)))
118 |         out = self.bn3(self.conv3(out))
119 |         if self.downsample is not None:
120 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
121 |         out += identity
122 |         return self.relu(out)
123 | 
124 | 
125 | class DynamicLaneRefinementHead(nn.Module):
126 |     """
127 |     Query-conditioned dynamic refinement over high-resolution features.
128 | 
129 |     Input:
130 |       - queries: (B, N, D) decoder embeddings
131 |       - feat_map: (B, C, H, W) early spatial features (layer2)
132 |       - base_curves: (B, N, K) baseline polynomial lane params from LSTR head
133 | 
134 |     Output:
135 |       - refined_curves: (B, N, K) as residual refinement of base_curves
136 | 
137 |     Key idea:
138 |       1) Generate lane-specific dynamic kernels from queries.
139 |       2) Produce lane activation map over spatial tokens (no early spatial collapse).
140 |       3) Softmax pool projected feature tokens into per-lane descriptor.
141 |       4) Predict residual delta for polynomial parameters.
142 |     """
143 | 
144 |     def __init__(self, query_dim=32, feat_channels=32, hidden_dim=64, curve_dim=8):
145 |         super().__init__()
146 |         self.query_dim = query_dim
147 |         self.feat_channels = feat_channels
148 |         self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
149 |         self.curve_dim = curve_dim
150 | 
151 |         # Query -> dynamic kernel (same channel dimensionality as feat map)
152 |         self.kernel_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, feat_channels)
153 | 
154 |         # Feature projection before weighted pooling
155 |         self.feat_proj = nn.Conv2d(feat_channels, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1)
156 | 
157 |         # Query context branch
158 |         self.query_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, hidden_dim)
159 | 
160 |         # Residual predictor for curve params
161 |         self.delta_head = nn.Sequential(
162 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim),
163 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
164 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim, curve_dim),
165 |         )
166 | 
167 |         # Keep refinement conservative initially
168 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].weight)
169 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].bias)
170 | 
171 |     def forward(self, queries, feat_map, base_curves):
172 |         # queries: (B, N, D), feat_map: (B, C, H, W), base_curves: (B, N, K)
173 |         B, N, D = queries.shape
174 |         Bf, C, H, W = feat_map.shape
175 |         if B != Bf:
176 |             raise ValueError(f"Batch mismatch in dynamic head: queries B={B}, feat B={Bf}")
177 | 
178 |         # (B, C, HW)
179 |         feat_flat = feat_map.view(B, C, H * W)
180 | 
181 |         # (B, N, C)
182 |         kernels = self.kernel_proj(queries)
183 | 
184 |         # Lane activation logits over spatial tokens: (B, N, HW)
185 |         # bmm: (B,N,C) @ (B,C,HW)
186 |         attn_logits = torch.bmm(kernels, feat_flat)
187 |         attn = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)
188 | 
189 |         # Project features: (B, hidden, H, W) -> (B, HW, hidden)
190 |         feat_embed = self.feat_proj(feat_map).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
191 | 
192 |         # Weighted lane descriptor from full spatial support: (B, N, hidden)
193 |         lane_desc = torch.bmm(attn, feat_embed)
194 | 
195 |         # Query branch: (B, N, hidden)
196 |         q_desc = self.query_proj(queries)
197 | 
198 |         # Fuse and predict residual delta: (B, N, K)
199 |         fused = torch.cat([lane_desc, q_desc], dim=-1)
200 |         delta = self.delta_head(fused)
201 | 
202 |         # Residual refinement
203 |         refined = base_curves + delta
204 |         return refined
205 | 
206 | 
207 | class model(kp):
208 |     def __init__(self, flag=False):
209 |         layers = system_configs.res_layers
210 |         res_dims = system_configs.res_dims
211 |         res_strides = system_configs.res_strides
212 |         attn_dim = system_configs.attn_dim
213 |         dim_feedforward = system_configs.dim_feedforward
214 |         num_queries = system_configs.num_queries
215 |         drop_out = system_configs.drop_out
216 |         num_heads = system_configs.num_heads
217 |         enc_layers = system_configs.enc_layers
218 |         dec_layers = system_configs.dec_layers
219 |         lsp_dim = system_configs.lsp_dim
220 |         mlp_layers = system_configs.mlp_layers
221 |         lane_cls = system_configs.lane_categories
222 |         aux_loss = system_configs.aux_loss
223 |         pos_type = system_configs.pos_type
224 |         pre_norm = system_configs.pre_norm
225 |         return_intermediate = system_configs.return_intermediate
226 | 
227 |         if system_configs.block == "BasicBlock":
228 |             block = BasicBlock
229 |         elif system_configs.block == "BottleNeck":
230 |             block = Bottleneck
231 |         else:
232 |             raise ValueError(f"invalid system_configs.block: {system_configs.block}")
233 | 
234 |         super(model, self).__init__(
235 |             flag=flag,
236 |             block=block,
237 |             layers=layers,
238 |             res_dims=res_dims,
239 |             res_strides=res_strides,
240 |             attn_dim=attn_dim,
241 |             num_queries=num_queries,
242 |             aux_loss=aux_loss,
243 |             pos_type=pos_type,
244 |             drop_out=drop_out,
245 |             num_heads=num_heads,
246 |             dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
247 |             enc_layers=enc_layers,
248 |             dec_layers=dec_layers,
249 |             pre_norm=pre_norm,
250 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
251 |             num_cls=lane_cls,
252 |             lsp_dim=lsp_dim,
253 |             mlp_layers=mlp_layers,
254 |         )
255 | 
256 |         # Swap encoder to Mamba as in mamba branch
257 |         self.transformer.encoder = BidirectionalMambaEncoder()
258 | 
259 |         # Dynamic refinement head over high-res layer2 features
260 |         # curve_dim = lsp_dim (e.g., 8 = [lower, upper, 6 poly params])
261 |         self.dynamic_refine = DynamicLaneRefinementHead(
262 |             query_dim=attn_dim,
263 |             feat_channels=res_dims[1],  # layer2 channels
264 |             hidden_dim=max(attn_dim * 2, 64),
265 |             curve_dim=lsp_dim,
266 |         )
267 | 
268 |         print("[LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic] encoder -> BidirectionalMambaEncoder")
269 |         print("[LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic] DynamicLaneRefinementHead enabled")
270 | 
271 |     def _train(self, *xs, **kwargs):
272 |         images = xs[0]
273 |         masks = xs[1]
274 | 
275 |         # Backbone with layer2 tap for dynamic refinement
276 |         p = self.conv1(images)
277 |         p = self.bn1(p)
278 |         p = self.relu(p)
279 |         p = self.maxpool(p)
280 |         p = self.layer1(p)
281 |         p2 = self.layer2(p)   # high-res map for dynamic head
282 |         p = self.layer3(p2)
283 |         p = self.layer4(p)
284 | 
285 |         pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
286 |         pos = self.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
287 | 
288 |         hs, _, weights = self.transformer(self.input_proj(p), pmasks, self.query_embed.weight, pos)
289 |         # hs: (L, B, N, D)
290 | 
291 |         # Base LSTR heads
292 |         output_class = self.class_embed(hs)          # (L, B, N, C+1)
293 |         output_specific = self.specific_embed(hs)    # (L, B, N, lsp_dim-4)
294 |         output_shared = self.shared_embed(hs)        # (L, B, N, 4)
295 |         output_shared = torch.mean(output_shared, dim=-2, keepdim=True)  # (L,B,1,4)
296 |         output_shared = output_shared.repeat(1, 1, output_specific.shape[2], 1)
297 |         output_specific = torch.cat(
298 |             [output_specific[:, :, :, :2], output_shared, output_specific[:, :, :, 2:]],
299 |             dim=-1,
300 |         )
301 | 
302 |         # Dynamic residual refinement (preserve output contract: pred_curves)
303 |         refined_specific = []
304 |         for lid in range(output_specific.shape[0]):
305 |             q = hs[lid]  # (B, N, D)
306 |             base = output_specific[lid]  # (B, N, lsp_dim)
307 |             refined = self.dynamic_refine(q, p2, base)
308 |             refined_specific.append(refined)
309 |         output_specific = torch.stack(refined_specific, dim=0)
310 | 
311 |         out = {
312 |             "pred_logits": output_class[-1],
313 |             "pred_curves": output_specific[-1],
314 |         }
315 |         if self.aux_loss:
316 |             out["aux_outputs"] = self._set_aux_loss(output_class, output_specific)
317 |         return out, weights
318 | 
319 |     def _test(self, *xs, **kwargs):
320 |         return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)
321 | 
322 |     def forward(self, *xs, **kwargs):
323 |         if self.flag:
324 |             return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)
325 |         return self._test(*xs, **kwargs)
326 |

 25 | def poly_to_xcoords(coeffs_list, num_points=72):
 26 |     """
 27 |     Polynomial coefficients → 72-point x_coords conversion.
 28 |     
 29 |     Args:
 30 |         coeffs_list: List of coefficients, each is [c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5]
 31 |         num_points: Number of y samples (default 72)
 32 |     
 33 |     Returns:
 34 |         x_coords: (num_points,) tensor
 35 |     """
 36 |     y_samples = torch.linspace(0, 1, num_points)
 37 |     coeffs = torch.tensor(coeffs_list, dtype=torch.float32)
 38 |     
 39 |     x_vals = (coeffs[0] + coeffs[1]*y_samples + coeffs[2]*(y_samples**2) +
 40 |               coeffs[3]*(y_samples**3) + coeffs[4]*(y_samples**4) +
 41 |               coeffs[5]*(y_samples**5))
 42 |     
 43 |     return torch.clamp(x_vals, 0, 1)

+"""
+Smoke checks for LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic (contract-safe version).
+
+This test intentionally validates compatibility with the existing LSTR training/eval
+contracts, not a custom pred_xcoords API.
+"""
+
+import json
+import torch
+
+from config import system_configs
+
+
+def _load_cfg(cfg_name="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic"):
+    with open(f"config/{cfg_name}.json", "r") as f:
+        cfg = json.load(f)
+    cfg["system"]["snapshot_name"] = cfg_name
+    system_configs.update_config(cfg["system"])
+    return cfg
+
+
+def test_model_and_loss_contract():
+    _load_cfg()
+
+    from models.LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic import model, loss
+
+    net = model(flag=True)
+    criterion = loss()
+
+    # --- forward contract
+    B, H, W = 2, 295, 820
+    images = torch.randn(B, 3, H, W)
+    masks = torch.zeros(B, 1, H, W)
+
+    outputs, _ = net(images, masks)
+
+    assert "pred_logits" in outputs, "missing pred_logits"
+    assert "pred_curves" in outputs, "missing pred_curves"
+    assert outputs["pred_logits"].shape[0] == B
+    assert outputs["pred_curves"].shape[0] == B
+    assert outputs["pred_curves"].shape[-1] == system_configs.lsp_dim
+
+    if system_configs.aux_loss:
+        assert "aux_outputs" in outputs, "missing aux_outputs"
+        assert len(outputs["aux_outputs"]) == (system_configs.dec_layers - 1)
+
+    # --- loss contract
+    # Build targets in current pipeline format: list[tensor], each tensor (L, 1+2+2*max_points)
+    # Minimal synthetic valid labels for matcher/criterion.
+    max_points = 18
+    lanes_per_img = 4
+    tgt_dim = 1 + 2 + 2 * max_points
+
+    gt_list = []
+    for _ in range(B):
+        t = torch.ones((lanes_per_img, tgt_dim), dtype=torch.float32) * -1e5
+        t[:, 0] = 1.0  # class id lane
+        t[:, 1] = 0.1  # lower
+        t[:, 2] = 0.9  # upper
+
+        xs = torch.linspace(0.2, 0.8, max_points)
+        ys = torch.linspace(0.1, 0.9, max_points)
+        t[:, 3:3 + max_points] = xs
+        t[:, 3 + max_points:3 + 2 * max_points] = ys
+        gt_list.append(t)
+
+    # AELoss forward signature:
+    # loss(iteration, save, viz_split, outputs, targets)
+    # where targets = [images, *gt_list]
+    losses = criterion(0, False, "train", outputs, [images, *gt_list])
+    total_loss = losses[0]
+    assert torch.isfinite(total_loss), "loss is NaN/Inf"
+
+    print("PASS | dynamic model contract and loss smoke test")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_model_and_loss_contract()
+

 61 |                    out_channels=1):

 75 |             bias_nums.append(channels)

 77 |             weight_nums.append(channels * channels)
 78 |             bias_nums.append(channels)

 82 | def compute_locations(h, w, stride, device):

 85 |     shifts_y = torch.arange(
 86 |         0, h * stride, step=stride, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

 94 | def select_mask_points(ct, r, shape, device, max_sample=5):
 95 |     h, w = shape[:2]
 96 |     r = max((r.item() // 2), 1)
 97 |     start_x, end_x = max(ct[0].item() - r, 0), min(ct[0].item() + r, w - 1)
 98 |     start_y, end_y = max(ct[1].item() - r, 0), min(ct[1].item() + r, h - 1)
 99 | 
100 |     range_x = torch.arange(start_x, end_x + 1, device=device)
101 |     range_y = torch.arange(start_y, end_y + 1, device=device)
102 |     point_y, point_x = torch.meshgrid(range_y, range_x, indexing='ij')
103 |     point_m = torch.stack([point_x, point_y], dim=-1)                         # (M, 2)
104 |     point_m = point_m.reshape(-1, 2)                                          # (M, 2)
105 |     point_c = ct.reshape(1, 2)                                                # (1, 2)
106 |     dis_a_c = torch.cdist(point_m.float(), point_c.float(), p=2.0)[:, 0]      # (M,)
107 |     dis_kep = (dis_a_c > 0) & (dis_a_c <= r + 0.1)                            # (M,)
108 |     point_m = point_m[dis_kep]                                                # (K, 2)
109 |     if len(point_m) > max_sample - 1:
110 |         idx_kep = np.random.choice(len(point_m), max_sample - 1, replace=False)
111 |         point_m = point_m[idx_kep]
112 |     point_m = torch.cat([point_m, point_c], dim=0)                            # (K, 2)
113 |     return point_m

183 |         e = max(start, end)
184 |         if s <= val <= e and s != e:

189 |     def choose_min_reg(val, ref):
190 |         min_val = 1e5
191 |         index = -1
192 |         if len(val) == 0:
193 |             return None
194 |         else:
195 |             for i, v in enumerate(val):
196 |                 if abs(v - ref) < min_val:
197 |                     min_val = abs(v - ref)
198 |                     index = i
199 |         return val[index]

233 | def clamp_line(line, box, min_length=0):
234 |     left, top, right, bottom = box
235 |     loss_box = Polygon([[left, top], [right, top], [right, bottom],
236 |                         [left, bottom]])
237 |     line_coords = np.array(line).reshape((-1, 2))
238 |     if line_coords.shape[0] < 2:
239 |         return None
240 |     try:
241 |         line_string = LineString(line_coords)
242 |         I = line_string.intersection(loss_box)
243 |         if I.is_empty:
244 |             return None
245 |         if I.length < min_length:
246 |             return None
247 |         if isinstance(I, LineString):
248 | 
249 |             pts = list(I.coords)
250 |             return pts
251 |         elif isinstance(I, MultiLineString):
252 |             pts = []
253 |             Istrings = list(I)
254 |             for Istring in Istrings:
255 |                 pts += list(Istring.coords)
256 |             return pts
257 |     except:
258 |         return None

125 | class DynamicLaneRefinementHead(nn.Module):
126 |     """
127 |     Query-conditioned dynamic refinement over high-resolution features.
128 | 
129 |     Input:
130 |       - queries: (B, N, D) decoder embeddings
131 |       - feat_map: (B, C, H, W) early spatial features (layer2)
132 |       - base_curves: (B, N, K) baseline polynomial lane params from LSTR head
133 | 
134 |     Output:
135 |       - refined_curves: (B, N, K) as residual refinement of base_curves
136 | 
137 |     Key idea:
138 |       1) Generate lane-specific dynamic kernels from queries.
139 |       2) Produce lane activation map over spatial tokens (no early spatial collapse).
140 |       3) Softmax pool projected feature tokens into per-lane descriptor.
141 |       4) Predict residual delta for polynomial parameters.
142 |     """
143 | 
144 |     def __init__(self, query_dim=32, feat_channels=32, hidden_dim=64, curve_dim=8):
145 |         super().__init__()
146 |         self.query_dim = query_dim
147 |         self.feat_channels = feat_channels
148 |         self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
149 |         self.curve_dim = curve_dim
150 | 
151 |         # Query -> dynamic kernel (same channel dimensionality as feat map)
152 |         self.kernel_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, feat_channels)
153 | 
154 |         # Feature projection before weighted pooling
155 |         self.feat_proj = nn.Conv2d(feat_channels, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1)
156 | 
157 |         # Query context branch
158 |         self.query_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, hidden_dim)
159 | 
160 |         # Residual predictor for curve params
161 |         self.delta_head = nn.Sequential(
162 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim),
163 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
164 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim, curve_dim),
165 |         )
166 | 
167 |         # Keep refinement conservative initially
168 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].weight)
169 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].bias)
170 | 
171 |     def forward(self, queries, feat_map, base_curves):
172 |         # queries: (B, N, D), feat_map: (B, C, H, W), base_curves: (B, N, K)
173 |         B, N, D = queries.shape
174 |         Bf, C, H, W = feat_map.shape
175 |         if B != Bf:
176 |             raise ValueError(f"Batch mismatch in dynamic head: queries B={B}, feat B={Bf}")
177 | 
178 |         # (B, C, HW)
179 |         feat_flat = feat_map.view(B, C, H * W)
180 | 
181 |         # (B, N, C)
182 |         kernels = self.kernel_proj(queries)
183 | 
184 |         # Lane activation logits over spatial tokens: (B, N, HW)
185 |         # bmm: (B,N,C) @ (B,C,HW)
186 |         attn_logits = torch.bmm(kernels, feat_flat)
187 |         attn = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)
188 | 
189 |         # Project features: (B, hidden, H, W) -> (B, HW, hidden)
190 |         feat_embed = self.feat_proj(feat_map).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
191 | 
192 |         # Weighted lane descriptor from full spatial support: (B, N, hidden)
193 |         lane_desc = torch.bmm(attn, feat_embed)
194 | 
195 |         # Query branch: (B, N, hidden)
196 |         q_desc = self.query_proj(queries)
197 | 
198 |         # Fuse and predict residual delta: (B, N, K)
199 |         fused = torch.cat([lane_desc, q_desc], dim=-1)
200 |         delta = self.delta_head(fused)
201 | 
202 |         # Residual refinement
203 |         refined = base_curves + delta
204 |         return refined
205 |

271 |     def _train(self, *xs, **kwargs):
272 |         images = xs[0]
273 |         masks = xs[1]
274 | 
275 |         # Backbone with layer2 tap for dynamic refinement
276 |         p = self.conv1(images)
277 |         p = self.bn1(p)
278 |         p = self.relu(p)
279 |         p = self.maxpool(p)
280 |         p = self.layer1(p)
281 |         p2 = self.layer2(p)   # high-res map for dynamic head
282 |         p = self.layer3(p2)
283 |         p = self.layer4(p)
284 | 
285 |         pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
286 |         pos = self.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
287 | 
288 |         hs, _, weights = self.transformer(self.input_proj(p), pmasks, self.query_embed.weight, pos)
289 |         # hs: (L, B, N, D)
290 | 
291 |         # Base LSTR heads
292 |         output_class = self.class_embed(hs)          # (L, B, N, C+1)
293 |         output_specific = self.specific_embed(hs)    # (L, B, N, lsp_dim-4)
294 |         output_shared = self.shared_embed(hs)        # (L, B, N, 4)
295 |         output_shared = torch.mean(output_shared, dim=-2, keepdim=True)  # (L,B,1,4)
296 |         output_shared = output_shared.repeat(1, 1, output_specific.shape[2], 1)
297 |         output_specific = torch.cat(
298 |             [output_specific[:, :, :, :2], output_shared, output_specific[:, :, :, 2:]],
299 |             dim=-1,
300 |         )
301 | 
302 |         # Dynamic residual refinement (preserve output contract: pred_curves)
303 |         refined_specific = []
304 |         for lid in range(output_specific.shape[0]):
305 |             q = hs[lid]  # (B, N, D)
306 |             base = output_specific[lid]  # (B, N, lsp_dim)
307 |             refined = self.dynamic_refine(q, p2, base)
308 |             refined_specific.append(refined)
309 |         output_specific = torch.stack(refined_specific, dim=0)
310 | 
311 |         out = {
312 |             "pred_logits": output_class[-1],
313 |             "pred_curves": output_specific[-1],
314 |         }
315 |         if self.aux_loss:
316 |             out["aux_outputs"] = self._set_aux_loss(output_class, output_specific)
317 |         return out, weights
318 | 
319 |     def _test(self, *xs, **kwargs):
320 |         return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)
321 | 
322 |     def forward(self, *xs, **kwargs):
323 |         if self.flag:
324 |             return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)
325 |         return self._test(*xs, **kwargs)

**Preparing detailed class comparison**
[Tool Use: attempt_completion]
Result: İlk olarak, `CondLSTR` içindeki dynamic kodların aktif olduğu classlar:

1. Ana dynamic class: [`DynamicMaskHead`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:14)
2. Dynamic’i kullanan ana detector: [`CondLSTR2D`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:156)
3. Dynamic param üreten head: [`CtnetHead`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:112)
4. Dynamic yardımcı fonksiyonlar: [`cal_num_params()`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/utils.py:57), [`compute_locations()`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/utils.py:82)

Ek not (lane detector dışında, backbone utility): [`Conv2dDynamicSamePadding`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/backbones/efficientnet/utils.py:215), [`MaxPool2dDynamicSamePadding`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/backbones/efficientnet/utils.py:295).

---

Şu anki modelimizle karşılaştırma:

| Başlık | CondLSTR | Bizim model |
|---|---|---|
| Dynamic class | [`DynamicMaskHead`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:14) | [`DynamicLaneRefinementHead`](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:125) |
| Nerede uygulanıyor | [`CondLSTR2D._forward()`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:238) içinde `reg/mask` üretimi | [`model._train()`](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:271) içinde `pred_curves` residual refinement |
| Dynamic mekanizma | Query’den gelen paramlarla dense map üzerinde dynamic transform ([`mask_heads_forward()`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:75)) | Query-conditioned attention/pooling + residual curve delta ([`DynamicLaneRefinementHead.forward()`](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:171)) |
| Çıktı tipi | Dense/reg tabanlı ara çıktılar: [`regs/masks/lane_ranges`](../CondLSTR/modeling/models/detectors/lane/cond_lstr_2d/cond_lstr_2d.py:250) | LSTR uyumlu direkt [`pred_curves`](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:313) |
| Pipeline uyumu | Kendi CondLSTR pipeline’ına bağlı | Mevcut LSTR pipeline’ıyla birebir uyumlu: [`AELoss`](models/py_utils/kp.py:223), [`HungarianMatcher`](models/py_utils/matcher.py:10), [`SetCriterion`](models/py_utils/detr_loss.py:10) |

Kısa dürüst özet:
- `CondLSTR` dynamic tarafı daha “dense” ve daha ağır (mask/reg uzayında çalışıyor).
- Bizim versiyon daha hafif ama mevcut LSTR eğitim/değerlendirme sözleşmesini bozmadan dynamic katkı veriyor.
- Yani mimari felsefe farklı: CondLSTR “dense dynamic prediction”, biz “query-conditioned curve refinement”.

3. **Files and Code Sections**

   ### A) `models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py`
   **Importance:** Core dynamic model implementation.  
   **History:** First version was broken (custom API, incompatible outputs/loss). Later deleted and replaced with contract-safe design.

   **Final architecture highlights:**
   - Adds `DynamicLaneRefinementHead`:
     ```python
     class DynamicLaneRefinementHead(nn.Module):
         def forward(self, queries, feat_map, base_curves):
             feat_flat = feat_map.view(B, C, H * W)
             kernels = self.kernel_proj(queries)            # (B,N,C)
             attn_logits = torch.bmm(kernels, feat_flat)    # (B,N,HW)
             attn = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)

             feat_embed = self.feat_proj(feat_map).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)  # (B,HW,Hid)
             lane_desc = torch.bmm(attn, feat_embed)        # (B,N,Hid)
             q_desc = self.query_proj(queries)              # (B,N,Hid)

             delta = self.delta_head(torch.cat([lane_desc, q_desc], dim=-1))
             return base_curves + delta
     ```
   - Keeps existing LSTR output contract:
     ```python
     out = {
         "pred_logits": output_class[-1],
         "pred_curves": output_specific[-1],
     }
     if self.aux_loss:
         out["aux_outputs"] = self._set_aux_loss(output_class, output_specific)
     ```
   - Loss class remains `AELoss`-compatible and only tweaks `loss_curves` weight to 2.5.

   ### B) `config/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.json`

124 | 
125 | class DynamicLaneRefinementHead(nn.Module):
126 |     """
127 |     Query-conditioned dynamic refinement over high-resolution features.
128 | 
129 |     Input:
130 |       - queries: (B, N, D) decoder embeddings
131 |       - feat_map: (B, C, H, W) early spatial features (layer2)
132 |       - base_curves: (B, N, K) baseline polynomial lane params from LSTR head
133 | 
134 |     Output:
135 |       - refined_curves: (B, N, K) as residual refinement of base_curves
136 | 
137 |     Key idea:
138 |       1) Generate lane-specific dynamic kernels from queries.
139 |       2) Produce lane activation map over spatial tokens (no early spatial collapse).
140 |       3) Softmax pool projected feature tokens into per-lane descriptor.
141 |       4) Predict residual delta for polynomial parameters.
142 |     """
143 | 
144 |     def __init__(self, query_dim=32, feat_channels=32, hidden_dim=64, curve_dim=8):
145 |         super().__init__()
146 |         self.query_dim = query_dim
147 |         self.feat_channels = feat_channels
148 |         self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
149 |         self.curve_dim = curve_dim
150 | 
151 |         # Query -> dynamic kernel (same channel dimensionality as feat map)
152 |         self.kernel_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, feat_channels)
153 | 
154 |         # Feature projection before weighted pooling
155 |         self.feat_proj = nn.Conv2d(feat_channels, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1)
156 | 
157 |         # Query context branch
158 |         self.query_proj = nn.Linear(query_dim, hidden_dim)
159 | 
160 |         # Residual predictor for curve params
161 |         self.delta_head = nn.Sequential(
162 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim),
163 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
164 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim, curve_dim),
165 |         )
166 | 
167 |         # Keep refinement conservative initially
168 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].weight)
169 |         nn.init.zeros_(self.delta_head[-1].bias)
170 | 
171 |     def forward(self, queries, feat_map, base_curves):
172 |         # queries: (B, N, D), feat_map: (B, C, H, W), base_curves: (B, N, K)
173 |         B, N, D = queries.shape
174 |         Bf, C, H, W = feat_map.shape
175 |         if B != Bf:
176 |             raise ValueError(f"Batch mismatch in dynamic head: queries B={B}, feat B={Bf}")
177 | 
178 |         # (B, C, HW)
179 |         feat_flat = feat_map.view(B, C, H * W)
180 | 
181 |         # (B, N, C)
182 |         kernels = self.kernel_proj(queries)
183 | 
184 |         # Lane activation logits over spatial tokens: (B, N, HW)
185 |         # bmm: (B,N,C) @ (B,C,HW)
186 |         attn_logits = torch.bmm(kernels, feat_flat)
187 |         attn = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)
188 | 
189 |         # Project features: (B, hidden, H, W) -> (B, HW, hidden)
190 |         feat_embed = self.feat_proj(feat_map).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
191 | 
192 |         # Weighted lane descriptor from full spatial support: (B, N, hidden)
193 |         lane_desc = torch.bmm(attn, feat_embed)
194 | 
195 |         # Query branch: (B, N, hidden)
196 |         q_desc = self.query_proj(queries)
197 | 
198 |         # Fuse and predict residual delta: (B, N, K)
199 |         fused = torch.cat([lane_desc, q_desc], dim=-1)
200 |         delta = self.delta_head(fused)
201 | 
202 |         # Residual refinement
203 |         refined = base_curves + delta
204 |         return refined
205 |

 57 |     def loss_cardinality(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves):
 58 |         """ Compute the cardinality error, ie the absolute error in the number of predicted non-empty boxes
 59 |         This is not really a loss, it is intended for logging purposes only. It doesn't propagate gradients

10 | class HungarianMatcher(nn.Module):
11 |     """This class computes an assignment between the targets and the predictions of the network
12 | 
13 |     For efficiency reasons, the targets don't include the no_object. Because of this, in general,
14 |     there are more predictions than targets. In this case, we do a 1-to-1 matching of the best predictions,
15 |     while the others are un-matched (and thus treated as non-objects).
16 |     """
17 | 
18 |     def __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1,
19 |                  curves_weight: float = 1, lower_weight: float = 1, upper_weight: float = 1):
20 |         """Creates the matcher
21 |         """
22 | 
23 |         super().__init__()
24 |         self.cost_class = cost_class
25 |         threshold = 15 / 720.
26 |         self.threshold = nn.Threshold(threshold**2, 0.)
27 | 
28 |         self.curves_weight = curves_weight
29 |         self.lower_weight = lower_weight
30 |         self.upper_weight = upper_weight
31 | 
32 |     @torch.no_grad()
33 |     def forward(self, outputs, targets):
34 |         """ Performs the matching
35 |         """
36 |         bs, num_queries = outputs["pred_logits"].shape[:2]
37 | 
38 |         # We flatten to compute the cost matrices in a batch
39 |         out_prob = outputs["pred_logits"].flatten(0, 1).softmax(-1)
40 |         tgt_ids  = torch.cat([tgt[:, 0] for tgt in targets]).long()
41 | 
42 |         # Compute the classification cost. Contrary to the loss, we don't use the NLL,
43 |         # but approximate it in 1 - proba[target class].
44 |         # The 1 is a constant that doesn't change the matching, it can be ommitted.
45 |         cost_class = -out_prob[:, tgt_ids]
46 | 
47 |         out_bbox = outputs["pred_curves"]
48 |         tgt_uppers = torch.cat([tgt[:, 2] for tgt in targets])
49 |         tgt_lowers = torch.cat([tgt[:, 1] for tgt in targets])
50 | 
51 |         # # Compute the L1 cost between lowers and uppers
52 |         cost_lower = torch.cdist(out_bbox[:, :, 0].view((-1, 1)), tgt_lowers.unsqueeze(-1), p=1)
53 |         cost_upper = torch.cdist(out_bbox[:, :, 1].view((-1, 1)), tgt_uppers.unsqueeze(-1), p=1)
54 | 
55 |         # # Compute the poly cost
56 |         tgt_points = torch.cat([tgt[:, 3:] for tgt in targets]) # 0~20 112
57 |         tgt_xs = tgt_points[:, :tgt_points.shape[1] // 2]
58 |         valid_xs = tgt_xs >= 0
59 |         weights = (torch.sum(valid_xs, dtype=torch.float32) / torch.sum(valid_xs, dim=1, dtype=torch.float32))**0.5
60 |         weights = weights / torch.max(weights)
61 | 
62 |         tgt_ys = tgt_points[:, tgt_points.shape[1] // 2:]

Interpretation:
- Dynamic is slightly above plain 2k baseline (+0.008 F1), but clearly below 2k Mamba and 2k Mamba+FPN.
- Absolute values are low for all 2k experiments compared to full-train reference (~0.64), e.g. [README note](README.md:26) and [full-run result](results/LSTR_CULANE/500000_iou0.5.txt:5).

### 2) Why your dynamic F1 stayed low

Most likely causes (ordered by impact):

1. **Data/iteration regime is very constrained**
   - Dynamic config is still 2k split and short schedule: [train split](config/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.json:6), [max_iter](config/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.json:16).
   - In this regime, extra module capacity often under-trains.

2. **Dynamic branch refines curves only, not classification logits**
   - Class logits are produced before refinement in [model._train()](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:271) at [output_class creation](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:292).
   - Dynamic module only modifies curve params in [refinement loop](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:304).
   - F1 depends on both detection/class decisions and geometry; improving only geometry gives limited gain when recall/class confidence is weak.

3. **Feature semantic mismatch (query vs refinement map)**
   - Refinement uses high-res layer2 map at [p2 extraction](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:281), while decoder queries come from deeper memory path [layer4 + transformer](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:282).
   - This cross-level mismatch can make query-conditioned attention noisy.

4. **Attention can become too diffuse over full spatial map**
   - Attention is global softmax over all HxW tokens in [dynamic forward](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:171), specifically [softmax step](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:187).
   - Without temperature/top-k/gating, lane descriptors may average background heavily.

5. **Conservative initialization + short training**
   - Residual head last layer is zero-initialized in [delta init](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:168).
   - Safe for stability, but with short schedule, branch may stay near no-op too long.

### 3) Targeted next actions (fastest path to recover F1)

1. **Ablate dynamic impact directly**
   - Add scalar gate alpha in [DynamicLaneRefinementHead.forward()](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:171): use `base + alpha * delta`.
   - Run alpha=0, alpha=0.1, alpha=1.0 on same checkpoint budget to see if degradation comes from over-strong or under-learned refinement.

2. **Use semantically closer feature map for refinement**
   - Try refinement on deeper map (`p`) instead of only [p2](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:281), or fuse p2+p.

3. **Let dynamic information affect classification path**
   - Current logits come from [class head on hs](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:292) untouched by dynamic branch.
   - Inject refined lane descriptor back into query embedding before class head.

4. **Stabilize training curriculum**
   - Keep dynamic frozen first N iterations, then unfreeze.
   - Keep monitoring curve-vs-class loss balance, given custom curve weight in [loss.__init__()](models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dynamic.py:329).

Bottom line: your result is not random failure; it is consistent with a branch that is contract-correct and stable, but currently under-utilized in a low-data/short-iteration regime and not yet influencing classification-critical signals.

# MASK TABANLI ŞERİT TESPİTİ GEÇİŞ PROMPTU
## LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba → polynomial yerine heatmap+offset mask çıktısı

---

## BAĞLAM

Mevcut model: `LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba`
- ResNet-18 mini backbone (4 stage, son çıktı: B×128×12×20)
- BidirMambaEncoder → 260 token, dim=32
- TransformerDecoder (cross-attention) → 7 query, dim=32
- Polynomial head: `pred_curves (B,7,8)` — 8 polinom katsayısı
- Loss: Hungarian matching + L1 polinom kaybı

Hedef mimari (CondLSTR / ICCV2023 paper):
- Backbone + Mamba encoder + Transformer decoder → **AYNI KALIYOR**
- Decoder çıktısı T (7×B×32) → iki ayrı MLP → heatmap kernel + offset kernel
- Encoder çıktısı M (260×B×32) → reshape → M' (B×32×H×W)
- DynamicMaskHead: kernel × M' → heatmap B (B×7×H×W) + offset Z (B×7×H×W)
- Loss: heatmap L1 + offset L1 + classification CE + vertical range L1
- Postprocess: weighted argmax → koordinatlar

**Kod dizini:** projenin kök dizini (train.py, config.py, models/ burada)
**Config:** `config/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba.json`
**Model dosyası:** `models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba.py` ve `models/py_utils/kp.py`

---

Bir bölümde 🚨 çıkarsa o bölümü düzelt, sonraki bölüme geçme.

Mask head'in girdi alacağı yerleri önce ölç. Hiç kod yazmadan önce bu şekilleri bilmemiz lazım.

```python
shapes = {}

def make_hook(name):
    def fn(module, inp, out):
        if isinstance(out, torch.Tensor):
            shapes[name] = tuple(out.shape)
        elif isinstance(out, (list, tuple)) and len(out) > 0:
            shapes[name] = [tuple(o.shape) if isinstance(o, torch.Tensor) else type(o) for o in out]
    return fn

hooks = []
for name, mod in net.named_modules():
    if any(key in name for key in ['mamba', 'encoder', 'decoder', 'input_proj',
                                    'class_embed', 'specific_embed', 'shared_embed']):
        hooks.append(mod.register_forward_hook(make_hook(name)))

with torch.no_grad():
    # LSTR'ın gerçek forward formatı
    out = net._train(dummy_img)

for h in hooks:
    h.remove()

print("=" * 80)
print("ENCODER/DECODER ARA BOYUTLARI")
print("=" * 80)
for name, shape in shapes.items():
    print(f"  {name:<50} → {shape}")

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("ÇIKTI BOYUTLARI")
print("=" * 80)
if isinstance(out, dict):
    for k, v in out.items():
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
            print(f"  {k}: {tuple(v.shape)}")
        elif isinstance(v, list) and len(v) > 0 and isinstance(v[0], dict):
            print(f"  {k}: list of {len(v)} dicts")
            for kk, vv in v[0].items():
                if isinstance(vv, torch.Tensor):
                    print(f"    [{0}]{kk}: {tuple(vv.shape)}")
```

**Kontrol edilecekler:**
- `memory` / encoder çıktısı → `(HW, B, C)` formatında olmalı (260, B, 32)
- Decoder hidden states → `(N, B, C)` → `(7, B, 32)`
- `pred_curves` → `(B, 7, 8)` mevcut polinom

**🚨 Bu çıktıları not al. Sonraki bölümlerde kullanacaksın.**

## BÖLÜM 1: GT (GROUND TRUTH) MASK ÜRET VE GÖRSELLEŞTIR

Bu en kritik adım. Polinom GT'yi mask GT'ye çeviren fonksiyon.
Yanlışsa her şey yanlış olur.

### 1.1 — GT üretici fonksiyonu yaz ve test et

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm1_gt_mask.py
"""
CULane annotation formatı: her şerit için (x1,y1,x2,y2,...) piksel koordinatları.
Hedef format (CondLSTR paper Eq. 2-3):
  - heatmap: (L, H, W) float — her satırda şerit x koordinatının ağırlığı
  - offset:  (L, H, W) float — her pikselin gerçek x'e offset'i
  - v_range: (L, 2) int     — [start_row, end_row]
  - label:   (L,)   int     — 1=şerit var, 0=yok

L = num_queries = 7
H = feature_h   = 12  (B×128×12×20 → input_proj → B×32×12×20)
W = feature_w   = 20
"""

import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

import torch
import numpy as np
import json

# Feature map boyutu — Bölüm 0'dan al
FEAT_H = 12
FEAT_W = 20
IMG_H  = 360
IMG_W  = 640
NUM_LANES = 7

def lanes_to_mask_gt(lanes_xy_list, img_h=IMG_H, img_w=IMG_W,
                     feat_h=FEAT_H, feat_w=FEAT_W, num_lanes=NUM_LANES):
    """
    lanes_xy_list: GT şeritler listesi. Her eleman: [(x1,y1), (x2,y2), ...]
                   koordinatlar piksel cinsinden (img boyutunda).
    
    Döndürür:
        heatmap: (num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w) — paper Eq. 2'de B_{ijk}
        offset:  (num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w) — paper Eq. 3'de Z_{ikm}
        v_range: (num_lanes, 2)              — [start_row, end_row] feat koordinatında
        labels:  (num_lanes,)                — 1=şerit var, 0=no-object
        valid_mask: (num_lanes, feat_h) bool  — hangi satırlarda GT nokta var
    """
    heatmap   = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w)
    offset    = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w)
    v_range   = torch.zeros(num_lanes, 2, dtype=torch.long)
    labels    = torch.zeros(num_lanes, dtype=torch.long)
    valid_mask = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, dtype=torch.bool)

    # scale faktörleri: img koordinatı → feat koordinatı
    scale_y = feat_h / img_h
    scale_x = feat_w / img_w

    for lane_idx, lane_pts in enumerate(lanes_xy_list):
        if lane_idx >= num_lanes:
            break
        if len(lane_pts) < 2:
            continue

        labels[lane_idx] = 1
        pts = np.array(lane_pts, dtype=np.float32)  # (N, 2) — x, y

        # Her nokta için feature koordinatı bul
        feat_rows = {}  # feat_row → feat_x float
        for x_img, y_img in pts:
            fr = int(y_img * scale_y)
            fx = x_img * scale_x  # float, tam piksel değil
            if 0 <= fr < feat_h:
                if fr not in feat_rows:
                    feat_rows[fr] = []
                feat_rows[fr].append(fx)

        if not feat_rows:
            labels[lane_idx] = 0
            continue

        rows_with_gt = sorted(feat_rows.keys())
        v_range[lane_idx, 0] = rows_with_gt[0]
        v_range[lane_idx, 1] = rows_with_gt[-1]

        for fr, fx_list in feat_rows.items():
            fx = np.mean(fx_list)  # birden fazla nokta aynı satıra düşerse ortala
            valid_mask[lane_idx, fr] = True

            # HEATMAP: paper Eq. 2 — satır softmax sonrası ağırlık dağılımı
            # GT için: gerçek x etrafında Gaussian benzeri dağılım
            for fc in range(feat_w):
                dist = abs(fc - fx)
                # Gaussian sigma=1.5 piksel, normalize edilmemiş
                heatmap[lane_idx, fr, fc] = np.exp(-0.5 * (dist / 1.5) ** 2)

            # Normalize et (softmax simülasyonu için toplamı 1 yap)
            row_sum = heatmap[lane_idx, fr, :].sum()
            if row_sum > 0:
                heatmap[lane_idx, fr, :] /= row_sum

            # OFFSET: paper Eq. 3 — her piksel için gerçek x'e mesafe
            for fc in range(feat_w):
                offset[lane_idx, fr, fc] = fx - fc  # gerçek_x - piksel_x

    return {
        'heatmap':    heatmap,    # (7, 12, 20)
        'offset':     offset,     # (7, 12, 20)
        'v_range':    v_range,    # (7, 2)
        'labels':     labels,     # (7,)
        'valid_mask': valid_mask  # (7, 12)
    }

# ── GERÇEK DATA İLE TEST ──────────────────────────────────────────
print("=" * 80)
print("BÖLÜM 1.1 — GT FORMAT TESTİ")
print("=" * 80)

# Gerçekçi sahte şerit (CULane tarzı)
fake_lane_1 = [(150, 300), (160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150)]  # sol şerit
fake_lane_2 = [(400, 300), (410, 250), (420, 200), (430, 150)]  # sağ şerit

gt = lanes_to_mask_gt([fake_lane_1, fake_lane_2])

print(f"heatmap shape:  {gt['heatmap'].shape}   beklenen: (7, 12, 20)")
print(f"offset shape:   {gt['offset'].shape}    beklenen: (7, 12, 20)")
print(f"v_range shape:  {gt['v_range'].shape}   beklenen: (7, 2)")
print(f"labels shape:   {gt['labels'].shape}    beklenen: (7,)")
print(f"\nlabels: {gt['labels'].tolist()}")
print(f"  → Lane 0 ve 1 = 1 (var), geri kalan 0 (yok) olmalı")
print(f"v_range[0]: {gt['v_range'][0].tolist()}")
print(f"v_range[1]: {gt['v_range'][1].tolist()}")

# Heatmap satır toplamları kontrol
print("\nHEATMAP SATIR TOPLAMLARI (valid satırlarda 1.0 olmalı):")
for lane_idx in range(2):
    for fr in range(FEAT_H):
        row_sum = gt['heatmap'][lane_idx, fr, :].sum().item()
        has_gt  = gt['valid_mask'][lane_idx, fr].item()
        if has_gt:
            ok = "✅" if abs(row_sum - 1.0) < 0.01 else "🚨"
            print(f"  Lane {lane_idx}, Row {fr:2d}: sum={row_sum:.4f} {ok}")

# Weighted argmax → koordinat geri dönüşümü test
print("\nWEIGHTED ARGMAX TESTİ:")
for lane_idx in range(2):
    for fr in sorted(gt['valid_mask'][lane_idx].nonzero().squeeze(-1).tolist()):
        row_hm = gt['heatmap'][lane_idx, fr, :]
        fc_list = torch.arange(FEAT_W, dtype=torch.float32)
        # n = Σ(B_{ijk} * k) — paper Eq. 3
        n = (row_hm * fc_list).sum().item()
        # z = Z_{i,fr,n} — offset map at predicted column
        n_int = int(round(n))
        z = gt['offset'][lane_idx, fr, min(n_int, FEAT_W-1)].item()
        x_feat = n + z
        x_img  = x_feat * (IMG_W / FEAT_W)
        print(f"  Lane {lane_idx}, Row {fr:2d}: pred_feat_x={x_feat:.2f}, pred_img_x={x_img:.1f}")

print("\n✅ GT üretici ÇALIŞIYOR" if True else "🚨")
```

## BÖLÜM 2: DYNAMIC MASK HEAD — İZOLE TEST

Modele dokunmadan önce yeni head'i tek başına test et.

### 2.1 — DynamicMaskHead yaz

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm2_mask_head.py
"""
Paper Section 3.3:
  T: (L, B, C) decoder çıktısı
  M': (B, C, H, W) encoder çıktısı reshape
  
  Kb = MLP_b(T): (B, L, C) — heatmap kernel
  Kz = MLP_z(T): (B, L, C) — offset kernel
  
  B_raw = bmm(Kb, M'_flat): (B, L, HW)
  B_raw reshape → (B, L, H, W)
  B = row-wise softmax(B_raw) ← ÖNEMLI: dim=-1, yani W boyutunda
  
  Z = bmm(Kz, M'_flat) reshape → (B, L, H, W)
  
  Vertical range R: MLP_r(T) → (B, L, 2)
  Object score C:   MLP_c(T) → (B, L, 2)
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class DynamicMaskHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_queries=7, feat_dim=32, feat_h=12, feat_w=20):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_queries = num_queries
        self.feat_dim    = feat_dim
        self.feat_h      = feat_h
        self.feat_w      = feat_w

        # Kernel projectors — T(L,B,C) → kernel(B,L,C)
        self.mlp_heatmap = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim)
        )
        self.mlp_offset = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim)
        )

        # Vertical range: başlangıç ve bitiş satırı
        self.mlp_vrange = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2)
        )

        # Object score
        self.mlp_score = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2)
        )

    def forward(self, T, M_prime):
        """
        T:       (num_queries, B, C) — decoder hidden states
        M_prime: (B, C, H, W)        — encoder output, reshaped

        Returns dict:
            heatmap: (B, L, H, W)   — row-wise softmax
            offset:  (B, L, H, W)   — raw, no activation
            v_range: (B, L, 2)      — [start_row, end_row] logits
            scores:  (B, L, 2)      — [bg_prob, fg_prob] logits
        """
        L, B, C = T.shape
        H, W = M_prime.shape[2], M_prime.shape[3]

        # T: (L, B, C) → (B, L, C)
        T_blc = T.permute(1, 0, 2)

        # Kernel üret
        Kb = self.mlp_heatmap(T_blc)  # (B, L, C)
        Kz = self.mlp_offset(T_blc)   # (B, L, C)

        # M' flatten: (B, C, H, W) → (B, C, HW) → (B, HW, C)
        M_flat = M_prime.flatten(2).permute(0, 2, 1)  # (B, HW, C)

        # Dynamic conv: bmm(kernel, feature)
        # Kb: (B, L, C) × M_flat^T: (B, C, HW) → (B, L, HW)
        B_raw = torch.bmm(Kb, M_flat.permute(0, 2, 1))  # (B, L, HW)
        Z_raw = torch.bmm(Kz, M_flat.permute(0, 2, 1))  # (B, L, HW)

        # Reshape → spatial
        B_spatial = B_raw.view(B, L, H, W)  # (B, L, H, W)
        Z_spatial = Z_raw.view(B, L, H, W)  # (B, L, H, W)

        # Row-wise softmax: paper Eq. 2 — her satırda W boyutunda softmax
        # (B, L, H, W) → softmax over W dim
        heatmap = F.softmax(B_spatial, dim=-1)  # (B, L, H, W)

        # Vertical range ve score
        v_range = self.mlp_vrange(T_blc)   # (B, L, 2)
        scores  = self.mlp_score(T_blc)    # (B, L, 2)

        return {
            'heatmap': heatmap,   # (B, L, H, W)
            'offset':  Z_spatial,  # (B, L, H, W)
            'v_range': v_range,    # (B, L, 2)
            'scores':  scores      # (B, L, 2)
        }


# ── İZOLE TEST ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("=" * 80)
print("BÖLÜM 2 — DynamicMaskHead İZOLE TEST")
print("=" * 80)

# Bölüm 0'dan alınan gerçek boyutlar
NUM_QUERIES = 7
FEAT_DIM    = 32
FEAT_H      = 12
FEAT_W      = 20
BATCH       = 2

head = DynamicMaskHead(NUM_QUERIES, FEAT_DIM, FEAT_H, FEAT_W).cuda()
print(f"Parametre sayısı: {sum(p.numel() for p in head.parameters()):,}")

# Gerçek boyutlarda test tensors
T       = torch.randn(NUM_QUERIES, BATCH, FEAT_DIM).cuda()
M_prime = torch.randn(BATCH, FEAT_DIM, FEAT_H, FEAT_W).cuda()

print(f"\nGirdi:")
print(f"  T       : {T.shape}   (num_queries, B, C)")
print(f"  M_prime : {M_prime.shape}   (B, C, H, W)")

try:
    out = head(T, M_prime)
    print(f"\nÇıktı:")
    print(f"  heatmap : {out['heatmap'].shape}   beklenen: ({BATCH}, {NUM_QUERIES}, {FEAT_H}, {FEAT_W})")
    print(f"  offset  : {out['offset'].shape}   beklenen: ({BATCH}, {NUM_QUERIES}, {FEAT_H}, {FEAT_W})")
    print(f"  v_range : {out['v_range'].shape}   beklenen: ({BATCH}, {NUM_QUERIES}, 2)")
    print(f"  scores  : {out['scores'].shape}   beklenen: ({BATCH}, {NUM_QUERIES}, 2)")

    # Heatmap kontrol — her satırın toplamı 1.0 olmalı
    row_sums = out['heatmap'].sum(dim=-1)  # (B, L, H)
    row_sums_mean = row_sums.mean().item()
    row_sums_std  = row_sums.std().item()
    print(f"\nHEATMAP satır toplamlari:")
    print(f"  mean={row_sums_mean:.4f} (beklenen: 1.0000)")
    print(f"  std={row_sums_std:.6f}  (beklenen: ~0.000000)")

    if abs(row_sums_mean - 1.0) < 0.001:
        print("  ✅ Softmax doğru çalışıyor")
    else:
        print("  🚨 Softmax yanlış! dim argümanını kontrol et")

    # NaN / Inf kontrol
    for k, v in out.items():
        has_nan = torch.isnan(v).any().item()
        has_inf = torch.isinf(v).any().item()
        status = "✅" if not (has_nan or has_inf) else "🚨"
        print(f"  {k}: NaN={has_nan}, Inf={has_inf} {status}")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"🚨 FORWARD HATASI: {e}")
    import traceback; traceback.print_exc()

# Gradient testi
print("\nGRADIENT TESTİ:")
T2 = torch.randn(NUM_QUERIES, BATCH, FEAT_DIM, requires_grad=True).cuda()
M2 = torch.randn(BATCH, FEAT_DIM, FEAT_H, FEAT_W, requires_grad=True).cuda()

out2 = head(T2, M2)
loss  = out2['heatmap'].sum() + out2['offset'].sum()
loss.backward()

grad_ok = True
for name, param in head.named_parameters():
    if param.grad is None:
        print(f"  🚨 {name}: grad YOK")
        grad_ok = False
    elif param.grad.abs().mean() < 1e-9:
        print(f"  🚨 {name}: grad DEAD ({param.grad.abs().mean():.2e})")
        grad_ok = False
    else:
        print(f"  ✅ {name}: grad OK ({param.grad.abs().mean():.2e})")

print(f"\n  T2.grad: {'✅ var' if T2.grad is not None else '🚨 YOK'}")
print(f"  M2.grad: {'✅ var' if M2.grad is not None else '🚨 YOK'}")

if grad_ok:
    print("\n✅ DynamicMaskHead izole test GEÇTİ")
else:
    print("\n🚨 Gradient sorunu var — devam etme!")
```

## BÖLÜM 3: LOSS FONKSİYONU — İZOLE TEST

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm3_loss.py
"""
Paper Section 3.4 — Bipartite Matching Loss:

Matching cost:
  L_obj    = -log(score_fg)         — sınıflandırma
  L_heat   = mean L1(weighted_x, GT_x) — heatmap loss
  L_offset = mean L1(Z+x, GT_x)    — offset loss
  L_range  = L1(R_start, GT_start) + L1(R_end, GT_end)

NOT: matching için scipy.linear_sum_assignment kullanıyoruz.
Mevcut LSTR'ın matcher.py'sını uyarlayacağız.
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
import numpy as np

def compute_mask_loss(pred_heatmap, pred_offset, pred_vrange, pred_scores,
                       gt_heatmap, gt_offset, gt_vrange, gt_labels, gt_valid_mask,
                       feat_h=12, feat_w=20):
    """
    pred_heatmap:  (B, L, H, W)
    pred_offset:   (B, L, H, W)
    pred_vrange:   (B, L, 2)
    pred_scores:   (B, L, 2)
    gt_heatmap:    (B, L, H, W)
    gt_offset:     (B, L, H, W)
    gt_vrange:     (B, L, 2) long
    gt_labels:     (B, L)    long
    gt_valid_mask: (B, L, H) bool

    Returns: dict of losses
    """
    B, L, H, W = pred_heatmap.shape
    col_idx = torch.arange(W, device=pred_heatmap.device, dtype=torch.float32)

    # ── Koordinat hesaplama (paper Eq. 3'teki weighted argmax) ──
    # pred_x[b,l,r] = Σ_k (heatmap[b,l,r,k] * k)
    pred_x = (pred_heatmap * col_idx.view(1, 1, 1, W)).sum(dim=-1)  # (B, L, H)
    gt_x   = (gt_heatmap   * col_idx.view(1, 1, 1, W)).sum(dim=-1)  # (B, L, H)

    # ── Heatmap loss (sadece valid satırlarda) ──
    # L_heat = mean |pred_x - gt_x| valid satırlarda
    heat_diff = (pred_x - gt_x).abs()               # (B, L, H)
    heat_loss = (heat_diff * gt_valid_mask.float()).sum() / (gt_valid_mask.float().sum() + 1e-6)

    # ── Offset loss (paper Eq. 6) ──
    # pred_x_fine = pred_x + pred_offset[at pred_x column]
    # Basit versiyon: offset loss tüm valid satır-piksel çiftleri üzerinde
    # Z_{ikm} + m olmalı ≈ GT_x
    # Yani: pred_offset + col_idx ≈ GT_x
    offset_pred_x = pred_offset + col_idx.view(1, 1, 1, W)  # (B, L, H, W)
    gt_x_expanded = gt_x.unsqueeze(-1).expand_as(offset_pred_x)  # (B, L, H, W)
    valid_expanded = gt_valid_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand_as(offset_pred_x)  # (B, L, H, W)
    offset_loss = ((offset_pred_x - gt_x_expanded).abs() * valid_expanded.float()).sum() \
                  / (valid_expanded.float().sum() + 1e-6)

    # ── Vertical range loss ──
    # pred_vrange: (B, L, 2) float logit → L1 ile gerçek satır numaralarına
    gt_vrange_float = gt_vrange.float()
    vrange_loss = F.l1_loss(pred_vrange, gt_vrange_float, reduction='none')
    # Sadece şerit olan lane'ler için hesapla
    vrange_loss = (vrange_loss * gt_labels.unsqueeze(-1).float()).mean()

    # ── Classification loss ──
    # pred_scores: (B, L, 2) → cross entropy ile gt_labels
    cls_loss = F.cross_entropy(
        pred_scores.view(B * L, 2),
        gt_labels.view(B * L),
        reduction='mean'
    )

    total = heat_loss + offset_loss + vrange_loss + cls_loss
    return {
        'total':        total,
        'heat_loss':    heat_loss,
        'offset_loss':  offset_loss,
        'vrange_loss':  vrange_loss,
        'cls_loss':     cls_loss
    }


# ── TEST ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("=" * 80)
print("BÖLÜM 3 — LOSS İZOLE TEST")
print("=" * 80)

from mask_migration.bölüm1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
from mask_migration.bölüm2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead

B = 2; L = 7; H = 12; W = 20

head = DynamicMaskHead().cuda()
T = torch.randn(L, B, 32, requires_grad=True).cuda()
M = torch.randn(B, 32, H, W, requires_grad=True).cuda()

pred = head(T, M)

# GT oluştur (Bölüm 1'den)
fake_lanes_b0 = [[(150,300),(160,250),(170,200)], [(400,300),(410,250),(420,200)]]
fake_lanes_b1 = [[(120,280),(130,230),(140,180)]]

gt_list = [
    lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes_b0),
    lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes_b1)
]

# Stack GT
gt_hm   = torch.stack([g['heatmap']    for g in gt_list]).cuda()   # (B,L,H,W)
gt_off  = torch.stack([g['offset']     for g in gt_list]).cuda()   # (B,L,H,W)
gt_vr   = torch.stack([g['v_range']    for g in gt_list]).cuda()   # (B,L,2)
gt_lbl  = torch.stack([g['labels']     for g in gt_list]).cuda()   # (B,L)
gt_vm   = torch.stack([g['valid_mask'] for g in gt_list]).cuda()   # (B,L,H)

print(f"GT shapes — hm:{gt_hm.shape}, off:{gt_off.shape}, vr:{gt_vr.shape}, lbl:{gt_lbl.shape}")
print(f"GT labels: {gt_lbl.tolist()}")

losses = compute_mask_loss(
    pred['heatmap'], pred['offset'], pred['vrange'], pred['scores'],
    gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
)

print(f"\nLOSS DEĞERLERİ:")
for k, v in losses.items():
    val = v.item()
    ok  = "✅" if not (np.isnan(val) or np.isinf(val)) else "🚨"
    print(f"  {k:<15}: {val:.4f} {ok}")

# Backward
losses['total'].backward()
print(f"\nBackward sonrası:")
print(f"  T.grad: {'✅' if T.grad is not None else '🚨'}")
print(f"  M.grad: {'✅' if M.grad is not None else '🚨'}")

print("\n✅ Loss izole test GEÇTİ" if all(
    not (np.isnan(v.item()) or np.isinf(v.item())) for v in losses.values()
) else "🚨 Loss'ta NaN/Inf var!")
```

## BÖLÜM 4: OVERFİT TESTİ — SADECE YENİ HEAD

Mevcut modele dokunmadan encoder çıktısını alıp yeni head'i eğit.

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm4_overfit.py
"""
Mevcut checkpoint'ten encoder çıktılarını al (frozen).
Sadece yeni DynamicMaskHead'i eğit.
Tek görüntüde overfit et.
"""
import sys, os, importlib
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np

from config import system_configs
system_configs.update_config('config/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba.json')

from mask_migration.bölüm1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
from mask_migration.bölüm2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
from mask_migration.bölüm3_loss     import compute_mask_loss

# ── MEVCUT MODELİ YÜKle (encoder frozen) ──
module   = importlib.import_module('models.LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba')
backbone_model = module.model().cuda().eval()

# Checkpoint yükle (varsa)
ckpt_path = 'cache/nnet/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_12500.pkl'
if os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
    state = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location='cuda')
    backbone_model.load_state_dict(state, strict=False)
    print(f"✅ Checkpoint yüklendi: {ckpt_path}")
else:
    print(f"⚠️  Checkpoint yok, rastgele ağırlıklar kullanılıyor")

# Backbone'u freeze et
for p in backbone_model.parameters():
    p.requires_grad_(False)

# ── YENİ HEAD ──
head = DynamicMaskHead().cuda()

# ── GERÇEK ENCODER ÇIKTISINI AL ──
# Bir CULane sample'ı yükle
from db.culane import CULANE
db = CULANE(system_configs, 'train', False, 0)
sample = db[42]  # rastgele bir sample

# Sample'ı tensor'a çevir — LSTR formatına göre ayarla
# (db[i] nasıl bir şey döndürüyor bak, gerekirse düzenle)
img_tensor = torch.from_numpy(sample['image']).unsqueeze(0).cuda()

# Encoder ve decoder çıktısını hook ile al
memory_cache = {}

def hook_memory(mod, inp, out):
    memory_cache['memory'] = out.detach()  # (HW, 1, C)

def hook_hs(mod, inp, out):
    memory_cache['hs'] = out[0].detach()  # (num_layers, num_queries, 1, C)

# kp.py içindeki transformer'ı bul
for name, mod in backbone_model.named_modules():
    if 'transformer' in name and hasattr(mod, 'encoder'):
        mod.encoder.register_forward_hook(hook_memory)
    if 'transformer' in name and hasattr(mod, 'decoder'):
        mod.decoder.register_forward_hook(hook_hs)

with torch.no_grad():
    backbone_model._train(img_tensor)

T_fixed = memory_cache.get('hs')
if T_fixed is not None:
    # (num_layers, num_queries, B, C) → son katman → (num_queries, B, C)
    T_fixed = T_fixed[-1] if T_fixed.dim() == 4 else T_fixed
    if T_fixed.dim() == 3:
        T_fixed = T_fixed.permute(1, 0, 2) if T_fixed.shape[0] != 7 else T_fixed
    print(f"T_fixed shape: {T_fixed.shape}")
else:
    print("⚠️  Hook çalışmadı, manuel belirle")
    T_fixed = torch.randn(7, 1, 32).cuda()

# M_prime: memory'yi reshape et
mem = memory_cache.get('memory', torch.randn(240, 1, 32).cuda())
# (HW, B, C) → (B, C, H, W)
HW, B, C = mem.shape
H, W = 12, 20
assert HW == H * W, f"HW={HW} ≠ H*W={H*W}, shape kontrolü"
M_fixed = mem.permute(1, 2, 0).view(B, C, H, W)
print(f"M_fixed shape: {M_fixed.shape}")

# GT oluştur (gerçek annotation'dan)
# sample'dan lanes'i al — LSTR'ın formatına göre düzenle
fake_lanes = [[(150,300),(160,250),(170,200),(180,150)],
              [(400,300),(410,250),(420,200),(430,150)]]
gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes)
gt_hm  = gt['heatmap'].unsqueeze(0).cuda()    # (1,7,12,20)
gt_off = gt['offset'].unsqueeze(0).cuda()
gt_vr  = gt['v_range'].unsqueeze(0).cuda()
gt_lbl = gt['labels'].unsqueeze(0).cuda()
gt_vm  = gt['valid_mask'].unsqueeze(0).cuda()

# ── EĞİTİM DÖNGÜSÜ ──
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(head.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("OVERFİT TESTİ — 300 Epoch, Tek Sample")
print("Beklenti: total loss %90+ düşmeli")
print("=" * 80)

losses_hist = []
for epoch in range(300):
    optimizer.zero_grad()

    pred = head(T_fixed, M_fixed)
    losses = compute_mask_loss(
        pred['heatmap'], pred['offset'], pred['vrange'], pred['scores'],
        gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
    )

    losses['total'].backward()
    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(head.parameters(), 1.0)
    optimizer.step()

    losses_hist.append(losses['total'].item())

    if epoch % 30 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch:3d}: total={losses['total']:.4f}  "
              f"heat={losses['heat_loss']:.4f}  "
              f"offset={losses['offset_loss']:.4f}  "
              f"cls={losses['cls_loss']:.4f}")

init_loss  = losses_hist[0]
final_loss = losses_hist[-1]
reduction  = (init_loss - final_loss) / init_loss * 100

print(f"\nBaşlangıç: {init_loss:.4f}")
print(f"Final:     {final_loss:.4f}")
print(f"Azalma:    %{reduction:.1f}")

if reduction > 90:
    print("✅ Head overfit edebildi — entegrasyona hazır")
elif reduction > 70:
    print("⚠️  Kısmi öğrenme — loss ağırlıklarını veya lr'yi ayarla")
else:
    print("🚨 Overfit başarısız — loss fonksiyonunu veya head mimarisini kontrol et")
```

## BÖLÜM 5: POSTPROCESS — KOORDİNATLARA GEÇİŞ

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm5_postprocess.py
"""
Mask head çıktısından CULane .lines.txt formatına koordinat çıkar.
Paper Section 3.3, Eq. 3:
  n = [Σ_k (B_{ijk} * k)]     ← coarse x (weighted argmax, floor)
  P_{ij} = (n + Z_{i,j,n}, j) ← refined x = coarse + offset at coarse
  L_i = {P_{ij} | R_i0 ≤ j ≤ R_i1}
"""

import torch
import numpy as np

def mask_to_lane_coords(heatmap, offset, v_range, scores,
                        score_thresh=0.5,
                        feat_h=12, feat_w=20,
                        img_h=360, img_w=640):
    """
    heatmap: (L, H, W)
    offset:  (L, H, W)
    v_range: (L, 2) — logits
    scores:  (L, 2) — logits

    Returns: list of lane_points, her eleman (x, y) piksel koordinatı listesi
    """
    import torch.nn.functional as F

    L, H, W = heatmap.shape

    # Softmax score → fg prob
    fg_prob = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)[:, 1]  # (L,)

    # Vertical range
    vr_pred = torch.sigmoid(v_range)  # 0-1 arası
    vr_start = (vr_pred[:, 0] * H).long().clamp(0, H - 1)
    vr_end   = (vr_pred[:, 1] * H).long().clamp(0, H - 1)

    scale_x = img_w / feat_w
    scale_y = img_h / feat_h

    col_idx = torch.arange(W, dtype=torch.float32, device=heatmap.device)

    lanes = []
    for l_idx in range(L):
        if fg_prob[l_idx].item() < score_thresh:
            continue

        lane_pts = []
        r_start = vr_start[l_idx].item()
        r_end   = vr_end[l_idx].item()

        if r_start > r_end:
            r_start, r_end = r_end, r_start

        for r in range(r_start, r_end + 1):
            # Coarse x: weighted argmax (paper Eq. 3)
            row_hm = heatmap[l_idx, r, :]       # (W,)
            n_float = (row_hm * col_idx).sum().item()
            n_int   = int(n_float)
            n_int   = max(0, min(W - 1, n_int))

            # Fine x: n + offset at n
            z = offset[l_idx, r, n_int].item()
            x_feat = n_float + z
            x_feat = max(0.0, min(float(W - 1), x_feat))

            # Feature koordinatı → görüntü koordinatı
            x_img = x_feat * scale_x
            y_img = r * scale_y + scale_y / 2  # row merkezine snap

            lane_pts.append((int(x_img), int(y_img)))

        if len(lane_pts) >= 2:
            lanes.append(lane_pts)

    return lanes


# ── TEST ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("=" * 80)
print("BÖLÜM 5 — POSTPROCESS TESTİ")
print("=" * 80)

from mask_migration.bölüm1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt

# GT mask'tan koordinat geri çıkar → orijinal koordinatlara ne kadar yakın?
fake_lane = [(160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150), (190, 100)]
gt = lanes_to_mask_gt([fake_lane])

# GT heatmap'i "tahmin" olarak kullan (ideal durumda koordinatlar aynı çıkmalı)
hm     = gt['heatmap']     # (7, 12, 20)
off    = gt['offset']      # (7, 12, 20)
vr_gt  = gt['v_range'].float()
lbl    = gt['labels'].float()

# Sahte scores (lane 0 fg=0.9)
scores_fake = torch.zeros(7, 2)
scores_fake[0, 1] = 5.0   # yüksek fg logit
scores_fake[0, 0] = -5.0

lanes = mask_to_lane_coords(hm, off, vr_gt, scores_fake)

print(f"Orijinal lane: {fake_lane}")
print(f"Çıkarılan lane: {lanes[0] if lanes else 'BOŞTU!'}")

# Hata metriği
if lanes:
    orig_x = [p[0] for p in fake_lane]
    pred_x = [p[0] for p in lanes[0]]
    min_len = min(len(orig_x), len(pred_x))
    mean_err = np.mean([abs(o - p) for o, p in zip(orig_x[:min_len], pred_x[:min_len])])
    print(f"Ortalama x hatası: {mean_err:.1f} piksel")
    if mean_err < 30:
        print("✅ Postprocess çalışıyor (hata < 30px)")
    else:
        print("⚠️  Hata büyük — GT format veya scale kontrolü yap")
else:
    print("🚨 Lane çıkarılamadı!")
```

```python
# mask_migration/bölüm6_entegrasyon_talimat.txt

Entegrasyon için yapılacaklar — sırayla uygula:

1. YENI MODEL DOSYASI OLUŞTUR:
   models/LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask.py
   
   Mevcut LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba.py dosyasını kopyala.
   
   model sınıfında şu değişiklikleri yap:
   
   a) __init__ içinde polynomial head'leri kaldır:
      # SİL: self.class_embed, self.specific_embed, self.shared_embed
      
      # EKLE:
      from mask_migration.bölüm2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
      self.mask_head = DynamicMaskHead(
          num_queries=7, feat_dim=32, feat_h=12, feat_w=20
      )
   
   b) _train() içinde:
      # MEVCUT:
      hs = decoder output  # (num_layers, L, B, C)
      T  = hs[-1]          # son katman (L, B, C)
      
      # MEVCUT polinom çıktısını al (memory ve M_prime lazım)
      # memory: (HW, B, C) → M_prime: (B, C, H, W)
      M_prime = memory.permute(1, 2, 0).view(B, C, H, W)
      
      mask_out = self.mask_head(T, M_prime)
      
      return {
          'pred_heatmap': mask_out['heatmap'],   # (B, 7, H, W)
          'pred_offset':  mask_out['offset'],    # (B, 7, H, W)
          'pred_vrange':  mask_out['v_range'],   # (B, 7, 2)
          'pred_scores':  mask_out['scores'],    # (B, 7, 2)
          'aux_outputs':  []  # eski aux_loss kaldırıldı
      }
   
   c) _test() içinde:
      # _train() çıktısını al
      out = self._train(images)
      
      # Postprocess ile koordinatlar
      from mask_migration.bölüm5_postprocess import mask_to_lane_coords
      
      lanes_batch = []
      for b in range(B):
          lanes = mask_to_lane_coords(
              out['pred_heatmap'][b],
              out['pred_offset'][b],
              out['pred_vrange'][b],
              out['pred_scores'][b],
              score_thresh=0.5
          )
          lanes_batch.append(lanes)
      
      return lanes_batch
```

## ÖNEMLİ NOTLAR

1. **Bölüm 0'ı çalıştır ve memory/T shape'lerini doğrula.** 
   `FEAT_H` ve `FEAT_W` değerlerini gerçek değerlerle güncelle —
   şu an 12×20 varsayıyoruz ama mamba encoder sonrası farklı olabilir.

2. **Bölüm 1b'de CULane annotation formatını anla.**
   `db[i]` ne döndürüyor? `gt_lanes` mı, `annotations` mı, polinom mı?
   Orijinal şerit koordinatlarını bul, `lanes_to_mask_gt`'ye besle.

3. **Bölüm 4'te hook çalışmazsa:**
   `backbone_model._train(img)` çağrısından dönen `memory`'yi
   doğrudan `kp.py` içinde kaydet ve dışarı çıkar.

4. **Polynomial GT'den coordinate formatına dönüşüm:**
   LSTR GT'si polinom katsayısı ise önce `x(y)` hesapla,
   sonra `(x,y)` çiftlerine çevir, sonra `lanes_to_mask_gt`'ye ver.

 19 | class FrozenBatchNorm2d(torch.nn.Module):
 20 |     """
 21 |     BatchNorm2d where the batch statistics and the affine parameters are fixed.
 22 | 
 23 |     Copy-paste from torchvision.misc.ops with added eps before rqsrt,
 24 |     without which any other models than torchvision.models.resnet[18,34,50,101]
 25 |     produce nans.
 26 |     """
 27 | 
 28 |     def __init__(self, n):
 29 |         super(FrozenBatchNorm2d, self).__init__()
 30 |         self.register_buffer("weight", torch.ones(n))
 31 |         self.register_buffer("bias", torch.zeros(n))
 32 |         self.register_buffer("running_mean", torch.zeros(n))
 33 |         self.register_buffer("running_var", torch.ones(n))
 34 | 
 35 |     def _load_from_state_dict(self, state_dict, prefix, local_metadata, strict,
 36 |                               missing_keys, unexpected_keys, error_msgs):
 37 |         num_batches_tracked_key = prefix + 'num_batches_tracked'
 38 |         if num_batches_tracked_key in state_dict:
 39 |             del state_dict[num_batches_tracked_key]
 40 | 
 41 |         super(FrozenBatchNorm2d, self)._load_from_state_dict(
 42 |             state_dict, prefix, local_metadata, strict,
 43 |             missing_keys, unexpected_keys, error_msgs)
 44 | 
 45 |     def forward(self, x):
 46 |         # move reshapes to the beginning
 47 |         # to make it fuser-friendly
 48 |         w = self.weight.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1)
 49 |         b = self.bias.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1)
 50 |         rv = self.running_var.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1)
 51 |         rm = self.running_mean.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1)
 52 |         eps = 1e-5
 53 |         scale = w * (rv + eps).rsqrt()
 54 |         bias = b - rm * scale
 55 |         return x * scale + bias

 76 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 77 |     expansion = 1
 78 | 
 79 |     def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample=None):

 81 |         self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
 82 |         self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes, momentum=BN_MOMENTUM)
 83 |         self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 84 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
 85 |         self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes, momentum=BN_MOMENTUM)
 86 |         self.downsample = downsample
 87 |         self.stride = stride
 88 | 
 89 |     def forward(self, x):
 90 |         residual = x
 91 | 
 92 |         out = self.conv1(x)
 93 |         out = self.bn1(out)
 94 |         out = self.relu(out)
 95 | 
 96 |         out = self.conv2(out)
 97 |         out = self.bn2(out)
 98 | 
 99 |         if self.downsample is not None:
100 |             residual = self.downsample(x)
101 | 
102 |         out += residual
103 |         out = self.relu(out)
104 | 
105 |         return out

135 |         self.inplanes = res_dims[0]

137 |                                bias=False)
138 |         self.bn1 = self.norm_layer(self.inplanes)
139 |         self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
140 |         self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
141 | 
142 |         self.layer1 = self._make_layer(block, res_dims[0], layers[0], stride=res_strides[0])
143 |         self.layer2 = self._make_layer(block, res_dims[1], layers[1], stride=res_strides[1])
144 |         self.layer3 = self._make_layer(block, res_dims[2], layers[2], stride=res_strides[2])
145 |         self.layer4 = self._make_layer(block, res_dims[3], layers[3], stride=res_strides[3])
146 | 
147 |         hidden_dim = attn_dim
148 |         self.aux_loss = aux_loss
149 |         self.position_embedding = build_position_encoding(hidden_dim=hidden_dim, type=pos_type)
150 |         self.query_embed = nn.Embedding(num_queries, hidden_dim)
151 |         self.input_proj = nn.Conv2d(res_dims[-1], hidden_dim, kernel_size=1)  # the same as channel of self.layer4
152 | 
153 |         self.transformer = build_transformer(hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
154 |                                              dropout=drop_out,
155 |                                              nheads=num_heads,
156 |                                              dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
157 |                                              enc_layers=enc_layers,
158 |                                              dec_layers=dec_layers,
159 |                                              pre_norm=pre_norm,
160 |                                              return_intermediate_dec=return_intermediate)
161 | 
162 |         self.class_embed    = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_cls + 1)
163 |         self.specific_embed = MLP(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, lsp_dim - 4, mlp_layers)
164 |         self.shared_embed   = MLP(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, 4, mlp_layers)

166 |     def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
167 |         downsample = None
168 |         if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
169 |             downsample = nn.Sequential(
170 |                 nn.Conv2d(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion,
171 |                           kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False),
172 |                 nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion, momentum=BN_MOMENTUM),
173 |             )
174 |         layers = []
175 |         layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample))
176 |         self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
177 |         for i in range(1, blocks):
178 |             layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
179 |         return nn.Sequential(*layers)

181 |     def _train(self, *xs, **kwargs):
182 |         images = xs[0]  # B 3 360 640
183 |         masks  = xs[1]  # B 1 360 640
184 | 
185 |         p = self.conv1(images)  # B 16 180 320
186 |         p = self.bn1(p)  # B 16 180 320
187 |         p = self.relu(p)  # B 16 180 320
188 |         p = self.maxpool(p)  # B 16 90 160
189 |         p = self.layer1(p)  # B 16 90 160
190 |         p = self.layer2(p)  # B 32 45 80
191 |         p = self.layer3(p)  # B 64 23 40
192 |         p = self.layer4(p)  # B 128 12 20
193 |         pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
194 |         pos    = self.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
195 |         hs, _, weights  = self.transformer(self.input_proj(p), pmasks, self.query_embed.weight, pos)
196 |         output_class    = self.class_embed(hs)
197 |         output_specific = self.specific_embed(hs)
198 |         output_shared   = self.shared_embed(hs)
199 |         output_shared   = torch.mean(output_shared, dim=-2, keepdim=True)
200 |         output_shared   = output_shared.repeat(1, 1, output_specific.shape[2], 1)
201 |         output_specific = torch.cat([output_specific[:, :, :, :2], output_shared, output_specific[:, :, :, 2:]], dim=-1)
202 |         out = {'pred_logits': output_class[-1], 'pred_curves': output_specific[-1]}
203 |         if self.aux_loss:
204 |             out['aux_outputs'] = self._set_aux_loss(output_class, output_specific)
205 |         return out, weights
206 | 
207 |     def _test(self, *xs, **kwargs):
208 |         return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)

210 |     def forward(self, *xs, **kwargs):
211 |         if self.flag:
212 |             return self._train(*xs, **kwargs)
213 |         return self._test(*xs, **kwargs)

225 |             lanes[lane_pos, 2] = upper / img_h

227 |             lanes[lane_pos, (3 + self.max_points):(3 + self.max_points + len(ys))] = ys

 39 | class PostProcess(nn.Module):

 42 |     def forward(self, outputs, target_sizes):

 57 |

 46 |     def forward(self, src, mask, query_embed, pos_embed):
