*** Add File: condlstr_analysis/bolum1b_head_with_coords.py
+"""
+BÖLÜM 1b — Coord-aware head analizi (izole).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Coord injection destekli başlık (head) varyantını bağımsız test etmek
+2) Sıfır coord-kernel ile baseline ile birebir uyum göstermek
+3) Coord-kernel etkinleştirildiğinde çıktının değiştiğini doğrulamak
+4) Gradient akışını kontrol etmek
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
+from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, forward_to_decoder, load_system_config
+
+
+def inject_coord_channels(memory: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if memory.dim() != 4:
+        raise ValueError(f"memory must be 4D (B,C,H,W), got {tuple(memory.shape)}")
+    bsz, _c, h, w = memory.shape
+    ys = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=h, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
+    xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
+    y_plane = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(bsz, 1, h, w)
+    x_plane = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(bsz, 1, h, w)
+    return torch.cat([memory, y_plane, x_plane], dim=1)
+
+
+class DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords(nn.Module):
+    """
+    T:       (L, B, C) or (B, L, C)
+    M_prime: (B, C, H, W)
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32, use_coords: bool = True):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_queries = num_queries
+        self.feat_dim = feat_dim
+        self.use_coords = use_coords
+        self.kernel_dim = feat_dim + (2 if use_coords else 0)
+
+        self.mlp_heatmap = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, self.kernel_dim),
+        )
+        self.mlp_offset = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, self.kernel_dim),
+        )
+        self.mlp_vrange = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2),
+        )
+        self.mlp_score = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _to_blc(t: torch.Tensor, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if t.dim() != 3:
+            raise ValueError(f"T must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
+        if t.shape[1] == batch:  # (L,B,C)
+            return t.permute(1, 0, 2)
+        if t.shape[0] == batch:  # (B,L,C)
+            return t
+        raise ValueError(f"Cannot infer batch dim from T={tuple(t.shape)} and batch={batch}")
+
+    def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m_prime: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        if m_prime.dim() != 4:
+            raise ValueError(f"M_prime must be 4D, got {tuple(m_prime.shape)}")
+
+        bsz, channels, h, w = m_prime.shape
+        if channels != self.feat_dim:
+            raise ValueError(f"M_prime channels={channels}, expected feat_dim={self.feat_dim}")
+
+        t_blc = self._to_blc(t, bsz)
+        feats = inject_coord_channels(m_prime) if self.use_coords else m_prime
+
+        m_flat = feats.flatten(2)  # (B, C(+2), HW)
+        kb = self.mlp_heatmap(t_blc)  # (B, L, C(+2))
+        kz = self.mlp_offset(t_blc)   # (B, L, C(+2))
+
+        b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, m_flat)
+        z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, m_flat)
+
+        b_spatial = b_raw.view(bsz, t_blc.shape[1], h, w)
+        z_spatial = z_raw.view(bsz, t_blc.shape[1], h, w)
+
+        heatmap = F.softmax(b_spatial, dim=-1)
+        v_range = self.mlp_vrange(t_blc)
+        scores = self.mlp_score(t_blc)
+
+        return {
+            "heatmap": heatmap,
+            "offset": z_spatial,
+            "v_range": v_range,
+            "scores": scores,
+        }
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def copy_from_baseline(baseline: DynamicMaskHead, coord_head: DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords) -> None:
+    """Baseline ağırlıklarını coord-head'e taşır, extra coord kernel satırlarını 0 başlatır."""
+
+    def _copy_kernel_mlp(src: nn.Sequential, dst: nn.Sequential, feat_dim: int) -> None:
+        dst[0].weight.copy_(src[0].weight)
+        dst[0].bias.copy_(src[0].bias)
+        dst[2].weight.zero_()
+        dst[2].bias.zero_()
+        dst[2].weight[:feat_dim].copy_(src[2].weight)
+        dst[2].bias[:feat_dim].copy_(src[2].bias)
+
+    _copy_kernel_mlp(baseline.mlp_heatmap, coord_head.mlp_heatmap, coord_head.feat_dim)
+    _copy_kernel_mlp(baseline.mlp_offset, coord_head.mlp_offset, coord_head.feat_dim)
+
+    coord_head.mlp_vrange.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_vrange.state_dict())
+    coord_head.mlp_score.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_score.state_dict())
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def enable_coord_effect(coord_head: DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords, scale: float = 5e-2) -> None:
+    """Extra coord kernel satırlarını sıfırdan çıkararak coord etkisini görünür yapar."""
+    fd = coord_head.feat_dim
+
+    # heatmap kernel (y ve x coord satırları)
+    coord_head.mlp_heatmap[2].weight[fd + 0].fill_(+scale)
+    coord_head.mlp_heatmap[2].weight[fd + 1].fill_(-scale)
+
+    # offset kernel
+    coord_head.mlp_offset[2].weight[fd + 0].fill_(-scale)
+    coord_head.mlp_offset[2].weight[fd + 1].fill_(+scale)
+
+
+def _max_diff(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return float((a - b).abs().max().item())
+
+
+def _mean_diff(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return float((a - b).abs().mean().item())
+
+
+def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask", batch: int = 2, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
+
+    net = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=True)
+
+    images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        hs, memory, _ = forward_to_decoder(net, images, masks)
+        t_blc = hs[-1]  # (B, L, C)
+
+    bsz, c, h, w = memory.shape
+    lq = t_blc.shape[1]
+
+    baseline_head = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=lq, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
+    baseline_head.load_state_dict(net.mask_head.state_dict(), strict=True)
+    baseline_head.eval()
+
+    coord_head = DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords(num_queries=lq, feat_dim=c, use_coords=True).to(device)
+    coord_head.eval()
+    copy_from_baseline(baseline_head, coord_head)
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        out_base = baseline_head(t_blc, memory)
+        out_coord_zero = coord_head(t_blc, memory)
+
+    zero_diffs = {
+        "heatmap": _max_diff(out_base["heatmap"], out_coord_zero["heatmap"]),
+        "offset": _max_diff(out_base["offset"], out_coord_zero["offset"]),
+        "v_range": _max_diff(out_base["v_range"], out_coord_zero["v_range"]),
+        "scores": _max_diff(out_base["scores"], out_coord_zero["scores"]),
+    }
+
+    enable_coord_effect(coord_head, scale=5e-2)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        out_coord_on = coord_head(t_blc, memory)
+
+    effect_diffs = {
+        "heatmap": _mean_diff(out_coord_zero["heatmap"], out_coord_on["heatmap"]),
+        "offset": _mean_diff(out_coord_zero["offset"], out_coord_on["offset"]),
+    }
+
+    # Gradient testi
+    coord_head.train()
+    t2 = t_blc.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    m2 = memory.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    out_grad = coord_head(t2, m2)
+    grad_loss = (
+        out_grad["heatmap"].sum()
+        + out_grad["offset"].sum()
+        + out_grad["v_range"].sum()
+        + out_grad["scores"].sum()
+    )
+    grad_loss.backward()
+
+    grad_ok = True
+    for p in coord_head.parameters():
+        if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
+            grad_ok = False
+            break
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["shape_ok"] = tuple(out_coord_on["heatmap"].shape) == (bsz, lq, h, w)
+    checks["finite_outputs"] = all(
+        bool(torch.isfinite(v).all().item())
+        for v in [
+            out_coord_on["heatmap"],
+            out_coord_on["offset"],
+            out_coord_on["v_range"],
+            out_coord_on["scores"],
+        ]
+    )
+    checks["zero_coord_matches_baseline"] = max(zero_diffs.values()) < 1e-6
+    checks["coords_change_output"] = (effect_diffs["heatmap"] > 1e-8) or (effect_diffs["offset"] > 1e-8)
+    checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (t2.grad is not None) and (m2.grad is not None)
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 1b — HEAD WITH COORDS")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
+    print(f"T shape: {tuple(t_blc.shape)}")
+    print(f"M_prime shape: {tuple(memory.shape)}")
+    print(f"Output shape: {tuple(out_coord_on['heatmap'].shape)}")
+
+    print("\nZero-coord compatibility max |diff|:")
+    for k, v in zero_diffs.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<8}: {v:.3e}")
+
+    print("\nCoord effect mean |diff| (after enabling coord kernels):")
+    for k, v in effect_diffs.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<8}: {v:.3e}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<30}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask")
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 1b — Head+Coords: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+BÖLÜM 2 — Real GT pipeline analizi (izole).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Mevcut label-tensor tabanlı GT ile old_anno['lanes'] tabanlı gerçek GT'yi karşılaştırmak
+2) Shape/finite/coverage farklarını sayısallaştırmak
+3) Match cost düzeyinde iki GT kaynağının etkisini izole etmek
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from config import system_configs
+from db.culane import CULANE
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import labels_to_mask_batch_gt, lanes_to_mask_gt
+from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, infer_feature_hw, load_system_config
+
+
+def _extract_old_lanes(item: dict) -> List[List[Tuple[float, float]]]:
+    old_lanes = item.get("old_anno", {}).get("lanes", [])
+    lanes: List[List[Tuple[float, float]]] = []
+    for lane in old_lanes:
+        pts = [(float(x), float(y)) for (x, y) in lane if x >= 0 and y >= 0]
+        if len(pts) >= 2:
+            lanes.append(pts)
+    return lanes
+
+
+def old_anno_to_mask_batch_gt(
+    items: Sequence[dict],
+    feat_h: int,
+    feat_w: int,
+    num_lanes: int,
+    img_h: int,
+    img_w: int,
+) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    hm, off, vr, lbl, vm = [], [], [], [], []
+    for item in items:
+        lanes = _extract_old_lanes(item)
+        gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
+            lanes,
+            img_h=img_h,
+            img_w=img_w,
+            feat_h=feat_h,
+            feat_w=feat_w,
+            num_lanes=num_lanes,
+            normalized=False,
+        )
+        hm.append(gt["heatmap"])
+        off.append(gt["offset"])
+        vr.append(gt["v_range"])
+        lbl.append(gt["labels"])
+        vm.append(gt["valid_mask"])
+    return {
+        "heatmap": torch.stack(hm, dim=0),
+        "offset": torch.stack(off, dim=0),
+        "v_range": torch.stack(vr, dim=0),
+        "labels": torch.stack(lbl, dim=0),
+        "valid_mask": torch.stack(vm, dim=0),
+    }
+
+
+def _rowloc_from_heatmap(hm: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # hm: (B, L, H, W) -> row-wise expected x (B, L, H)
+    w = hm.shape[-1]
+    cols = torch.arange(w, dtype=hm.dtype, device=hm.device)
+    return (hm * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)
+
+
+def _simple_match_cost(
+    pred_scores: torch.Tensor,   # (B, L, 2)
+    pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,  # (B, L, H, W)
+    pred_vrange: torch.Tensor,   # (B, L, 2)
+    gt_hm: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, H, W)
+    gt_vr: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, 2)
+    gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,        # (B, L)
+    gt_vm: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, H)
+) -> List[float]:
+    """Current [mask_migration.bolum3_loss.py](mask_migration/bolum3_loss.py:12) cost benzeri skaler rapor."""
+    bsz, lq, _h, _w = pred_heatmap.shape
+    pred_x = _rowloc_from_heatmap(pred_heatmap)
+    gt_x = _rowloc_from_heatmap(gt_hm)
+
+    batch_costs: List[float] = []
+    fg_prob = torch.softmax(pred_scores, dim=-1)[:, :, 1]  # (B, L)
+
+    for b in range(bsz):
+        gt_idx = torch.nonzero(gt_lbl[b] > 0, as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)
+        if gt_idx.numel() == 0:
+            batch_costs.append(0.0)
+            continue
+        csum = 0.0
+        for g in gt_idx.tolist():
+            valid = gt_vm[b, g]
+            if bool(valid.any().item()):
+                heat_cost = torch.abs(pred_x[b, :, valid] - gt_x[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
+            else:
+                heat_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, dtype=pred_x.dtype, device=pred_x.device)
+            range_cost = torch.abs(pred_vrange[b] - gt_vr[b, g].float().unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
+            cls_cost = 1.0 - fg_prob[b]
+            total_cost = cls_cost + heat_cost + 0.25 * range_cost
+            csum += float(total_cost.min().item())
+        batch_costs.append(csum / max(len(gt_idx), 1))
+
+    return batch_costs
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask", samples: int = 8, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+
+    model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=True)
+    in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
+    feat_h, feat_w = infer_feature_hw(model, in_h, in_w, device)
+    num_lanes = int(system_configs.num_queries)
+
+    db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
+    n = min(samples, len(db.db_inds))
+    indices = [int(db.db_inds[i]) for i in range(n)]
+    items = [db.detections(i) for i in indices]
+
+    # 1) label-tensor GT
+    label_tensors = [torch.from_numpy(it["label"]).float() for it in items]
+    gt_label = labels_to_mask_batch_gt(label_tensors, feat_h=feat_h, feat_w=feat_w, num_lanes=num_lanes)
+
+    # 2) old_anno lanes GT (real)
+    gt_real = old_anno_to_mask_batch_gt(
+        items,
+        feat_h=feat_h,
+        feat_w=feat_w,
+        num_lanes=num_lanes,
+        img_h=int(db.img_h),
+        img_w=int(db.img_w),
+    )
+
+    # tek batch infer
+    images = torch.randn(n, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    masks = torch.zeros(n, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    outputs, _ = model._train(images, masks)
+
+    pred_hm = outputs["pred_heatmap"]
+    pred_vr = outputs["pred_vrange"]
+    pred_sc = outputs["pred_scores"]
+
+    gt_label_dev = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in gt_label.items()}
+    gt_real_dev = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in gt_real.items()}
+
+    # coverage / density
+    lbl_lane_counts = gt_label["labels"].sum(dim=1).cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32)
+    real_lane_counts = gt_real["labels"].sum(dim=1).cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32)
+
+    lbl_valid_rows = gt_label["valid_mask"].sum(dim=(1, 2)).cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32)
+    real_valid_rows = gt_real["valid_mask"].sum(dim=(1, 2)).cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32)
+
+    # pairwise diffs (GT source difference)
+    hm_l1 = float((gt_label["heatmap"] - gt_real["heatmap"]).abs().mean().item())
+    vr_l1 = float((gt_label["v_range"].float() - gt_real["v_range"].float()).abs().mean().item())
+
+    # match-cost proxy (same preds, farklı GT kaynakları)
+    cost_label = _simple_match_cost(
+        pred_scores=pred_sc,
+        pred_heatmap=pred_hm,
+        pred_vrange=pred_vr,
+        gt_hm=gt_label_dev["heatmap"],
+        gt_vr=gt_label_dev["v_range"],
+        gt_lbl=gt_label_dev["labels"],
+        gt_vm=gt_label_dev["valid_mask"],
+    )
+    cost_real = _simple_match_cost(
+        pred_scores=pred_sc,
+        pred_heatmap=pred_hm,
+        pred_vrange=pred_vr,
+        gt_hm=gt_real_dev["heatmap"],
+        gt_vr=gt_real_dev["v_range"],
+        gt_lbl=gt_real_dev["labels"],
+        gt_vm=gt_real_dev["valid_mask"],
+    )
+
+    d_cost = float(np.mean(np.asarray(cost_real) - np.asarray(cost_label)))
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["shape_match"] = (
+        tuple(gt_label["heatmap"].shape) == tuple(gt_real["heatmap"].shape)
+        and tuple(gt_label["offset"].shape) == tuple(gt_real["offset"].shape)
+        and tuple(gt_label["v_range"].shape) == tuple(gt_real["v_range"].shape)
+    )
+    checks["finite_gt"] = all(
+        bool(torch.isfinite(v).all().item())
+        for v in [
+            gt_label["heatmap"],
+            gt_label["offset"],
+            gt_label["v_range"].float(),
+            gt_real["heatmap"],
+            gt_real["offset"],
+            gt_real["v_range"].float(),
+        ]
+    )
+    checks["real_pipeline_nonempty"] = float(real_lane_counts.mean()) > 0.0 and float(real_valid_rows.mean()) > 0.0
+    checks["gt_sources_not_identical"] = (hm_l1 > 1e-8) or (vr_l1 > 1e-8)
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 2 — REAL GT ANALİZİ")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
+    print(f"Samples: {n}")
+    print(f"Input size: {(in_h, in_w)}, feature size: {(feat_h, feat_w)}")
+
+    print("\nGT kaynak karşılaştırması:")
+    print(f"  lane_count(label) mean: {float(lbl_lane_counts.mean()):.3f}")
+    print(f"  lane_count(real ) mean: {float(real_lane_counts.mean()):.3f}")
+    print(f"  valid_rows(label) mean: {float(lbl_valid_rows.mean()):.3f}")
+    print(f"  valid_rows(real ) mean: {float(real_valid_rows.mean()):.3f}")
+    print(f"  heatmap L1(label-real): {hm_l1:.6e}")
+    print(f"  vrange  L1(label-real): {vr_l1:.6e}")
+
+    print("\nMatch-cost proxy (aynı pred, farklı GT):")
+    print(f"  cost(label) mean: {float(np.mean(cost_label)):.6f}")
+    print(f"  cost(real ) mean: {float(np.mean(cost_real)):.6f}")
+    print(f"  delta(real-label): {d_cost:.6f}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<28}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask")
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, samples=args.samples, seed=args.seed)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 2 — Real GT: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""
+BÖLÜM 3 — Prior bias analizi (izole).
+
+Amaç:
+1) CondLSTR benzeri prior-bias başlatmasını skor başlığına uygulamak
+2) Başlangıç fg olasılık dağılımını sayısallaştırmak
+3) Bias öncesi/sonrası loss-gradient davranışını karşılaştırmak
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import math
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
+from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
+from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
+
+
+def init_score_prior_bias(head: DynamicMaskHead, prior_prob: float = 0.01) -> None:
+    if not (0.0 < prior_prob < 1.0):
+        raise ValueError(f"prior_prob must be in (0,1), got {prior_prob}")
+    bias_value = -math.log((1.0 - prior_prob) / prior_prob)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        last = head.mlp_score[-1]
+        if not isinstance(last, torch.nn.Linear) or last.out_features != 2:
+            raise ValueError("mlp_score son katmanı 2 çıkışlı Linear olmalı")
+        last.bias[0] = 0.0
+        last.bias[1] = float(bias_value)
+
+
+def _build_toy_gt(batch: int, lanes: int, h: int, w: int, device: torch.device):
+    gt_list = []
+    for b in range(batch):
+        dx = 10 * b
+        fake_lanes = [
+            [(150 + dx, 300), (160 + dx, 250), (170 + dx, 200), (180 + dx, 150)],
+            [(390 - dx, 300), (400 - dx, 250), (410 - dx, 200), (420 - dx, 150)],
+        ]
+        gt_list.append(lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes, img_h=360, img_w=640, feat_h=h, feat_w=w, num_lanes=lanes))
+
+    gt_hm = torch.stack([g["heatmap"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_off = torch.stack([g["offset"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_vr = torch.stack([g["v_range"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_lbl = torch.stack([g["labels"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_vm = torch.stack([g["valid_mask"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    return gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
+
+
+def _collect_stats(
+    head: DynamicMaskHead,
+    t: torch.Tensor,
+    m: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_hm: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_off: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_vr: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_vm: torch.Tensor,
+) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    out = head(t, m)
+    probs = torch.softmax(out["scores"], dim=-1)[..., 1]
+
+    losses = compute_mask_loss(
+        out["heatmap"],
+        out["offset"],
+        out["v_range"],
+        out["scores"],
+        gt_hm,
+        gt_off,
+        gt_vr,
+        gt_lbl,
+        gt_vm,
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "fg_prob_mean": float(probs.mean().item()),
+        "fg_prob_std": float(probs.std().item()),
+        "fg_prob_min": float(probs.min().item()),
+        "fg_prob_max": float(probs.max().item()),
+        "loss_total": float(losses["total"].item()),
+        "loss_cls": float(losses["cls_loss"].item()),
+        "loss_heat": float(losses["heat_loss"].item()),
+        "loss_off": float(losses["offset_loss"].item()),
+        "loss_vr": float(losses["vrange_loss"].item()),
+    }
+
+
+def run(seed: int = 0, prior_prob: float = 0.01) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    b, l, c, h, w = 2, 7, 32, 10, 26

+    m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device)
+    gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm = _build_toy_gt(b, l, h, w, device)
+
+    # Aynı başlangıçtan iki head
+    base = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
+    with_prior = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
+    with_prior.load_state_dict(base.state_dict(), strict=True)

+
+    stats_base = _collect_stats(base, t, m, gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm)
+    stats_prior = _collect_stats(with_prior, t, m, gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm)
+
+    # gradient kıyası (classification head odaklı)
+    for mod in (base, with_prior):

+    out_b = base(t, m)
+    loss_b = compute_mask_loss(out_b["heatmap"], out_b["offset"], out_b["v_range"], out_b["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm)["total"]

+
+    out_p = with_prior(t, m)
+    loss_p = compute_mask_loss(out_p["heatmap"], out_p["offset"], out_p["v_range"], out_p["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm)["total"]
+    loss_p.backward()
+    grad_p = float(with_prior.mlp_score[-1].weight.grad.abs().mean().item())
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["prior_reduces_initial_fg_prob"] = stats_prior["fg_prob_mean"] < stats_base["fg_prob_mean"]
+    checks["prior_fg_near_target_scale"] = abs(stats_prior["fg_prob_mean"] - prior_prob) < 0.05
+    checks["loss_finite"] = np.isfinite(stats_base["loss_total"]) and np.isfinite(stats_prior["loss_total"])
+    checks["gradient_alive"] = grad_b > 0.0 and grad_p > 0.0
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 3 — PRIOR BIAS ANALİZİ")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Prior prob: {prior_prob}")
+
+    print("\nBase stats:")
+    for k, v in stats_base.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<14}: {v:.6f}")
+
+    print("\nPrior stats:")
+    for k, v in stats_prior.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<14}: {v:.6f}")
+
+    print("\nGrad mean |mlp_score[-1].weight|:")
+    print(f"  base : {grad_b:.6e}")
+    print(f"  prior: {grad_p:.6e}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<30}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--prior", type=float, default=0.01)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(seed=args.seed, prior_prob=args.prior)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 3 — Prior Bias: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+"""
+BÖLÜM 4 — Dense offset supervision analizi (izole).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Mevcut offset loss (n_idx tek örnekleme) ile dense offset loss'u karşılaştırmak
+2) Farkın sayısal büyüklüğünü raporlamak
+3) Dense loss altında gradient akışını doğrulamak
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
+from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
+from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
+
+
+def dense_offset_loss(
+    pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,  # (B,L,H,W)
+    pred_offset: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
+    gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,H,W)
+    gt_offset: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
+    gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor, # (B,L,H)
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """
+    Row-wise dense supervision:
+      valid satırlarda W boyunca |pred_offset - gt_offset|, gt_heatmap ile ağırlıklı ortalama.
+    """
+    diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)
+    w = gt_heatmap / gt_heatmap.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
+    row_loss = (diff * w).sum(dim=-1)  # (B,L,H)
+    m = gt_valid_mask.float()
+    return (row_loss * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
+
+
+def _build_toy_gt(batch: int, lanes: int, h: int, w: int, device: torch.device):
+    gt_list = []
+    for b in range(batch):
+        dx = 12 * b
+        fake_lanes = [
+            [(140 + dx, 300), (152 + dx, 250), (164 + dx, 200), (176 + dx, 150)],
+            [(420 - dx, 300), (408 - dx, 250), (396 - dx, 200), (384 - dx, 150)],
+        ]
+        gt_list.append(lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes, img_h=360, img_w=640, feat_h=h, feat_w=w, num_lanes=lanes))
+
+    gt_hm = torch.stack([g["heatmap"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_off = torch.stack([g["offset"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_vr = torch.stack([g["v_range"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_lbl = torch.stack([g["labels"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    gt_vm = torch.stack([g["valid_mask"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
+    return gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
+
+
+def run(seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    b, l, c, h, w = 2, 7, 32, 10, 26
+    head = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
+
+    t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm = _build_toy_gt(b, l, h, w, device)
+
+    pred = head(t, m)
+    base_losses = compute_mask_loss(
+        pred["heatmap"], pred["offset"], pred["v_range"], pred["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
+    )
+
+    dense_off = dense_offset_loss(pred["heatmap"], pred["offset"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vm)
+    total_dense = base_losses["total"] + dense_weight * dense_off
+
+    head.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    if t.grad is not None:
+        t.grad.zero_()
+    if m.grad is not None:
+        m.grad.zero_()
+
+    total_dense.backward()
+
+    grad_alive = True
+    for p in head.parameters():
+        if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
+            grad_alive = False
+            break
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["dense_loss_positive"] = float(dense_off.item()) >= 0.0
+    checks["dense_changes_total"] = abs(float(total_dense.item()) - float(base_losses["total"].item())) > 1e-9
+    checks["finite"] = np.isfinite(float(total_dense.item()))
+    checks["gradient_alive"] = grad_alive and (t.grad is not None) and (m.grad is not None)
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 4 — DENSE OFFSET ANALİZİ")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"dense_weight: {dense_weight}")
+    print(f"base_total : {float(base_losses['total'].item()):.6f}")
+    print(f"base_offset: {float(base_losses['offset_loss'].item()):.6f}")
+    print(f"dense_off  : {float(dense_off.item()):.6f}")
+    print(f"total_dense: {float(total_dense.item()):.6f}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<24}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--dense-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(seed=args.seed, dense_weight=args.dense_weight)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 4 — Dense Offset: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

*** Add File: condlstr_analysis/bolum5_overfit_combined.py
+"""
+BÖLÜM 5 — Combined overfit smoke test (izole).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Coord-aware head + prior bias + dense offset kombinasyonunu izole ortamda doğrulamak
+2) Tek örnek üzerinde kısa overfit eğrisi üretmek
+3) Entegrasyon öncesi eğitilebilirlik riskini erken görmek
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import math
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
+from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
+
+
+def inject_coord_channels(memory: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    b, _c, h, w = memory.shape
+    ys = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=h, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
+    xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
+    y = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(b, 1, h, w)
+    x = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(b, 1, h, w)
+    return torch.cat([memory, y, x], dim=1)
+
+
+class CoordHead(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.feat_dim = feat_dim
+        kd = feat_dim + 2
+        self.mlp_heat = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
+        self.mlp_off = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
+        self.mlp_vr = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
+        self.mlp_sc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
+
+    def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
+        # t: (L,B,C) or (B,L,C), m: (B,C,H,W)
+        b, _c, h, w = m.shape
+        if t.shape[1] == b:
+            t = t.permute(1, 0, 2)
+        f = inject_coord_channels(m)
+        flat = f.flatten(2)
+        kb = self.mlp_heat(t)
+        kz = self.mlp_off(t)
+        b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
+        z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
+        return {
+            "heatmap": F.softmax(b_raw, dim=-1),
+            "offset": z_raw,
+            "v_range": self.mlp_vr(t),
+            "scores": self.mlp_sc(t),
+        }
+
+
+def init_prior(head: CoordHead, prior_prob: float = 0.01):
+    bias_value = -math.log((1.0 - prior_prob) / prior_prob)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[0] = 0.0
+        head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[1] = float(bias_value)
+
+
+def dense_offset_loss(pred_offset: torch.Tensor, gt_offset: torch.Tensor, gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor, gt_valid: torch.Tensor):
+    diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)
+    w = gt_heatmap / gt_heatmap.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
+    row = (diff * w).sum(dim=-1)
+    m = gt_valid.float()
+    return (row * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
+
+
+def run(epochs: int = 120, lr: float = 1e-3, seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    b, l, c, h, w = 1, 7, 32, 10, 26
+
+    t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device)
+    m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device)
+
+    gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
+        [
+            [(150, 300), (160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150)],
+            [(410, 300), (400, 250), (390, 200), (380, 150)],
+        ],
+        img_h=360,
+        img_w=640,
+        feat_h=h,
+        feat_w=w,
+        num_lanes=l,
+    )
+
+    gt_hm = gt["heatmap"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    gt_off = gt["offset"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    gt_vr = gt["v_range"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    gt_lbl = gt["labels"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    gt_vm = gt["valid_mask"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+
+    head = CoordHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c).to(device)
+    init_prior(head, prior_prob=0.01)
+    optim = torch.optim.Adam(head.parameters(), lr=lr)
+
+    hist = []
+    for ep in range(epochs):
+        optim.zero_grad()
+        out = head(t, m)
+        losses = compute_mask_loss(
+            out["heatmap"], out["offset"], out["v_range"], out["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
+        )
+        d_off = dense_offset_loss(out["offset"], gt_off, gt_hm, gt_vm)
+        total = losses["total"] + dense_weight * d_off
+        total.backward()
+        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(head.parameters(), 1.0)
+        optim.step()
+        hist.append(float(total.item()))
+
+        if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
+            print(
+                f"Epoch {ep:3d}: total={float(total.item()):.4f} "
+                f"base={float(losses['total'].item()):.4f} dense={float(d_off.item()):.4f}"
+            )
+
+    init_loss = hist[0]
+    final_loss = hist[-1]
+    reduction = (init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-6) * 100.0
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["loss_finite"] = np.isfinite(init_loss) and np.isfinite(final_loss)
+    checks["loss_reduced"] = final_loss < init_loss
+    checks["reduction_over_30pct"] = reduction > 30.0
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 5 — COMBINED OVERFIT")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Init loss : {init_loss:.6f}")
+    print(f"Final loss: {final_loss:.6f}")
+    print(f"Reduction : {reduction:.2f}%")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=120)
+    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-3)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--dense-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(epochs=args.epochs, lr=args.lr, seed=args.seed, dense_weight=args.dense_weight)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 5 — Combined Overfit: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+2) [db/culane.py](db/culane.py:416) lane-point serileştirme beklentisiyle yapı uyumunu doğrulamak

+
+
+def _is_lane_points_structure(pred) -> bool:
+    if not isinstance(pred, list):
+        return False
+    if len(pred) == 0:
+        return True
+    if not isinstance(pred[0], list):
+        return False
+    if len(pred[0]) == 0:
+        return True
+    p = pred[0][0]
+    return isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) == 2
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask", batch: int = 2, score_thresh: float = 0.5) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
+
+    model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=True)
+    post = PostProcess().to(device)
+
+    # 1) model out -> PostProcess
+    images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    outputs, _ = model._train(images, masks)
+    target_sizes = torch.tensor([[in_h, in_w]] * batch, device=device)
+
+    lanes_batch = post(outputs, target_sizes)
+
+    # 2) manual postprocess branch consistency
+    manual_batch: List[List[List[Tuple[int, int]]]] = []
+    for b in range(batch):
+        lanes = mask_to_lane_coords(
+            outputs["pred_heatmap"][b],
+            outputs["pred_offset"][b],
+            outputs["pred_vrange"][b],

 22 | def _extract_old_lanes(item: dict) -> List[List[Tuple[float, float]]]:
 23 |     old_lanes = item.get("old_anno", {}).get("lanes", [])
 24 |     lanes: List[List[Tuple[float, float]]] = []
 25 |     for lane in old_lanes:
 26 |         pts = [(float(x), float(y)) for (x, y) in lane if x >= 0 and y >= 0]
 27 |         if len(pts) >= 2:
 28 |             lanes.append(pts)
 29 |     return lanes
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | def old_anno_to_mask_batch_gt(
 33 |     items: Sequence[dict],
 34 |     feat_h: int,
 35 |     feat_w: int,
 36 |     num_lanes: int,
 37 |     img_h: int,
 38 |     img_w: int,
 39 | ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
 40 |     hm, off, vr, lbl, vm = [], [], [], [], []
 41 |     for item in items:
 42 |         lanes = _extract_old_lanes(item)
 43 |         gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
 44 |             lanes,
 45 |             img_h=img_h,
 46 |             img_w=img_w,
 47 |             feat_h=feat_h,
 48 |             feat_w=feat_w,
 49 |             num_lanes=num_lanes,
 50 |             normalized=False,
 51 |         )
 52 |         hm.append(gt["heatmap"])
 53 |         off.append(gt["offset"])
 54 |         vr.append(gt["v_range"])
 55 |         lbl.append(gt["labels"])
 56 |         vm.append(gt["valid_mask"])
 57 |     return {
 58 |         "heatmap": torch.stack(hm, dim=0),
 59 |         "offset": torch.stack(off, dim=0),
 60 |         "v_range": torch.stack(vr, dim=0),
 61 |         "labels": torch.stack(lbl, dim=0),
 62 |         "valid_mask": torch.stack(vm, dim=0),
 63 |     }
 64 | 
 65 | 
 66 | def _rowloc_from_heatmap(hm: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 67 |     # hm: (B, L, H, W) -> row-wise expected x (B, L, H)
 68 |     w = hm.shape[-1]
 69 |     cols = torch.arange(w, dtype=hm.dtype, device=hm.device)
 70 |     return (hm * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)
 71 | 
 72 | 
 73 | def _simple_match_cost(
 74 |     pred_scores: torch.Tensor,   # (B, L, 2)
 75 |     pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,  # (B, L, H, W)
 76 |     pred_vrange: torch.Tensor,   # (B, L, 2)
 77 |     gt_hm: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, H, W)
 78 |     gt_vr: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, 2)
 79 |     gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,        # (B, L)
 80 |     gt_vm: torch.Tensor,         # (B, L, H)
 81 | ) -> List[float]:
 82 |     """Current [mask_migration.bolum3_loss.py](mask_migration/bolum3_loss.py:12) cost benzeri skaler rapor."""
 83 |     bsz, lq, _h, _w = pred_heatmap.shape
 84 |     pred_x = _rowloc_from_heatmap(pred_heatmap)
 85 |     gt_x = _rowloc_from_heatmap(gt_hm)
 86 | 
 87 |     batch_costs: List[float] = []
 88 |     fg_prob = torch.softmax(pred_scores, dim=-1)[:, :, 1]  # (B, L)
 89 | 
 90 |     for b in range(bsz):
 91 |         gt_idx = torch.nonzero(gt_lbl[b] > 0, as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)
 92 |         if gt_idx.numel() == 0:
 93 |             batch_costs.append(0.0)
 94 |             continue
 95 |         csum = 0.0
 96 |         for g in gt_idx.tolist():
 97 |             valid = gt_vm[b, g]
 98 |             if bool(valid.any().item()):
 99 |                 heat_cost = torch.abs(pred_x[b, :, valid] - gt_x[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
100 |             else:
101 |                 heat_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, dtype=pred_x.dtype, device=pred_x.device)
102 |             range_cost = torch.abs(pred_vrange[b] - gt_vr[b, g].float().unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
103 |             cls_cost = 1.0 - fg_prob[b]
104 |             total_cost = cls_cost + heat_cost + 0.25 * range_cost
105 |             csum += float(total_cost.min().item())
106 |         batch_costs.append(csum / max(len(gt_idx), 1))
107 | 
108 |     return batch_costs

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 4 — Dense offset supervision analizi (izole).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Mevcut offset loss (n_idx tek örnekleme) ile dense offset loss'u karşılaştırmak
  6 | 2) Farkın sayısal büyüklüğünü raporlamak
  7 | 3) Dense loss altında gradient akışını doğrulamak
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | from typing import Dict
 12 | 
 13 | import numpy as np
 14 | import torch
 15 | 
 16 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
 17 | from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
 18 | from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
 19 | 
 20 | 
 21 | def dense_offset_loss(
 22 |     pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,  # (B,L,H,W)
 23 |     pred_offset: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
 24 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,H,W)
 25 |     gt_offset: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
 26 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor, # (B,L,H)
 27 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 28 |     """
 29 |     Row-wise dense supervision:
 30 |       valid satırlarda W boyunca |pred_offset - gt_offset|, gt_heatmap ile ağırlıklı ortalama.
 31 |     """
 32 |     diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)
 33 |     w = gt_heatmap / gt_heatmap.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
 34 |     row_loss = (diff * w).sum(dim=-1)  # (B,L,H)
 35 |     m = gt_valid_mask.float()
 36 |     return (row_loss * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
 37 | 
 38 | 
 39 | def _build_toy_gt(batch: int, lanes: int, h: int, w: int, device: torch.device):
 40 |     gt_list = []
 41 |     for b in range(batch):
 42 |         dx = 12 * b
 43 |         fake_lanes = [
 44 |             [(140 + dx, 300), (152 + dx, 250), (164 + dx, 200), (176 + dx, 150)],
 45 |             [(420 - dx, 300), (408 - dx, 250), (396 - dx, 200), (384 - dx, 150)],
 46 |         ]
 47 |         gt_list.append(lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes, img_h=360, img_w=640, feat_h=h, feat_w=w, num_lanes=lanes))
 48 | 
 49 |     gt_hm = torch.stack([g["heatmap"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
 50 |     gt_off = torch.stack([g["offset"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
 51 |     gt_vr = torch.stack([g["v_range"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
 52 |     gt_lbl = torch.stack([g["labels"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
 53 |     gt_vm = torch.stack([g["valid_mask"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
 54 |     return gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
 55 | 
 56 | 
 57 | def run(seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 58 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 59 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 60 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 61 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 62 | 
 63 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 64 | 
 65 |     b, l, c, h, w = 2, 7, 32, 10, 26
 66 |     head = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
 67 | 
 68 |     t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device, requires_grad=True)
 69 |     m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device, requires_grad=True)
 70 |     gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm = _build_toy_gt(b, l, h, w, device)
 71 | 
 72 |     pred = head(t, m)
 73 |     base_losses = compute_mask_loss(
 74 |         pred["heatmap"], pred["offset"], pred["v_range"], pred["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
 75 |     )
 76 | 
 77 |     dense_off = dense_offset_loss(pred["heatmap"], pred["offset"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vm)
 78 |     total_dense = base_losses["total"] + dense_weight * dense_off
 79 | 
 80 |     head.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 81 |     if t.grad is not None:
 82 |         t.grad.zero_()
 83 |     if m.grad is not None:
 84 |         m.grad.zero_()
 85 | 
 86 |     total_dense.backward()
 87 | 
 88 |     grad_alive = True
 89 |     for p in head.parameters():
 90 |         if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
 91 |             grad_alive = False
 92 |             break
 93 | 
 94 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
 95 |     checks["dense_loss_positive"] = float(dense_off.item()) >= 0.0
 96 |     checks["dense_changes_total"] = abs(float(total_dense.item()) - float(base_losses["total"].item())) > 1e-9
 97 |     checks["finite"] = np.isfinite(float(total_dense.item()))
 98 |     checks["gradient_alive"] = grad_alive and (t.grad is not None) and (m.grad is not None)
 99 | 
100 |     print("=" * 90)
101 |     print("BÖLÜM 4 — DENSE OFFSET ANALİZİ")
102 |     print("=" * 90)
103 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
104 |     print(f"dense_weight: {dense_weight}")
105 |     print(f"base_total : {float(base_losses['total'].item()):.6f}")
106 |     print(f"base_offset: {float(base_losses['offset_loss'].item()):.6f}")
107 |     print(f"dense_off  : {float(dense_off.item()):.6f}")
108 |     print(f"total_dense: {float(total_dense.item()):.6f}")
109 | 
110 |     print("\nKontroller:")
111 |     for k, v in checks.items():
112 |         print(f"  {k:<24}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
113 | 
114 |     return checks
115 | 
116 | 
117 | def main():
118 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
119 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
120 |     parser.add_argument("--dense-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
121 |     args = parser.parse_args()
122 | 
123 |     checks = run(seed=args.seed, dense_weight=args.dense_weight)
124 |     ok = all(checks.values())
125 | 
126 |     print("\n" + "=" * 90)
127 |     print("RAPOR")
128 |     print("=" * 90)
129 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 4 — Dense Offset: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
130 | 
131 |     if not ok:
132 |         raise SystemExit(1)
133 | 
134 | 
135 | if __name__ == "__main__":
136 |     main()

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 5 — Combined overfit smoke test (izole).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Coord-aware head + prior bias + dense offset kombinasyonunu izole ortamda doğrulamak
  6 | 2) Tek örnek üzerinde kısa overfit eğrisi üretmek
  7 | 3) Entegrasyon öncesi eğitilebilirlik riskini erken görmek
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | import math
 12 | from typing import Dict
 13 | 
 14 | import numpy as np
 15 | import torch
 16 | import torch.nn as nn
 17 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 18 | 
 19 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
 20 | from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
 21 | 
 22 | 
 23 | def inject_coord_channels(memory: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 24 |     b, _c, h, w = memory.shape
 25 |     ys = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=h, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 26 |     xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 27 |     y = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 28 |     x = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 29 |     return torch.cat([memory, y, x], dim=1)
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | class CoordHead(nn.Module):
 33 |     def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32):
 34 |         super().__init__()
 35 |         self.feat_dim = feat_dim
 36 |         kd = feat_dim + 2
 37 |         self.mlp_heat = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 38 |         self.mlp_off = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 39 |         self.mlp_vr = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 40 |         self.mlp_sc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 41 | 
 42 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
 43 |         # t: (L,B,C) or (B,L,C), m: (B,C,H,W)
 44 |         b, _c, h, w = m.shape
 45 |         if t.shape[1] == b:
 46 |             t = t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 47 |         f = inject_coord_channels(m)
 48 |         flat = f.flatten(2)
 49 |         kb = self.mlp_heat(t)
 50 |         kz = self.mlp_off(t)
 51 |         b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 52 |         z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 53 |         return {
 54 |             "heatmap": F.softmax(b_raw, dim=-1),
 55 |             "offset": z_raw,
 56 |             "v_range": self.mlp_vr(t),
 57 |             "scores": self.mlp_sc(t),
 58 |         }
 59 | 
 60 | 
 61 | def init_prior(head: CoordHead, prior_prob: float = 0.01):
 62 |     bias_value = -math.log((1.0 - prior_prob) / prior_prob)
 63 |     with torch.no_grad():
 64 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[0] = 0.0
 65 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[1] = float(bias_value)
 66 | 
 67 | 
 68 | def dense_offset_loss(pred_offset: torch.Tensor, gt_offset: torch.Tensor, gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor, gt_valid: torch.Tensor):
 69 |     diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)
 70 |     w = gt_heatmap / gt_heatmap.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
 71 |     row = (diff * w).sum(dim=-1)
 72 |     m = gt_valid.float()
 73 |     return (row * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
 74 | 
 75 | 
 76 | def run(epochs: int = 120, lr: float = 1e-3, seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 77 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 78 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 79 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 80 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 81 | 
 82 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 83 |     b, l, c, h, w = 1, 7, 32, 10, 26
 84 | 
 85 |     t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device)
 86 |     m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device)
 87 | 
 88 |     gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
 89 |         [
 90 |             [(150, 300), (160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150)],
 91 |             [(410, 300), (400, 250), (390, 200), (380, 150)],
 92 |         ],
 93 |         img_h=360,
 94 |         img_w=640,
 95 |         feat_h=h,
 96 |         feat_w=w,
 97 |         num_lanes=l,
 98 |     )
 99 | 
100 |     gt_hm = gt["heatmap"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
101 |     gt_off = gt["offset"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
102 |     gt_vr = gt["v_range"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
103 |     gt_lbl = gt["labels"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
104 |     gt_vm = gt["valid_mask"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
105 | 
106 |     head = CoordHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c).to(device)
107 |     init_prior(head, prior_prob=0.01)
108 |     optim = torch.optim.Adam(head.parameters(), lr=lr)
109 | 
110 |     hist = []
111 |     for ep in range(epochs):
112 |         optim.zero_grad()
113 |         out = head(t, m)
114 |         losses = compute_mask_loss(
115 |             out["heatmap"], out["offset"], out["v_range"], out["scores"], gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm
116 |         )
117 |         d_off = dense_offset_loss(out["offset"], gt_off, gt_hm, gt_vm)
118 |         total = losses["total"] + dense_weight * d_off
119 |         total.backward()
120 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(head.parameters(), 1.0)
121 |         optim.step()
122 |         hist.append(float(total.item()))
123 | 
124 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
125 |             print(
126 |                 f"Epoch {ep:3d}: total={float(total.item()):.4f} "
127 |                 f"base={float(losses['total'].item()):.4f} dense={float(d_off.item()):.4f}"
128 |             )
129 | 
130 |     init_loss = hist[0]
131 |     final_loss = hist[-1]
132 |     reduction = (init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-6) * 100.0
133 | 
134 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
135 |     checks["loss_finite"] = np.isfinite(init_loss) and np.isfinite(final_loss)
136 |     checks["loss_reduced"] = final_loss < init_loss
137 |     checks["reduction_over_30pct"] = reduction > 30.0
138 | 
139 |     print("=" * 90)
140 |     print("BÖLÜM 5 — COMBINED OVERFIT")
141 |     print("=" * 90)
142 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
143 |     print(f"Init loss : {init_loss:.6f}")
144 |     print(f"Final loss: {final_loss:.6f}")
145 |     print(f"Reduction : {reduction:.2f}%")
146 | 
147 |     print("\nKontroller:")
148 |     for k, v in checks.items():
149 |         print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
150 | 
151 |     return checks
152 | 
153 | 
154 | def main():
155 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
156 |     parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=120)
157 |     parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-3)
158 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
159 |     parser.add_argument("--dense-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
160 |     args = parser.parse_args()
161 | 
162 |     checks = run(epochs=args.epochs, lr=args.lr, seed=args.seed, dense_weight=args.dense_weight)
163 |     ok = all(checks.values())
164 | 
165 |     print("\n" + "=" * 90)
166 |     print("RAPOR")
167 |     print("=" * 90)
168 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 5 — Combined Overfit: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
169 |

172 | 
173 |

 24 |         return False
 25 |     if len(pred) == 0:
 26 |         return True
 27 |     if not isinstance(pred[0], list):

 35 | @torch.no_grad()
 36 | def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask", batch: int = 2, score_thresh: float = 0.5) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 37 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 38 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 39 |     in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]

 41 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=True)
 42 |     post = PostProcess().to(device)
 43 | 
 44 |     # 1) model out -> PostProcess
 45 |     images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 46 |     masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 47 |     outputs, _ = model._train(images, masks)
 48 |     target_sizes = torch.tensor([[in_h, in_w]] * batch, device=device)
 49 | 
 50 |     lanes_batch = post(outputs, target_sizes)
 51 | 
 52 |     # 2) manual postprocess branch consistency

 60 |             score_thresh=score_thresh,
 61 |             img_h=in_h,
 62 |             img_w=in_w,
 63 |         )
 64 |         manual_batch.append(lanes)
 65 | 
 66 |     # 3) db serializer compatibility check (single sample)
 67 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.test_split)
 68 |     dummy_runtime = 0.01
 69 |     serial_ok = False
 70 |     try:
 71 |         _ = db.pred2culaneformat(0, lanes_batch[0], dummy_runtime, system_configs.result_dir)
 72 |         serial_ok = True
 73 |     except Exception:
 74 |         serial_ok = False

 79 |     checks["lane_points_structure"] = _is_lane_points_structure(lanes_batch)
 80 |     checks["manual_post_structure"] = _is_lane_points_structure(manual_batch)
 81 |     checks["serializer_accepts_lane_points"] = serial_ok

 84 |     checks["manual_vs_post_batch_size"] = len(manual_batch) == len(lanes_batch)

 96 |     if len(manual_batch) > 0:

 98 | 
 99 |     print("\nKontroller:")
100 |     for k, v in checks.items():
101 |         print(f"  {k:<32}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
102 | 
103 |     return checks

108 |     parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask")
109 |     parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
110 |     parser.add_argument("--score-thresh", type=float, default=0.5)

+def _t_to_blc(t: torch.Tensor, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:

+        raise ValueError(f"T must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
+    if t.shape[1] == batch:  # (L,B,C)
+        return t.permute(1, 0, 2)
+    if t.shape[0] == batch:  # (B,L,C)
+        return t
+    raise ValueError(f"Cannot infer batch dim from T={tuple(t.shape)} and batch={batch}")

+@torch.no_grad()
+def copy_baseline_to_coord(baseline: DynamicMaskHead, coord: CoordHead):
+    fd = coord.feat_dim
+
+    # heat
+    coord.mlp_heat[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].weight)
+    coord.mlp_heat[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].bias)
+    coord.mlp_heat[2].weight.zero_()
+    coord.mlp_heat[2].bias.zero_()
+    coord.mlp_heat[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].weight)
+    coord.mlp_heat[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].bias)
+
+    # offset
+    coord.mlp_off[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].weight)
+    coord.mlp_off[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].bias)
+    coord.mlp_off[2].weight.zero_()
+    coord.mlp_off[2].bias.zero_()
+    coord.mlp_off[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].weight)
+    coord.mlp_off[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].bias)
+
+    coord.mlp_vr.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_vrange.state_dict())
+    coord.mlp_sc.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_score.state_dict())

+def _train_stage(
+    stage_name: str,
+    model: nn.Module,
+    t: torch.Tensor,
+    m: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_hm: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_off: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_vr: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_vm: torch.Tensor,
+    epochs: int,
+    lr: float,
+    dense_weight: float = 0.0,
+):
+    optim = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
+    hist = []
+
+    for ep in range(epochs):
+        optim.zero_grad()
+        out = model(t, m)
+        losses = compute_mask_loss(
+            out["heatmap"],
+            out["offset"],
+            out["v_range"],
+            out["scores"],
+            gt_hm,
+            gt_off,
+            gt_vr,
+            gt_lbl,
+            gt_vm,
+        )
+
+        dense = out["offset"].new_zeros(())
+        total = losses["total"]
+        if dense_weight > 0.0:
+            dense = dense_offset_loss_strong(
+                pred_offset=out["offset"],
+                gt_offset=gt_off,
+                gt_valid_mask=gt_vm,
+                pred_heatmap=out["heatmap"],
+                gt_heatmap=gt_hm,
+                weak_mix=0.25,
+            )
+            total = total + dense_weight * dense
+
+        total.backward()
+        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
+        optim.step()
+
+        hist.append(float(total.item()))
+        if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
+            print(
+                f"[{stage_name}] Epoch {ep:3d}: total={float(total.item()):.4f} "
+                f"base={float(losses['total'].item()):.4f} dense={float(dense.item()):.4f}"
+            )
+
+    init_loss = hist[0]
+    final_loss = hist[-1]
+    reduction = (init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-6) * 100.0
+    return {
+        "stage": stage_name,
+        "init": init_loss,
+        "final": final_loss,
+        "reduction": reduction,
+    }

+def _is_point(p) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(p, np.ndarray):
+        return p.ndim == 1 and p.shape[0] == 2
+    return isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) == 2
+
+
+def _is_lane(lane) -> bool:
+    # lane: list/tuple/ndarray of points
+    if isinstance(lane, np.ndarray):
+        if lane.ndim != 2 or lane.shape[1] != 2:
+            return False
+        return True
+    if not isinstance(lane, (list, tuple)):
+        return False
+    if len(lane) == 0:
+        return True
+    return all(_is_point(p) for p in lane)
+
+
+def _is_batch_lane_points_structure(batch_pred) -> bool:
+    """
+    Beklenen yapı: batch -> lane -> point(x,y)
+    - batch_pred: list[B]
+    - batch_pred[b]: list[lane]
+    - lane: list[(x,y)] or ndarray[N,2]
+    """
+    if not isinstance(batch_pred, list):
+        return False
+    if len(batch_pred) == 0:
+        return True
+
+    for lanes in batch_pred:
+        if not isinstance(lanes, (list, tuple)):
+            return False
+        for lane in lanes:
+            if not _is_lane(lane):
+                return False
+    return True

 32 |     xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 33 |     y = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 34 |     x = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 35 |     return torch.cat([memory, y, x], dim=1)

 38 | class CoordHead(nn.Module):
 39 |     def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32):
 40 |         super().__init__()
 41 |         self.feat_dim = feat_dim
 42 |         kd = feat_dim + 2
 43 |         self.mlp_heat = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 44 |         self.mlp_off = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 45 |         self.mlp_vr = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 46 |         self.mlp_sc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 47 | 
 48 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
 49 |         # t: (L,B,C) or (B,L,C), m: (B,C,H,W)
 50 |         b, _c, h, w = m.shape
 51 |         if t.shape[1] == b:
 52 |             t = t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 53 |         f = inject_coord_channels(m)
 54 |         flat = f.flatten(2)
 55 |         kb = self.mlp_heat(t)
 56 |         kz = self.mlp_off(t)
 57 |         b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 58 |         z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 59 |         return {
 60 |             "heatmap": F.softmax(b_raw, dim=-1),
 61 |             "offset": z_raw,
 62 |             "v_range": self.mlp_vr(t),
 63 |             "scores": self.mlp_sc(t),
 64 |         }
 65 | 
 66 | 
 67 | def _t_to_blc(t: torch.Tensor, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:
 68 |     if t.dim() != 3:
 69 |         raise ValueError(f"T must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
 70 |     if t.shape[1] == batch:  # (L,B,C)
 71 |         return t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 72 |     if t.shape[0] == batch:  # (B,L,C)
 73 |         return t
 74 |     raise ValueError(f"Cannot infer batch dim from T={tuple(t.shape)} and batch={batch}")
 75 |

 77 | @torch.no_grad()
 78 | def copy_baseline_to_coord(baseline: DynamicMaskHead, coord: CoordHead):
 79 |     fd = coord.feat_dim
 80 | 
 81 |     # heat
 82 |     coord.mlp_heat[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].weight)
 83 |     coord.mlp_heat[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].bias)
 84 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].weight.zero_()
 85 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].bias.zero_()
 86 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].weight)
 87 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].bias)
 88 | 
 89 |     # offset
 90 |     coord.mlp_off[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].weight)
 91 |     coord.mlp_off[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].bias)
 92 |     coord.mlp_off[2].weight.zero_()
 93 |     coord.mlp_off[2].bias.zero_()
 94 |     coord.mlp_off[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].weight)
 95 |     coord.mlp_off[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].bias)
 96 | 
 97 |     coord.mlp_vr.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_vrange.state_dict())
 98 |     coord.mlp_sc.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_score.state_dict())

101 | class BaselineHeadAdapter(nn.Module):
102 |     """[mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head.DynamicMaskHead](mask_migration/bolum2_mask_head.py:11) için ortak arayüz."""
103 | 
104 |     def __init__(self, head: DynamicMaskHead):
105 |         super().__init__()
106 |         self.head = head
107 | 
108 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
109 |         out = self.head(t, m)
110 |         return {
111 |             "heatmap": out["heatmap"],
112 |             "offset": out["offset"],
113 |             "v_range": out["v_range"],
114 |             "scores": out["scores"],
115 |         }

118 | def init_prior(head: CoordHead, prior_prob: float = 0.01):
119 |     bias_value = -math.log((1.0 - prior_prob) / prior_prob)
120 |     with torch.no_grad():
121 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[0] = 0.0
122 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[1] = float(bias_value)
123 | 
124 | 
125 | def _train_stage(
126 |     stage_name: str,
127 |     model: nn.Module,
128 |     t: torch.Tensor,
129 |     m: torch.Tensor,
130 |     gt_hm: torch.Tensor,
131 |     gt_off: torch.Tensor,
132 |     gt_vr: torch.Tensor,
133 |     gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,
134 |     gt_vm: torch.Tensor,
135 |     epochs: int,
136 |     lr: float,
137 |     dense_weight: float = 0.0,
138 | ):
139 |     optim = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
140 |     hist = []
141 | 
142 |     for ep in range(epochs):
143 |         optim.zero_grad()
144 |         out = model(t, m)
145 |         losses = compute_mask_loss(
146 |             out["heatmap"],
147 |             out["offset"],
148 |             out["v_range"],
149 |             out["scores"],
150 |             gt_hm,
151 |             gt_off,
152 |             gt_vr,
153 |             gt_lbl,
154 |             gt_vm,
155 |         )
156 | 
157 |         dense = out["offset"].new_zeros(())
158 |         total = losses["total"]
159 |         if dense_weight > 0.0:
160 |             dense = dense_offset_loss_strong(
161 |                 pred_offset=out["offset"],
162 |                 gt_offset=gt_off,
163 |                 gt_valid_mask=gt_vm,
164 |                 pred_heatmap=out["heatmap"],
165 |                 gt_heatmap=gt_hm,
166 |                 weak_mix=0.25,
167 |             )
168 |             total = total + dense_weight * dense
169 | 
170 |         total.backward()
171 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
172 |         optim.step()
173 | 
174 |         hist.append(float(total.item()))
175 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
176 |             print(
177 |                 f"[{stage_name}] Epoch {ep:3d}: total={float(total.item()):.4f} "
178 |                 f"base={float(losses['total'].item()):.4f} dense={float(dense.item()):.4f}"
179 |             )
180 | 
181 |     init_loss = hist[0]
182 |     final_loss = hist[-1]
183 |     reduction = (init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-6) * 100.0
184 |     return {
185 |         "stage": stage_name,
186 |         "init": init_loss,
187 |         "final": final_loss,
188 |         "reduction": reduction,
189 |     }

193 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
194 |     np.random.seed(seed)

226 |     # A) baseline

228 |     head_a.load_state_dict(baseline_template.state_dict(), strict=True)
229 |     stage_a = _train_stage(

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 4 — Dense offset supervision analizi (izole).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Mevcut offset loss (n_idx tek örnekleme) ile dense offset loss'u karşılaştırmak
  6 | 2) Farkın sayısal büyüklüğünü raporlamak
  7 | 3) Dense loss altında gradient akışını doğrulamak
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | from typing import Dict, Optional
 12 | 
 13 | import numpy as np
 14 | import torch
 15 | 
 16 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
 17 | from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
 18 | from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
 19 | 
 20 | 
 21 | def dense_offset_loss_weak(
 22 |     pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,  # (B,L,H,W)
 23 |     pred_offset: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
 24 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,H,W)
 25 |     gt_offset: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
 26 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor, # (B,L,H)
 27 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 28 |     """
 29 |     Row-wise dense supervision:
 30 |       valid satırlarda W boyunca |pred_offset - gt_offset|, gt_heatmap ile ağırlıklı ortalama.
 31 |     """
 32 |     diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)
 33 |     w = gt_heatmap / gt_heatmap.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
 34 |     row_loss = (diff * w).sum(dim=-1)  # (B,L,H)
 35 |     m = gt_valid_mask.float()
 36 |     return (row_loss * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
 37 | 
 38 | 
 39 | def dense_offset_loss_strong(
 40 |     pred_offset: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
 41 |     gt_offset: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
 42 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor, # (B,L,H)
 43 |     pred_heatmap: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
 44 |     gt_heatmap: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
 45 |     weak_mix: float = 0.25,
 46 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 47 |     """
 48 |     Daha güçlü dense sinyal:
 49 |       1) valid satırlarda tüm W boyunca L1 (full-row supervision)
 50 |       2) opsiyonel zayıf merkez-odaklı terim ile karışım
 51 | 
 52 |     Not:
 53 |       - full-row terimi, merkezde offset≈0 olmasından kaynaklı sinyal zayıflamasını azaltır.
 54 |     """
 55 |     diff = torch.abs(pred_offset - gt_offset)  # (B,L,H,W)
 56 |     m = gt_valid_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1)    # (B,L,H,1)
 57 | 
 58 |     full_row = (diff * m).sum() / m.sum().clamp(min=1.0) / pred_offset.shape[-1]
 59 | 
 60 |     if (
 61 |         pred_heatmap is not None
 62 |         and gt_heatmap is not None
 63 |         and weak_mix > 0.0
 64 |     ):
 65 |         weak = dense_offset_loss_weak(
 66 |             pred_heatmap=pred_heatmap,
 67 |             pred_offset=pred_offset,
 68 |             gt_heatmap=gt_heatmap,
 69 |             gt_offset=gt_offset,
 70 |             gt_valid_mask=gt_valid_mask,
 71 |         )
 72 |         return full_row + weak_mix * weak
 73 | 
 74 |     return full_row
 75 | 
 76 | 
 77 | # Geri uyumluluk: önceki isim güçlü sürüme yönlensin.
 78 | def dense_offset_loss(
 79 |     pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,
 80 |     pred_offset: torch.Tensor,
 81 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,
 82 |     gt_offset: torch.Tensor,
 83 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
 84 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 85 |     return dense_offset_loss_strong(
 86 |         pred_offset=pred_offset,
 87 |         gt_offset=gt_offset,
 88 |         gt_valid_mask=gt_valid_mask,
 89 |         pred_heatmap=pred_heatmap,
 90 |         gt_heatmap=gt_heatmap,
 91 |     )

 94 | def _build_toy_gt(batch: int, lanes: int, h: int, w: int, device: torch.device):
 95 |     gt_list = []
 96 |     for b in range(batch):
 97 |         dx = 12 * b
 98 |         fake_lanes = [
 99 |             [(140 + dx, 300), (152 + dx, 250), (164 + dx, 200), (176 + dx, 150)],
100 |             [(420 - dx, 300), (408 - dx, 250), (396 - dx, 200), (384 - dx, 150)],
101 |         ]
102 |         gt_list.append(lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes, img_h=360, img_w=640, feat_h=h, feat_w=w, num_lanes=lanes))
103 | 
104 |     gt_hm = torch.stack([g["heatmap"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
105 |     gt_off = torch.stack([g["offset"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
106 |     gt_vr = torch.stack([g["v_range"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
107 |     gt_lbl = torch.stack([g["labels"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
108 |     gt_vm = torch.stack([g["valid_mask"] for g in gt_list]).to(device)
109 |     return gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm

112 | def run(seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
113 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
114 |     np.random.seed(seed)
115 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
116 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
117 | 
118 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
119 | 
120 |     b, l, c, h, w = 2, 7, 32, 10, 26
121 |     head = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)

123 |     t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device, requires_grad=True)
124 |     m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device, requires_grad=True)
125 |     gt_hm, gt_off, gt_vr, gt_lbl, gt_vm = _build_toy_gt(b, l, h, w, device)
126 | 
127 |     pred = head(t, m)

 23 | def _is_point(p) -> bool:
 24 |     if isinstance(p, np.ndarray):

 29 | def _is_lane(lane) -> bool:
 30 |     # lane: list/tuple/ndarray of points
 31 |     if isinstance(lane, np.ndarray):
 32 |         if lane.ndim != 2 or lane.shape[1] != 2:
 33 |             return False
 34 |         return True

 37 |     if len(lane) == 0:

 45 |     - batch_pred: list[B]

 47 |     - lane: list[(x,y)] or ndarray[N,2]
 48 |     """

253 | 
254 |         required = ["pred_heatmap", "pred_offset", "pred_vrange", "pred_scores"]
255 |         missing = [k for k in required if k not in outputs]

258 |

263 |

267 |         # targets format from sampler: [images, gt_lane_0, ..., gt_lane_{B-1}]
268 |         gt_label_tensors = [tgt[0] for tgt in targets[1:]]
269 |         if len(gt_label_tensors) < B:

280 | 
281 |         mask_losses = compute_mask_loss(

 15 | 
 16 |     def __init__(self,
 17 |                  num_layers,
 18 |                  in_channels,
 19 |                  channels,
 20 |                  mask_out_stride,
 21 |                  weight_nums,
 22 |                  bias_nums,
 23 |                  disable_coords=False,
 24 |                  out_channels=1):
 25 |         super(DynamicMaskHead, self).__init__()
 26 |         self.num_layers = num_layers
 27 |         self.in_channels = in_channels
 28 |         self.channels = channels
 29 |         self.mask_out_stride = mask_out_stride
 30 |         self.disable_coords = disable_coords
 31 |         self.weight_nums = weight_nums

 36 |     def forward(self, x, mask_head_params, is_mask=True):
 37 |         N, _, H, W = x.size()
 38 |         if not self.disable_coords:
 39 |             locations = compute_locations(x.size(2), x.size(3), stride=1, device=x.device)
 40 |             locations = locations.unsqueeze(0).permute(0, 2, 1).contiguous().float().view(1, 2, H, W)
 41 |             locations[:, 0, :, :] /= H
 42 |             locations[:, 1, :, :] /= W
 43 |             locations = locations.repeat(N, 1, 1, 1)
 44 |             x = torch.cat([locations, x], dim=1)
 45 | 
 46 |         weights, biases = self.parse_dynamic_params(mask_head_params, mask=is_mask)

 50 |     def parse_dynamic_params(self, params, mask=True):
 51 |         assert params.dim() == 3
 52 |         assert len(self.weight_nums) == len(self.bias_nums)
 53 |         assert params.size(2) == sum(self.weight_nums) + sum(self.bias_nums)
 54 | 
 55 |         batch_size, num_ins = params.shape[:2]
 56 |         num_layers = len(self.weight_nums)
 57 |         params_list = list(params.split(self.weight_nums + self.bias_nums, dim=2))
 58 | 
 59 |         assert num_layers == 1, "If num_layers > 1, you cannot use this accelerated form of dynamic conv!"
 60 | 
 61 |         weight_list = params_list[:num_layers]                                                        # [(N, L, C)] * M

 95 | class MLP(nn.Module):
 96 |     """ Very simple multi-layer perceptron (also called FFN)"""
 97 | 
 98 |     def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, output_dim, num_layers):
 99 |         super().__init__()
100 |         self.num_layers = num_layers
101 |         h = [hidden_dim] * (num_layers - 1)
102 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
103 |             nn.Linear(n, k)
104 |             for n, k in zip([input_dim] + h, h + [output_dim]))

112 | class CtnetHead(nn.Module):
113 |     def __init__(self, heads, in_channels, head_channels=256):
114 |         super(CtnetHead, self).__init__()
115 | 
116 |         self.heads = heads
117 |         for head in self.heads:
118 |             classes = self.heads[head]
119 |             if head_channels > 0:
120 |                 fc = nn.Sequential(
121 |                     nn.Linear(in_channels, head_channels, bias=True),
122 |                     nn.ReLU(inplace=False),
123 |                     nn.Linear(head_channels, classes, bias=True))
124 |                 if 'logits' in head:
125 |                     fc[-1].bias.data.fill_(bias_value)
126 |                 else:
127 |                     self.fill_fc_weights(fc)
128 |             else:
129 |                 fc = nn.Linear(in_channels, classes, bias=True)
130 |                 if 'logits' in head:
131 |                     fc.bias.data.fill_(bias_value)
132 |                 else:
133 |                     self.fill_fc_weights(fc)
134 |             self.__setattr__(head, fc)
135 | 
136 |     @staticmethod
137 |     def fill_fc_weights(layers):
138 |         for m in layers.modules():
139 |             if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
140 |                 if m.bias is not None:
141 |                     nn.init.constant_(m.bias, 0)

149 |         return z

 10 | class SetCriterion(nn.Module):
 11 |     """ This class computes the loss for DETR.
 12 |     The process happens in two steps:
 13 |         1) we compute hungarian assignment between ground truth boxes and the outputs of the model
 14 |         2) we supervise each pair of matched ground-truth / prediction (supervise class and box)
 15 |     """
 16 |     def __init__(self, matcher, eos_coef=1., obj_weight=1., cls_weight=1., loc_weight=1.,
 17 |                  reg_weight=1., rng_weight=1., line_width=15):
 18 |         """ Create the criterion.
 19 |         Parameters:
 20 |             num_classes: number of object categories, omitting the special no-object category
 21 |             eos_coef: relative classification weight applied to the no-object category
 22 |             matcher: module able to compute a matching between targets and proposals
 23 |         """
 24 |         super().__init__()
 25 |         self.matcher    = matcher
 26 |         self.eos_coef   = eos_coef
 27 |         self.obj_weight = obj_weight
 28 |         self.cls_weight = cls_weight
 29 |         self.loc_weight = loc_weight
 30 |         self.reg_weight = reg_weight
 31 |         self.rng_weight = rng_weight
 32 |         self.line_width = line_width
 33 | 
 34 |         empty_weight = torch.ones(2)
 35 |         empty_weight[-1] = self.eos_coef
 36 |         self.register_buffer('empty_weight', empty_weight)
