  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 1b — Coord-aware head analizi (izole).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Coord injection destekli başlık (head) varyantını bağımsız test etmek
  6 | 2) Sıfır coord-kernel ile baseline ile birebir uyum göstermek
  7 | 3) Coord-kernel etkinleştirildiğinde çıktının değiştiğini doğrulamak
  8 | 4) Gradient akışını kontrol etmek
  9 | """
 10 | 
 11 | import argparse
 12 | from typing import Dict
 13 | 
 14 | import torch
 15 | import torch.nn as nn
 16 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 17 | 
 18 | from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
 19 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, forward_to_decoder, load_system_config
 20 | 
 21 | 
 22 | def inject_coord_channels(memory: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 23 |     if memory.dim() != 4:
 24 |         raise ValueError(f"memory must be 4D (B,C,H,W), got {tuple(memory.shape)}")
 25 |     bsz, _c, h, w = memory.shape
 26 |     ys = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=h, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 27 |     xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 28 |     y_plane = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(bsz, 1, h, w)
 29 |     x_plane = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(bsz, 1, h, w)
 30 |     return torch.cat([memory, y_plane, x_plane], dim=1)
 31 | 
 32 | 
 33 | class DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords(nn.Module):
 34 |     """
 35 |     T:       (L, B, C) or (B, L, C)
 36 |     M_prime: (B, C, H, W)
 37 |     """
 38 | 
 39 |     def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32, use_coords: bool = True):
 40 |         super().__init__()
 41 |         self.num_queries = num_queries
 42 |         self.feat_dim = feat_dim
 43 |         self.use_coords = use_coords
 44 |         self.kernel_dim = feat_dim + (2 if use_coords else 0)
 45 | 
 46 |         self.mlp_heatmap = nn.Sequential(
 47 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
 48 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
 49 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, self.kernel_dim),
 50 |         )
 51 |         self.mlp_offset = nn.Sequential(
 52 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim),
 53 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
 54 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, self.kernel_dim),
 55 |         )
 56 |         self.mlp_vrange = nn.Sequential(
 57 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
 58 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
 59 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2),
 60 |         )
 61 |         self.mlp_score = nn.Sequential(
 62 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
 63 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
 64 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2),
 65 |         )
 66 | 
 67 |     @staticmethod
 68 |     def _to_blc(t: torch.Tensor, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:
 69 |         if t.dim() != 3:
 70 |             raise ValueError(f"T must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
 71 |         if t.shape[1] == batch:  # (L,B,C)
 72 |             return t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 73 |         if t.shape[0] == batch:  # (B,L,C)
 74 |             return t
 75 |         raise ValueError(f"Cannot infer batch dim from T={tuple(t.shape)} and batch={batch}")
 76 | 
 77 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m_prime: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
 78 |         if m_prime.dim() != 4:
 79 |             raise ValueError(f"M_prime must be 4D, got {tuple(m_prime.shape)}")
 80 | 
 81 |         bsz, channels, h, w = m_prime.shape
 82 |         if channels != self.feat_dim:
 83 |             raise ValueError(f"M_prime channels={channels}, expected feat_dim={self.feat_dim}")
 84 | 
 85 |         t_blc = self._to_blc(t, bsz)
 86 |         feats = inject_coord_channels(m_prime) if self.use_coords else m_prime
 87 | 
 88 |         m_flat = feats.flatten(2)  # (B, C(+2), HW)
 89 |         kb = self.mlp_heatmap(t_blc)  # (B, L, C(+2))
 90 |         kz = self.mlp_offset(t_blc)   # (B, L, C(+2))
 91 | 
 92 |         b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, m_flat)
 93 |         z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, m_flat)
 94 | 
 95 |         b_spatial = b_raw.view(bsz, t_blc.shape[1], h, w)
 96 |         z_spatial = z_raw.view(bsz, t_blc.shape[1], h, w)
 97 | 
 98 |         heatmap = F.softmax(b_spatial, dim=-1)
 99 |         v_range = self.mlp_vrange(t_blc)
100 |         scores = self.mlp_score(t_blc)
101 | 
102 |         return {
103 |             "heatmap": heatmap,
104 |             "offset": z_spatial,
105 |             "v_range": v_range,
106 |             "scores": scores,
107 |         }
108 | 
109 | 
110 | @torch.no_grad()
111 | def copy_from_baseline(baseline: DynamicMaskHead, coord_head: DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords) -> None:
112 |     """Baseline ağırlıklarını coord-head'e taşır, extra coord kernel satırlarını 0 başlatır."""
113 | 
114 |     def _copy_kernel_mlp(src: nn.Sequential, dst: nn.Sequential, feat_dim: int) -> None:
115 |         dst[0].weight.copy_(src[0].weight)
116 |         dst[0].bias.copy_(src[0].bias)
117 |         dst[2].weight.zero_()
118 |         dst[2].bias.zero_()
119 |         dst[2].weight[:feat_dim].copy_(src[2].weight)
120 |         dst[2].bias[:feat_dim].copy_(src[2].bias)
121 | 
122 |     _copy_kernel_mlp(baseline.mlp_heatmap, coord_head.mlp_heatmap, coord_head.feat_dim)
123 |     _copy_kernel_mlp(baseline.mlp_offset, coord_head.mlp_offset, coord_head.feat_dim)
124 | 
125 |     coord_head.mlp_vrange.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_vrange.state_dict())
126 |     coord_head.mlp_score.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_score.state_dict())
127 | 
128 | 
129 | @torch.no_grad()
130 | def enable_coord_effect(coord_head: DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords, scale: float = 5e-2) -> None:
131 |     """Extra coord kernel satırlarını sıfırdan çıkararak coord etkisini görünür yapar."""
132 |     fd = coord_head.feat_dim
133 | 
134 |     # heatmap kernel (y ve x coord satırları)
135 |     coord_head.mlp_heatmap[2].weight[fd + 0].fill_(+scale)
136 |     coord_head.mlp_heatmap[2].weight[fd + 1].fill_(-scale)
137 | 
138 |     # offset kernel
139 |     coord_head.mlp_offset[2].weight[fd + 0].fill_(-scale)
140 |     coord_head.mlp_offset[2].weight[fd + 1].fill_(+scale)
141 | 
142 | 
143 | def _max_diff(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
144 |     return float((a - b).abs().max().item())
145 | 
146 | 
147 | def _mean_diff(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
148 |     return float((a - b).abs().mean().item())
149 | 
150 | 
151 | def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask", batch: int = 2, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
152 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
153 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
154 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
155 | 
156 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
157 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
158 |     in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
159 | 
160 |     net = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=True)
161 | 
162 |     images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
163 |     masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
164 | 
165 |     with torch.no_grad():
166 |         hs, memory, _ = forward_to_decoder(net, images, masks)
167 |         t_blc = hs[-1]  # (B, L, C)
168 | 
169 |     bsz, c, h, w = memory.shape
170 |     lq = t_blc.shape[1]
171 | 
172 |     baseline_head = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=lq, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
173 |     baseline_head.load_state_dict(net.mask_head.state_dict(), strict=True)
174 |     baseline_head.eval()
175 | 
176 |     coord_head = DynamicMaskHeadWithCoords(num_queries=lq, feat_dim=c, use_coords=True).to(device)
177 |     coord_head.eval()
178 |     copy_from_baseline(baseline_head, coord_head)
179 | 
180 |     with torch.no_grad():
181 |         out_base = baseline_head(t_blc, memory)
182 |         out_coord_zero = coord_head(t_blc, memory)
183 | 
184 |     zero_diffs = {
185 |         "heatmap": _max_diff(out_base["heatmap"], out_coord_zero["heatmap"]),
186 |         "offset": _max_diff(out_base["offset"], out_coord_zero["offset"]),
187 |         "v_range": _max_diff(out_base["v_range"], out_coord_zero["v_range"]),
188 |         "scores": _max_diff(out_base["scores"], out_coord_zero["scores"]),
189 |     }
190 | 
191 |     enable_coord_effect(coord_head, scale=5e-2)
192 |     with torch.no_grad():
193 |         out_coord_on = coord_head(t_blc, memory)
194 | 
195 |     effect_diffs = {
196 |         "heatmap": _mean_diff(out_coord_zero["heatmap"], out_coord_on["heatmap"]),
197 |         "offset": _mean_diff(out_coord_zero["offset"], out_coord_on["offset"]),
198 |     }
199 | 
200 |     # Gradient testi
201 |     coord_head.train()
202 |     t2 = t_blc.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
203 |     m2 = memory.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
204 |     out_grad = coord_head(t2, m2)
205 |     grad_loss = (
206 |         out_grad["heatmap"].sum()
207 |         + out_grad["offset"].sum()
208 |         + out_grad["v_range"].sum()
209 |         + out_grad["scores"].sum()
210 |     )
211 |     grad_loss.backward()
212 | 
213 |     grad_ok = True
214 |     for p in coord_head.parameters():
215 |         if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
216 |             grad_ok = False
217 |             break
218 | 
219 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
220 |     checks["shape_ok"] = tuple(out_coord_on["heatmap"].shape) == (bsz, lq, h, w)
221 |     checks["finite_outputs"] = all(
222 |         bool(torch.isfinite(v).all().item())
223 |         for v in [
224 |             out_coord_on["heatmap"],
225 |             out_coord_on["offset"],
226 |             out_coord_on["v_range"],
227 |             out_coord_on["scores"],
228 |         ]
229 |     )
230 |     checks["zero_coord_matches_baseline"] = max(zero_diffs.values()) < 1e-6
231 |     checks["coords_change_output"] = (effect_diffs["heatmap"] > 1e-8) or (effect_diffs["offset"] > 1e-8)
232 |     checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (t2.grad is not None) and (m2.grad is not None)
233 | 
234 |     print("=" * 90)
235 |     print("BÖLÜM 1b — HEAD WITH COORDS")
236 |     print("=" * 90)
237 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
238 |     print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
239 |     print(f"T shape: {tuple(t_blc.shape)}")
240 |     print(f"M_prime shape: {tuple(memory.shape)}")
241 |     print(f"Output shape: {tuple(out_coord_on['heatmap'].shape)}")
242 | 
243 |     print("\nZero-coord compatibility max |diff|:")
244 |     for k, v in zero_diffs.items():
245 |         print(f"  {k:<8}: {v:.3e}")
246 | 
247 |     print("\nCoord effect mean |diff| (after enabling coord kernels):")
248 |     for k, v in effect_diffs.items():
249 |         print(f"  {k:<8}: {v:.3e}")
250 | 
251 |     print("\nKontroller:")
252 |     for k, v in checks.items():
253 |         print(f"  {k:<30}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
254 | 
255 |     return checks
256 |

259 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
260 |     parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask")
261 |     parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
262 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
263 |     args = parser.parse_args()
264 | 
265 |     checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed)
266 |     ok = all(checks.values())
267 |

+"""
+BÖLÜM 1 — RegHead izole test.
+
+Yeni başlık:
+  T:   (B, L, C)
+  reg: (B, L, H)
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+
+class RegHead(nn.Module):
+    """
+    Query tabanlı satır-residual başlığı.
+
+    Girdi:
+      t_blc: (B, L, C)
+    Çıktı:
+      reg:   (B, L, H), normalize residual in [-1, 1]
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, feat_dim: int = 32, feat_h: int = 10, num_queries: int = 7):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.feat_dim = feat_dim
+        self.feat_h = feat_h
+        self.num_queries = num_queries
+
+        self.mlp_reg = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, feat_h),
+            nn.Tanh(),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, t_blc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if t_blc.dim() != 3:
+            raise ValueError(f"t_blc must be 3D, got {tuple(t_blc.shape)}")
+        bsz, lanes, channels = t_blc.shape
+        if lanes != self.num_queries:
+            raise ValueError(f"lane dim={lanes}, expected num_queries={self.num_queries}")
+        if channels != self.feat_dim:
+            raise ValueError(f"channel dim={channels}, expected feat_dim={self.feat_dim}")
+        return self.mlp_reg(t_blc)
+
+
+def run(batch: int = 2, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32, feat_h: int = 10, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    head = RegHead(feat_dim=feat_dim, feat_h=feat_h, num_queries=num_queries).to(device)
+
+    t = torch.randn(batch, num_queries, feat_dim, requires_grad=True, device=device)
+    out = head(t)
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["shape"] = tuple(out.shape) == (batch, num_queries, feat_h)
+    checks["range"] = float(out.min().item()) >= -1.000001 and float(out.max().item()) <= 1.000001
+    checks["finite"] = bool(torch.isfinite(out).all().item())
+
+    loss = out.sum()
+    loss.backward()
+    grad_params_ok = True
+    for p in head.parameters():
+        if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
+            grad_params_ok = False
+            break
+    checks["grad_params"] = grad_params_ok
+    checks["grad_input"] = t.grad is not None and float(t.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    t2 = torch.randn_like(t)
+    out2 = head(t2)
+    checks["sensitive_to_input"] = float((out - out2).abs().mean().item()) > 1e-6
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 1 — REGHEAD İZOLE TEST")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Input T: {tuple(t.shape)}")
+    print(f"Output reg: {tuple(out.shape)}")
+    print(f"Range: [{float(out.min().item()):.4f}, {float(out.max().item()):.4f}]")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-queries", type=int, default=7)
+    parser.add_argument("--feat-dim", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--feat-h", type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(
+        batch=args.batch,
+        num_queries=args.num_queries,
+        feat_dim=args.feat_dim,
+        feat_h=args.feat_h,
+        seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 1 — RegHead izole: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+BÖLÜM 2 — GT residual-reg üretimi.
+
+Hedef:
+  gt_reg[lane, row] = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / feat_w
+
+Burada:
+  - gt_x_coarse: gt heatmap weighted-argmax (sürekli)
+  - gt_x_true  : tercihen gt_offset map'ten türetilen x (varsa)
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from config import system_configs
+from db.culane import CULANE
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import labels_to_mask_batch_gt, lanes_to_mask_gt
+from mask_migration.common import load_system_config
+
+
+def compute_gt_reg(
+    gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,     # (L,H,W)
+    gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,  # (L,H)
+    feat_w: int,
+    gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # (L,H,W), optional
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if gt_heatmap.dim() != 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"gt_heatmap must be (L,H,W), got {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}")
+    if gt_valid_mask.dim() != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"gt_valid_mask must be (L,H), got {tuple(gt_valid_mask.shape)}")
+
+    lanes, h, w = gt_heatmap.shape
+    if w != feat_w:
+        raise ValueError(f"feat_w mismatch: heatmap W={w}, feat_w={feat_w}")
+
+    cols = torch.arange(w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
+    gt_x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)  # (L,H)
+
+    if gt_offset is not None:
+        if gt_offset.dim() != 3 or gt_offset.shape != gt_heatmap.shape:
+            raise ValueError(f"gt_offset shape must be {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}, got {tuple(gt_offset.shape)}")
+        # gt_offset[l,r,c] = gt_x_true - c -> c=0'dan gt_x_true alınabilir.
+        gt_x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
+    else:
+        gt_x_true = gt_x_coarse
+
+    reg = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / float(max(feat_w, 1))
+    reg = reg * gt_valid_mask.float()
+    return reg
+
+
+def _round_trip_error(
+    gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_reg: torch.Tensor,
+    gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    feat_w: int,
+    gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> float:
+    cols = torch.arange(feat_w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
+    x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, feat_w)).sum(dim=-1)
+    x_recovered = x_coarse + gt_reg * feat_w
+
+    if gt_offset is not None:
+        x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
+    else:
+        x_true = x_coarse
+
+    valid = gt_valid_mask.bool()
+    if not bool(valid.any().item()):
+        return 0.0
+    return float(torch.abs(x_recovered[valid] - x_true[valid]).mean().item())
+
+
+def run_synthetic(feat_h: int = 10, feat_w: int = 26, num_lanes: int = 7) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    fake_lanes = [[(150, 250), (160, 200), (170, 150)], [(400, 250), (410, 200), (420, 150)]]
+    gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
+        fake_lanes,
+        img_h=295,
+        img_w=820,
+        feat_h=feat_h,
+        feat_w=feat_w,
+        num_lanes=num_lanes,
+    )
+
+    gt_reg = compute_gt_reg(
+        gt_heatmap=gt["heatmap"],
+        gt_valid_mask=gt["valid_mask"],
+        feat_w=feat_w,
+        gt_offset=gt["offset"],
+    )
+    err = _round_trip_error(
+        gt_heatmap=gt["heatmap"],
+        gt_reg=gt_reg,
+        gt_valid_mask=gt["valid_mask"],
+        feat_w=feat_w,
+        gt_offset=gt["offset"],
+    )
+
+    valid_vals = gt_reg[gt["valid_mask"]]
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["shape"] = tuple(gt_reg.shape) == (num_lanes, feat_h)
+    checks["range"] = (not bool(gt["valid_mask"].any().item())) or (float(valid_vals.abs().max().item()) <= 1.0 + 1e-3)
+    checks["invalid_zero"] = (not bool((~gt["valid_mask"]).any().item())) or (float(gt_reg[~gt["valid_mask"]].abs().max().item()) < 1e-6)
+    checks["roundtrip"] = err < 0.5
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 2.1 — GT REG SENTETİK TEST")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"gt_reg shape: {tuple(gt_reg.shape)}")
+    if bool(gt["valid_mask"].any().item()):
+        print(f"reg valid range: [{float(valid_vals.min().item()):.4f}, {float(valid_vals.max().item()):.4f}]")
+    print(f"round-trip hata (feat px): {err:.6f}")
+
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def run_real(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask_c", samples: int = 8) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
+
+    feat_h = 10
+    feat_w = 26
+    num_lanes = int(system_configs.num_queries)
+
+    success = 0
+    fail = 0
+    for i in range(min(samples, len(db.db_inds))):
+        db_ind = int(db.db_inds[i])
+        item = db.detections(db_ind)
+        label_t = torch.from_numpy(item["label"]).float()
+
+        gt_batch = labels_to_mask_batch_gt([label_t], feat_h=feat_h, feat_w=feat_w, num_lanes=num_lanes)
+        hm = gt_batch["heatmap"][0]
+        vm = gt_batch["valid_mask"][0]
+        off = gt_batch["offset"][0]
+
+        reg = compute_gt_reg(hm, vm, feat_w=feat_w, gt_offset=off)
+
+        has_valid = bool(vm.any().item())
+        in_range = (not has_valid) or (float(reg[vm].abs().max().item()) <= 1.0 + 1e-3)
+        zero_inv = (not bool((~vm).any().item())) or (float(reg[~vm].abs().max().item()) < 1e-6)
+        if has_valid and in_range and zero_inv:
+            success += 1
+            rng_txt = f"[{float(reg[vm].min().item()):.3f},{float(reg[vm].max().item()):.3f}]"
+            print(f"  Sample {i}: ✅ valid_rows={int(vm.sum().item())} reg_range={rng_txt}")
+        else:
+            fail += 1
+            print(f"  Sample {i}: 🚨 has_valid={has_valid} in_range={in_range} zero_inv={zero_inv}")
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["all_samples_ok"] = fail == 0
+    checks["at_least_one_success"] = success > 0
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 2.2 — GT REG GERÇEK CULANE TEST")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Başarılı: {success}, Hatalı: {fail}")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<20}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_mask_c")
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--feat-h", type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument("--feat-w", type=int, default=26)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-lanes", type=int, default=7)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    c1 = run_synthetic(feat_h=args.feat_h, feat_w=args.feat_w, num_lanes=args.num_lanes)
+    c2 = run_real(cfg_name=args.cfg, samples=args.samples)
+    ok = all(c1.values()) and all(c2.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 2 — GT reg formatı: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+
*** Add File: reghead_analysis/bolum3_loss_reg.py
+"""
+BÖLÜM 3 — Yeni reg-loss (B,L,H) izole testi.
+
+Offset (B,L,H,W) yerine reg (B,L,H) kullanılır.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
+
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
+from reghead_analysis.bolum2_gt_reg import compute_gt_reg
+
+
+def compute_reg_loss(pred_reg: torch.Tensor, gt_reg: torch.Tensor, gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if pred_reg.shape != gt_reg.shape:
+        raise ValueError(f"pred_reg shape={tuple(pred_reg.shape)} != gt_reg shape={tuple(gt_reg.shape)}")
+    mask = gt_valid_mask.float()
+    diff = torch.abs(pred_reg - gt_reg)
+    return (diff * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
+
+
+def compute_new_mask_loss(
+    pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
+    pred_reg: torch.Tensor,       # (B,L,H)
+    pred_vrange: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,2)
+    pred_scores: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,2)
+    gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
+    gt_reg: torch.Tensor,         # (B,L,H)
+    gt_vrange: torch.Tensor,      # (B,L,2)
+    gt_labels: torch.Tensor,      # (B,L)
+    gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,  # (B,L,H)
+    w_heat: float = 1.0,
+    w_reg: float = 1.0,
+    w_vr: float = 1.0,
+    w_cls: float = 1.0,
+) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    device = pred_heatmap.device
+    bsz, lq, h, w = pred_heatmap.shape
+    cols = torch.arange(w, device=device, dtype=pred_heatmap.dtype)
+
+    pred_x_coarse = (pred_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)  # (B,L,H)
+    gt_x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)      # (B,L,H)
+
+    pred_x_fine = pred_x_coarse + pred_reg * w
+    gt_x_fine = gt_x_coarse + gt_reg * w
+
+    heat_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+    reg_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+    vr_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+    cls_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+    class_error_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+    n_matches = 0
+
+    for b in range(bsz):
+        gt_idx = torch.nonzero(gt_labels[b] > 0, as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)
+        cls_target = torch.zeros(lq, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+
+        if gt_idx.numel() > 0:
+            fg_prob = F.softmax(pred_scores[b], dim=-1)[:, 1]
+            cost = torch.zeros((lq, gt_idx.numel()), device=device)
+            for j, g in enumerate(gt_idx):
+                valid = gt_valid_mask[b, g]
+                if bool(valid.any().item()):
+                    heat_cost = torch.abs(pred_x_coarse[b, :, valid] - gt_x_coarse[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
+                    reg_cost = torch.abs(pred_x_fine[b, :, valid] - gt_x_fine[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
+                else:
+                    heat_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, device=device)
+                    reg_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, device=device)
+
+                range_cost = torch.abs(pred_vrange[b] - gt_vrange[b, g].float().unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
+                cls_cost = 1.0 - fg_prob
+                cost[:, j] = cls_cost + heat_cost + reg_cost + 0.25 * range_cost
+
+            row_ind, col_ind = linear_sum_assignment(cost.detach().cpu().numpy())
+            pred_match = torch.as_tensor(row_ind, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+            gt_match = gt_idx[torch.as_tensor(col_ind, dtype=torch.long, device=device)]
+            cls_target[pred_match] = 1
+
+            for p_i, g_i in zip(pred_match.tolist(), gt_match.tolist()):
+                valid = gt_valid_mask[b, g_i]
+                if bool(valid.any().item()):
+                    heat_total = heat_total + torch.abs(pred_x_coarse[b, p_i, valid] - gt_x_coarse[b, g_i, valid]).mean()
+                    reg_total = reg_total + torch.abs(pred_x_fine[b, p_i, valid] - gt_x_fine[b, g_i, valid]).mean()
+
+                vr_total = vr_total + F.l1_loss(
+                    pred_vrange[b, p_i],
+                    gt_vrange[b, g_i].float(),
+                    reduction="mean",
+                )
+                n_matches += 1
+
+        cls_total = cls_total + F.cross_entropy(pred_scores[b], cls_target, reduction="mean")
+        class_error_total = class_error_total + (pred_scores[b].argmax(dim=-1) != cls_target).float().mean() * 100.0
+
+    cls_loss = cls_total / max(bsz, 1)
+    class_error = class_error_total / max(bsz, 1)
+
+    if n_matches > 0:
+        heat_loss = heat_total / n_matches
+        reg_loss = reg_total / n_matches
+        vrange_loss = vr_total / n_matches
+    else:
+        heat_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+        reg_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+        vrange_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
+
+    total = w_heat * heat_loss + w_reg * reg_loss + w_vr * vrange_loss + w_cls * cls_loss
+    return {
+        "total": total,
+        "heat_loss": heat_loss,
+        "reg_loss": reg_loss,
+        "vrange_loss": vrange_loss,
+        "cls_loss": cls_loss,
+        "class_error": class_error,
+    }
+
+
+def run(seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    bsz, lq, h, w = 2, 7, 10, 26
+
+    pred_hm = F.softmax(torch.randn(bsz, lq, h, w, device=device), dim=-1)
+    pred_reg = torch.tanh(torch.randn(bsz, lq, h, device=device))
+    pred_vr = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device)
+    pred_sc = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device)
+
+    fake_lanes = [[(150, 250), (160, 200), (170, 150)], [(400, 250), (410, 200), (420, 150)]]
+    gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(fake_lanes, img_h=295, img_w=820, feat_h=h, feat_w=w, num_lanes=lq)
+    gt_hm = gt["heatmap"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1, -1).to(device)
+    gt_vr = gt["v_range"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)
+    gt_lbl = gt["labels"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1).to(device)
+    gt_vm = gt["valid_mask"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)
+    gt_reg = compute_gt_reg(gt["heatmap"], gt["valid_mask"], feat_w=w, gt_offset=gt["offset"]).unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)
+
+    losses = compute_new_mask_loss(
+        pred_hm,
+        pred_reg,
+        pred_vr,
+        pred_sc,
+        gt_hm,
+        gt_reg,
+        gt_vr,
+        gt_lbl,
+        gt_vm,
+    )
+
+    # gradient sanity
+    hm_logits = torch.randn(bsz, lq, h, w, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    reg_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, h, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    vr_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    sc_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+
+    losses_g = compute_new_mask_loss(
+        F.softmax(hm_logits, dim=-1),
+        torch.tanh(reg_raw),
+        vr_raw,
+        sc_raw,
+        gt_hm,
+        gt_reg,
+        gt_vr,
+        gt_lbl,
+        gt_vm,
+    )
+    losses_g["total"].backward()
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["finite_losses"] = all(bool(torch.isfinite(v).item()) for v in losses.values())
+    checks["reg_loss_positive"] = float(losses["reg_loss"].item()) > 0.0
+    checks["grad_hm"] = hm_logits.grad is not None and float(hm_logits.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+    checks["grad_reg"] = reg_raw.grad is not None and float(reg_raw.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+    checks["grad_vr"] = vr_raw.grad is not None and float(vr_raw.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+    checks["grad_sc"] = sc_raw.grad is not None and float(sc_raw.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 3 — YENİ REG LOSS İZOLE TEST")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    for k, v in losses.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<14}: {float(v.item()):.6f}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(seed=args.seed)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 3 — Yeni loss: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""
+BÖLÜM 5 — Yeni reg postprocess testi.
+
+ESKİ:
+  x_final = x_coarse + offset[row, n_col]
+
+YENİ:
+  x_final = x_coarse + reg[row] * feat_w
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import List, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
+from reghead_analysis.bolum2_gt_reg import compute_gt_reg
+
+
+def _decode_vrange_rows(v_range: torch.Tensor, feat_h: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    if v_range.numel() == 0:
+        z = torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long, device=v_range.device)
+        return z, z
+
+    if float(v_range.min().item()) >= -0.5 and float(v_range.max().item()) <= 1.5:
+        vr = torch.sigmoid(v_range)
+        s = (vr[:, 0] * (feat_h - 1)).round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
+        e = (vr[:, 1] * (feat_h - 1)).round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
+    else:
+        s = v_range[:, 0].round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
+        e = v_range[:, 1].round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
+    return s, e
+
+
+def new_postprocess(
+    heatmap: torch.Tensor,   # (L,H,W)
+    reg: torch.Tensor,       # (L,H)
+    vrange: torch.Tensor,    # (L,2)
+    scores: torch.Tensor,    # (L,2)
+    img_h: int,
+    img_w: int,
+    feat_h: int,
+    feat_w: int,
+    score_thresh: float = 0.5,
+) -> List[List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
+    if heatmap.dim() != 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"heatmap must be (L,H,W), got {tuple(heatmap.shape)}")
+    if reg.dim() != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"reg must be (L,H), got {tuple(reg.shape)}")
+
+    lanes, h, w = heatmap.shape
+    if h != feat_h or w != feat_w:
+        raise ValueError(f"heatmap size {(h, w)} != given feat size {(feat_h, feat_w)}")
+
+    col_idx = torch.arange(feat_w, device=heatmap.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    fg_prob = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)[:, 1]
+    row_start, row_end = _decode_vrange_rows(vrange, feat_h)
+
+    scale_x = img_w / float(max(feat_w - 1, 1))
+    scale_y = img_h / float(max(feat_h - 1, 1))
+
+    out: List[List[Tuple[int, int]]] = []
+    for l in range(lanes):
+        if float(fg_prob[l].item()) < score_thresh:
+            continue
+
+        s = int(row_start[l].item())
+        e = int(row_end[l].item())
+        if s > e:
+            s, e = e, s
+
+        pts: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
+        for r in range(s, e + 1):
+            row_hm = heatmap[l, r]
+            if float(row_hm.sum().item()) < 1e-6:
+                continue
+
+            x_coarse = float((row_hm * col_idx).sum().item())
+            x_fine = x_coarse + float(reg[l, r].item()) * feat_w
+            x_fine = max(0.0, min(float(feat_w - 1), x_fine))
+
+            x_img = int(round(x_fine * scale_x))
+            y_img = int(round(float(r) * scale_y))
+            pts.append((x_img, y_img))
+
+        if len(pts) >= 2:
+            out.append(pts)
+
+    return out
+
+
+def run() -> bool:
+    feat_h, feat_w = 10, 26
+    img_h, img_w = 295, 820
+    num_lanes = 7
+
+    fake_lane = [(160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150), (190, 100)]
+    gt = lanes_to_mask_gt([fake_lane], img_h=img_h, img_w=img_w, feat_h=feat_h, feat_w=feat_w, num_lanes=num_lanes)
+
+    hm = gt["heatmap"]
+    vm = gt["valid_mask"]
+    vr = gt["v_range"].float()
+    reg = compute_gt_reg(hm, vm, feat_w=feat_w, gt_offset=gt["offset"])
+
+    scores = torch.full((num_lanes, 2), -8.0)
+    scores[0, 1] = 8.0
+
+    lanes = new_postprocess(
+        hm,
+        reg,
+        vr,
+        scores,
+        img_h=img_h,
+        img_w=img_w,
+        feat_h=feat_h,
+        feat_w=feat_w,
+        score_thresh=0.5,
+    )
+
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print("BÖLÜM 5 — REG POSTPROCESS TEST")
+    print("=" * 90)
+    print(f"Orijinal lane: {fake_lane}")
+    print(f"Çıkarılan lane: {lanes[0] if lanes else 'BOŞ'}")
+
+    if not lanes:
+        print("🚨 Lane çıkarılamadı")
+        return False
+
+    orig = np.array(fake_lane, dtype=np.float32)
+    errs = []
+    for x_pred, y_pred in lanes[0]:
+        idx = int(np.argmin(np.abs(orig[:, 1] - float(y_pred))))
+        if abs(float(orig[idx, 1]) - float(y_pred)) <= 40.0:
+            errs.append(abs(float(orig[idx, 0]) - float(x_pred)))
+
+    if not errs:
+        print("⚠️ Uygun y-eşleşmesi bulunamadı")
+        return False
+
+    mean_err = float(np.mean(errs))
+    print(f"Ortalama x hatası: {mean_err:.2f} px")
+    ok = mean_err < 30.0
+    print(f"BÖLÜM 5: {'✅ GEÇTİ' if ok else '🚨 BAŞARISIZ'}")
+    return ok
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    _ = parser.parse_args()
+    ok = run()
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

   - Fix: `bolum4_dense_offset.py` içinde güçlü full-row + weak-mix yaklaşımı eklendi.

6. **Bölüm 6 validator yanlış alarm**
   - Sorun: `lane_points_structure` kontrolü yanlış nesting varsayıyordu.
   - Fix: batch→lane→point validator yazıldı; ndarray/list/tuple desteği eklendi.

7. **Baseline adapter tensor düzeni**
   - Sorun: `DynamicMaskHead` girdi formatı `(L,B,C)` / `(B,L,C)` uyumu.
   - Fix: `bolum5_overfit_combined.py` içinde adapter’da permute düzeltmesi yapıldı.

---

5. **Problem Solving**

**Çözülenler:**
- `condlstr_analysis` script seti tamamlandı ve kullanıcı geri bildirimine göre düzeltildi.
- CondLSTR kıyası yapıldı; “runtime doğru ama CondLSTR’e tam eşdeğer değil” netleştirildi.
- C varyantı (coord+prior, dense yok) üretime eklendi (`mask_c` model + config).
- Türkçe iletişim talebi kalıcı olarak benimsendi.

**Devam eden çalışma:**
- Son kullanıcı talebi olan `reghead_analysis` seti henüz tamamlanmadı.
- Şu an eksik bölümler: baseline offset referansı, old-vs-new overfit karşılaştırması, tam uyumluluk scripti.

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 1 — RegHead izole test.
  3 | 
  4 | Yeni başlık:
  5 |   T:   (B, L, C)
  6 |   reg: (B, L, H)
  7 | """
  8 | 
  9 | import argparse
 10 | from typing import Dict
 11 | 
 12 | import torch
 13 | import torch.nn as nn
 14 | 
 15 | 
 16 | class RegHead(nn.Module):
 17 |     """
 18 |     Query tabanlı satır-residual başlığı.
 19 | 
 20 |     Girdi:
 21 |       t_blc: (B, L, C)
 22 |     Çıktı:
 23 |       reg:   (B, L, H), normalize residual in [-1, 1]
 24 |     """
 25 | 
 26 |     def __init__(self, feat_dim: int = 32, feat_h: int = 10, num_queries: int = 7):
 27 |         super().__init__()
 28 |         self.feat_dim = feat_dim
 29 |         self.feat_h = feat_h
 30 |         self.num_queries = num_queries
 31 | 
 32 |         self.mlp_reg = nn.Sequential(
 33 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2),
 34 |             nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
 35 |             nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, feat_h),
 36 |             nn.Tanh(),
 37 |         )
 38 | 
 39 |     def forward(self, t_blc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 40 |         if t_blc.dim() != 3:
 41 |             raise ValueError(f"t_blc must be 3D, got {tuple(t_blc.shape)}")
 42 |         bsz, lanes, channels = t_blc.shape
 43 |         if lanes != self.num_queries:
 44 |             raise ValueError(f"lane dim={lanes}, expected num_queries={self.num_queries}")
 45 |         if channels != self.feat_dim:
 46 |             raise ValueError(f"channel dim={channels}, expected feat_dim={self.feat_dim}")
 47 |         return self.mlp_reg(t_blc)
 48 | 
 49 | 
 50 | def run(batch: int = 2, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32, feat_h: int = 10, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 51 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 52 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 53 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 54 | 
 55 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 56 |     head = RegHead(feat_dim=feat_dim, feat_h=feat_h, num_queries=num_queries).to(device)
 57 | 
 58 |     t = torch.randn(batch, num_queries, feat_dim, requires_grad=True, device=device)
 59 |     out = head(t)
 60 | 
 61 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
 62 |     checks["shape"] = tuple(out.shape) == (batch, num_queries, feat_h)
 63 |     checks["range"] = float(out.min().item()) >= -1.000001 and float(out.max().item()) <= 1.000001
 64 |     checks["finite"] = bool(torch.isfinite(out).all().item())
 65 | 
 66 |     loss = out.sum()
 67 |     loss.backward()
 68 |     grad_params_ok = True
 69 |     for p in head.parameters():
 70 |         if p.grad is None or float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) < 1e-12:
 71 |             grad_params_ok = False
 72 |             break
 73 |     checks["grad_params"] = grad_params_ok
 74 |     checks["grad_input"] = t.grad is not None and float(t.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
 75 | 
 76 |     t2 = torch.randn_like(t)
 77 |     out2 = head(t2)
 78 |     checks["sensitive_to_input"] = float((out - out2).abs().mean().item()) > 1e-6
 79 | 
 80 |     print("=" * 90)
 81 |     print("BÖLÜM 1 — REGHEAD İZOLE TEST")
 82 |     print("=" * 90)
 83 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
 84 |     print(f"Input T: {tuple(t.shape)}")
 85 |     print(f"Output reg: {tuple(out.shape)}")
 86 |     print(f"Range: [{float(out.min().item()):.4f}, {float(out.max().item()):.4f}]")
 87 | 
 88 |     print("\nKontroller:")
 89 |     for k, v in checks.items():
 90 |         print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
 91 | 
 92 |     return checks
 93 | 
 94 | 
 95 | def main():
 96 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
 97 |     parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
 98 |     parser.add_argument("--num-queries", type=int, default=7)
 99 |     parser.add_argument("--feat-dim", type=int, default=32)
100 |     parser.add_argument("--feat-h", type=int, default=10)
101 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
102 |     args = parser.parse_args()
103 | 
104 |     checks = run(
105 |         batch=args.batch,
106 |         num_queries=args.num_queries,
107 |         feat_dim=args.feat_dim,
108 |         feat_h=args.feat_h,
109 |         seed=args.seed,
110 |     )
111 |     ok = all(checks.values())
112 | 
113 |     print("\n" + "=" * 90)
114 |     print("RAPOR")
115 |     print("=" * 90)
116 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 1 — RegHead izole: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
117 |     if not ok:
118 |         raise SystemExit(1)
119 | 
120 | 
121 | if __name__ == "__main__":
122 |     main()

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 2 — GT residual-reg üretimi.
  3 | 
  4 | Hedef:
  5 |   gt_reg[lane, row] = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / feat_w
  6 | 
  7 | Burada:
  8 |   - gt_x_coarse: gt heatmap weighted-argmax (sürekli)
  9 |   - gt_x_true  : tercihen gt_offset map'ten türetilen x (varsa)
 10 | """
 11 | 
 12 | import argparse
 13 | from typing import Dict, Optional
 14 | 
 15 | import torch
 16 | 
 17 | from config import system_configs
 18 | from db.culane import CULANE
 19 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import labels_to_mask_batch_gt, lanes_to_mask_gt
 20 | from mask_migration.common import load_system_config
 21 | 
 22 | 
 23 | def compute_gt_reg(
 24 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,     # (L,H,W)
 25 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,  # (L,H)
 26 |     feat_w: int,
 27 |     gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # (L,H,W), optional
 28 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 29 |     if gt_heatmap.dim() != 3:
 30 |         raise ValueError(f"gt_heatmap must be (L,H,W), got {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}")
 31 |     if gt_valid_mask.dim() != 2:
 32 |         raise ValueError(f"gt_valid_mask must be (L,H), got {tuple(gt_valid_mask.shape)}")
 33 | 
 34 |     lanes, h, w = gt_heatmap.shape
 35 |     if w != feat_w:
 36 |         raise ValueError(f"feat_w mismatch: heatmap W={w}, feat_w={feat_w}")
 37 | 
 38 |     cols = torch.arange(w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
 39 |     gt_x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)  # (L,H)
 40 | 
 41 |     if gt_offset is not None:
 42 |         if gt_offset.dim() != 3 or gt_offset.shape != gt_heatmap.shape:
 43 |             raise ValueError(f"gt_offset shape must be {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}, got {tuple(gt_offset.shape)}")
 44 |         # gt_offset[l,r,c] = gt_x_true - c -> c=0'dan gt_x_true alınabilir.
 45 |         gt_x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
 46 |     else:
 47 |         gt_x_true = gt_x_coarse
 48 | 
 49 |     reg = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / float(max(feat_w, 1))
 50 |     reg = reg * gt_valid_mask.float()
 51 |     return reg
 52 | 
 53 | 
 54 | def _round_trip_error(
 55 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,
 56 |     gt_reg: torch.Tensor,
 57 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
 58 |     feat_w: int,
 59 |     gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
 60 | ) -> float:
 61 |     cols = torch.arange(feat_w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
 62 |     x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, feat_w)).sum(dim=-1)
 63 |     x_recovered = x_coarse + gt_reg * feat_w
 64 | 
 65 |     if gt_offset is not None:
 66 |         x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
 67 |     else:
 68 |         x_true = x_coarse
 69 | 
 70 |     valid = gt_valid_mask.bool()
 71 |     if not bool(valid.any().item()):
 72 |         return 0.0
 73 |     return float(torch.abs(x_recovered[valid] - x_true[valid]).mean().item())

  2 | BÖLÜM 3 — Yeni reg-loss (B,L,H) izole testi.
  3 |

  6 | 
  7 | import argparse
  8 | from typing import Dict
  9 | 
 10 | import numpy as np
 11 | import torch
 12 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 13 | from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
 14 | 
 15 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
 16 | from reghead_analysis.bolum2_gt_reg import compute_gt_reg
 17 | 
 18 | 
 19 | def compute_reg_loss(pred_reg: torch.Tensor, gt_reg: torch.Tensor, gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 20 |     if pred_reg.shape != gt_reg.shape:
 21 |         raise ValueError(f"pred_reg shape={tuple(pred_reg.shape)} != gt_reg shape={tuple(gt_reg.shape)}")
 22 |     mask = gt_valid_mask.float()
 23 |     diff = torch.abs(pred_reg - gt_reg)
 24 |     return (diff * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
 25 | 
 26 | 
 27 | def compute_new_mask_loss(
 28 |     pred_heatmap: torch.Tensor,   # (B,L,H,W)
 29 |     pred_reg: torch.Tensor,       # (B,L,H)
 30 |     pred_vrange: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,2)
 31 |     pred_scores: torch.Tensor,    # (B,L,2)
 32 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,     # (B,L,H,W)
 33 |     gt_reg: torch.Tensor,         # (B,L,H)
 34 |     gt_vrange: torch.Tensor,      # (B,L,2)
 35 |     gt_labels: torch.Tensor,      # (B,L)
 36 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,  # (B,L,H)
 37 |     w_heat: float = 1.0,
 38 |     w_reg: float = 1.0,
 39 |     w_vr: float = 1.0,
 40 |     w_cls: float = 1.0,
 41 | ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
 42 |     device = pred_heatmap.device
 43 |     bsz, lq, h, w = pred_heatmap.shape
 44 |     cols = torch.arange(w, device=device, dtype=pred_heatmap.dtype)
 45 | 
 46 |     pred_x_coarse = (pred_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)  # (B,L,H)
 47 |     gt_x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)      # (B,L,H)
 48 | 
 49 |     pred_x_fine = pred_x_coarse + pred_reg * w
 50 |     gt_x_fine = gt_x_coarse + gt_reg * w
 51 | 
 52 |     heat_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
 53 |     reg_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
 54 |     vr_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
 55 |     cls_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
 56 |     class_error_total = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
 57 |     n_matches = 0
 58 | 
 59 |     for b in range(bsz):
 60 |         gt_idx = torch.nonzero(gt_labels[b] > 0, as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)
 61 |         cls_target = torch.zeros(lq, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
 62 | 
 63 |         if gt_idx.numel() > 0:
 64 |             fg_prob = F.softmax(pred_scores[b], dim=-1)[:, 1]
 65 |             cost = torch.zeros((lq, gt_idx.numel()), device=device)
 66 |             for j, g in enumerate(gt_idx):
 67 |                 valid = gt_valid_mask[b, g]
 68 |                 if bool(valid.any().item()):
 69 |                     heat_cost = torch.abs(pred_x_coarse[b, :, valid] - gt_x_coarse[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
 70 |                     reg_cost = torch.abs(pred_x_fine[b, :, valid] - gt_x_fine[b, g, valid].unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
 71 |                 else:
 72 |                     heat_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, device=device)
 73 |                     reg_cost = torch.full((lq,), 2.0, device=device)
 74 | 
 75 |                 range_cost = torch.abs(pred_vrange[b] - gt_vrange[b, g].float().unsqueeze(0)).mean(dim=1)
 76 |                 cls_cost = 1.0 - fg_prob
 77 |                 cost[:, j] = cls_cost + heat_cost + reg_cost + 0.25 * range_cost
 78 | 
 79 |             row_ind, col_ind = linear_sum_assignment(cost.detach().cpu().numpy())
 80 |             pred_match = torch.as_tensor(row_ind, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
 81 |             gt_match = gt_idx[torch.as_tensor(col_ind, dtype=torch.long, device=device)]
 82 |             cls_target[pred_match] = 1
 83 | 
 84 |             for p_i, g_i in zip(pred_match.tolist(), gt_match.tolist()):
 85 |                 valid = gt_valid_mask[b, g_i]
 86 |                 if bool(valid.any().item()):
 87 |                     heat_total = heat_total + torch.abs(pred_x_coarse[b, p_i, valid] - gt_x_coarse[b, g_i, valid]).mean()
 88 |                     reg_total = reg_total + torch.abs(pred_x_fine[b, p_i, valid] - gt_x_fine[b, g_i, valid]).mean()
 89 | 
 90 |                 vr_total = vr_total + F.l1_loss(
 91 |                     pred_vrange[b, p_i],
 92 |                     gt_vrange[b, g_i].float(),
 93 |                     reduction="mean",
 94 |                 )
 95 |                 n_matches += 1
 96 | 
 97 |         cls_total = cls_total + F.cross_entropy(pred_scores[b], cls_target, reduction="mean")
 98 |         class_error_total = class_error_total + (pred_scores[b].argmax(dim=-1) != cls_target).float().mean() * 100.0
 99 | 
100 |     cls_loss = cls_total / max(bsz, 1)
101 |     class_error = class_error_total / max(bsz, 1)
102 | 
103 |     if n_matches > 0:
104 |         heat_loss = heat_total / n_matches
105 |         reg_loss = reg_total / n_matches
106 |         vrange_loss = vr_total / n_matches
107 |     else:
108 |         heat_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
109 |         reg_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
110 |         vrange_loss = pred_heatmap.new_zeros(())
111 | 
112 |     total = w_heat * heat_loss + w_reg * reg_loss + w_vr * vrange_loss + w_cls * cls_loss
113 |     return {
114 |         "total": total,
115 |         "heat_loss": heat_loss,
116 |         "reg_loss": reg_loss,
117 |         "vrange_loss": vrange_loss,
118 |         "cls_loss": cls_loss,
119 |         "class_error": class_error,
120 |     }

124 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
125 |     np.random.seed(seed)
126 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
127 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

139 |     gt_hm = gt["heatmap"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1, -1).to(device)
140 |     gt_vr = gt["v_range"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)

142 |     gt_vm = gt["valid_mask"].unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)
143 |     gt_reg = compute_gt_reg(gt["heatmap"], gt["valid_mask"], feat_w=w, gt_offset=gt["offset"]).unsqueeze(0).expand(bsz, -1, -1).to(device)
144 | 
145 |     losses = compute_new_mask_loss(

159 |     reg_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, h, device=device, requires_grad=True)
160 |     vr_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device, requires_grad=True)
161 |     sc_raw = torch.randn(bsz, lq, 2, device=device, requires_grad=True)

175 |

 12 | from typing import List, Tuple
 13 |

 19 | from reghead_analysis.bolum2_gt_reg import compute_gt_reg

 21 | 
 22 | def _decode_vrange_rows(v_range: torch.Tensor, feat_h: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
 23 |     if v_range.numel() == 0:
 24 |         z = torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long, device=v_range.device)
 25 |         return z, z
 26 | 
 27 |     if float(v_range.min().item()) >= -0.5 and float(v_range.max().item()) <= 1.5:
 28 |         vr = torch.sigmoid(v_range)
 29 |         s = (vr[:, 0] * (feat_h - 1)).round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
 30 |         e = (vr[:, 1] * (feat_h - 1)).round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
 31 |     else:
 32 |         s = v_range[:, 0].round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
 33 |         e = v_range[:, 1].round().long().clamp(0, feat_h - 1)
 34 |     return s, e
 35 | 
 36 | 
 37 | def new_postprocess(
 38 |     heatmap: torch.Tensor,   # (L,H,W)
 39 |     reg: torch.Tensor,       # (L,H)
 40 |     vrange: torch.Tensor,    # (L,2)
 41 |     scores: torch.Tensor,    # (L,2)
 42 |     img_h: int,
 43 |     img_w: int,
 44 |     feat_h: int,
 45 |     feat_w: int,
 46 |     score_thresh: float = 0.5,
 47 | ) -> List[List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
 48 |     if heatmap.dim() != 3:
 49 |         raise ValueError(f"heatmap must be (L,H,W), got {tuple(heatmap.shape)}")
 50 |     if reg.dim() != 2:
 51 |         raise ValueError(f"reg must be (L,H), got {tuple(reg.shape)}")
 52 | 
 53 |     lanes, h, w = heatmap.shape
 54 |     if h != feat_h or w != feat_w:
 55 |         raise ValueError(f"heatmap size {(h, w)} != given feat size {(feat_h, feat_w)}")
 56 | 
 57 |     col_idx = torch.arange(feat_w, device=heatmap.device, dtype=torch.float32)
 58 |     fg_prob = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)[:, 1]
 59 |     row_start, row_end = _decode_vrange_rows(vrange, feat_h)
 60 | 
 61 |     scale_x = img_w / float(max(feat_w - 1, 1))
 62 |     scale_y = img_h / float(max(feat_h - 1, 1))
 63 | 
 64 |     out: List[List[Tuple[int, int]]] = []
 65 |     for l in range(lanes):
 66 |         if float(fg_prob[l].item()) < score_thresh:
 67 |             continue
 68 | 
 69 |         s = int(row_start[l].item())
 70 |         e = int(row_end[l].item())
 71 |         if s > e:
 72 |             s, e = e, s
 73 | 
 74 |         pts: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
 75 |         for r in range(s, e + 1):
 76 |             row_hm = heatmap[l, r]
 77 |             if float(row_hm.sum().item()) < 1e-6:
 78 |                 continue
 79 | 
 80 |             x_coarse = float((row_hm * col_idx).sum().item())
 81 |             x_fine = x_coarse + float(reg[l, r].item()) * feat_w
 82 |             x_fine = max(0.0, min(float(feat_w - 1), x_fine))
 83 | 
 84 |             x_img = int(round(x_fine * scale_x))
 85 |             y_img = int(round(float(r) * scale_y))
 86 |             pts.append((x_img, y_img))
 87 | 
 88 |         if len(pts) >= 2:
 89 |             out.append(pts)
 90 | 
 91 |     return out
 92 | 
 93 | 
 94 | def run() -> bool:
 95 |     feat_h, feat_w = 10, 26
 96 |     img_h, img_w = 295, 820
 97 |     num_lanes = 7
 98 | 
 99 |     fake_lane = [(160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150), (190, 100)]
100 |     gt = lanes_to_mask_gt([fake_lane], img_h=img_h, img_w=img_w, feat_h=feat_h, feat_w=feat_w, num_lanes=num_lanes)
101 | 
102 |     hm = gt["heatmap"]
103 |     vm = gt["valid_mask"]
104 |     vr = gt["v_range"].float()
105 |     reg = compute_gt_reg(hm, vm, feat_w=feat_w, gt_offset=gt["offset"])
106 | 
107 |     scores = torch.full((num_lanes, 2), -8.0)
108 |     scores[0, 1] = 8.0
109 | 
110 |     lanes = new_postprocess(
111 |         hm,
112 |         reg,
113 |         vr,
114 |         scores,
115 |         img_h=img_h,
116 |         img_w=img_w,
117 |         feat_h=feat_h,
118 |         feat_w=feat_w,
119 |         score_thresh=0.5,
120 |     )
121 | 
122 |     print("=" * 90)
123 |     print("BÖLÜM 5 — REG POSTPROCESS TEST")
124 |     print("=" * 90)
125 |     print(f"Orijinal lane: {fake_lane}")
126 |     print(f"Çıkarılan lane: {lanes[0] if lanes else 'BOŞ'}")
127 | 
128 |     if not lanes:
129 |         print("🚨 Lane çıkarılamadı")
130 |         return False
131 | 
132 |     orig = np.array(fake_lane, dtype=np.float32)
133 |     errs = []
134 |     for x_pred, y_pred in lanes[0]:
135 |         idx = int(np.argmin(np.abs(orig[:, 1] - float(y_pred))))
136 |         if abs(float(orig[idx, 1]) - float(y_pred)) <= 40.0:
137 |             errs.append(abs(float(orig[idx, 0]) - float(x_pred)))
138 | 
139 |     if not errs:
140 |         print("⚠️ Uygun y-eşleşmesi bulunamadı")
141 |         return False
142 | 
143 |     mean_err = float(np.mean(errs))
144 |     print(f"Ortalama x hatası: {mean_err:.2f} px")
145 |     ok = mean_err < 30.0
146 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 5: {'✅ GEÇTİ' if ok else '🚨 BAŞARISIZ'}")
147 |     return ok
148 |

151 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
152 |     _ = parser.parse_args()
153 |     ok = run()
154 |     if not ok:
155 |         raise SystemExit(1)

 27 |     return nn.Conv2d(
 28 |         in_planes,

 43 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 44 |     expansion = 1
 45 | 
 46 |     def __init__(
 47 |         self,
 48 |         inplanes,
 49 |         planes,
 50 |         stride=1,
 51 |         downsample=None,
 52 |         groups=1,
 53 |         base_width=64,
 54 |         dilation=1,
 55 |         norm_layer=None,
 56 |     ):
 57 |         super().__init__()
 58 |         if norm_layer is None:
 59 |             norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
 60 |         if groups != 1 or base_width != 64:
 61 |             raise ValueError("BasicBlock only supports groups=1 and base_width=64")
 62 |         if dilation > 1:
 63 |             raise NotImplementedError("Dilation > 1 not supported in BasicBlock")
 64 | 
 65 |         self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
 66 |         self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
 67 |         self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 68 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
 69 |         self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
 70 |         self.downsample = downsample
 71 | 
 72 |     def forward(self, x):
 73 |         identity = x
 74 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
 75 |         out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
 76 |         if self.downsample is not None:
 77 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
 78 |         out += identity
 79 |         return self.relu(out)

 82 | class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
 83 |     expansion = 4
 84 | 
 85 |     def __init__(
 86 |         self,
 87 |         inplanes,
 88 |         planes,
 89 |         stride=1,
 90 |         downsample=None,
 91 |         groups=1,
 92 |         base_width=64,

 94 |         norm_layer=None,

 96 |         super().__init__()
 97 |         if norm_layer is None:
 98 |             norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
 99 |         width = int(planes * (base_width / 64.0)) * groups
100 | 
101 |         self.conv1 = conv1x1(inplanes, width)
102 |         self.bn1 = norm_layer(width)
103 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(width, width, stride, groups, dilation)
104 |         self.bn2 = norm_layer(width)
105 |         self.conv3 = conv1x1(width, planes * self.expansion)
106 |         self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
107 |         self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
108 |         self.downsample = downsample
109 |

111 |         identity = x
112 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
113 |         out = self.relu(self.bn2(self.conv2(out)))
114 |         out = self.bn3(self.conv3(out))
115 |         if self.downsample is not None:
116 |             identity = self.downsample(x)

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 5 — A/B/C/D ablation overfit testi (izole).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Her değişikliği ayrı ölçmek: A→B→C→D
  6 |    A: baseline head
  7 |    B: baseline + coord injection
  8 |    C: baseline + coord injection + prior bias
  9 |    D: baseline + coord injection + prior bias + dense offset
 10 | 2) Hangi adımda overfit gücü düştüğünü netleştirmek
 11 | 3) Entegrasyon öncesi riskli bileşeni izole etmek
 12 | """
 13 | 
 14 | import argparse
 15 | import math
 16 | from typing import Dict
 17 | 
 18 | import numpy as np
 19 | import torch
 20 | import torch.nn as nn
 21 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 22 | 
 23 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import lanes_to_mask_gt
 24 | from mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head import DynamicMaskHead
 25 | from mask_migration.bolum3_loss import compute_mask_loss
 26 | from condlstr_analysis.bolum4_dense_offset import dense_offset_loss_strong
 27 | 
 28 | 
 29 | def inject_coord_channels(memory: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 30 |     b, _c, h, w = memory.shape
 31 |     ys = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=h, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 32 |     xs = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, steps=w, device=memory.device, dtype=memory.dtype)
 33 |     y = ys.view(1, 1, h, 1).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 34 |     x = xs.view(1, 1, 1, w).expand(b, 1, h, w)
 35 |     return torch.cat([memory, y, x], dim=1)
 36 | 
 37 | 
 38 | class CoordHead(nn.Module):
 39 |     def __init__(self, num_queries: int = 7, feat_dim: int = 32):
 40 |         super().__init__()
 41 |         self.feat_dim = feat_dim
 42 |         kd = feat_dim + 2
 43 |         self.mlp_heat = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 44 |         self.mlp_off = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim, kd))
 45 |         self.mlp_vr = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 46 |         self.mlp_sc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat_dim, feat_dim // 2), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Linear(feat_dim // 2, 2))
 47 | 
 48 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
 49 |         # t: (L,B,C) or (B,L,C), m: (B,C,H,W)
 50 |         b, _c, h, w = m.shape
 51 |         if t.shape[1] == b:
 52 |             t = t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 53 |         f = inject_coord_channels(m)
 54 |         flat = f.flatten(2)
 55 |         kb = self.mlp_heat(t)
 56 |         kz = self.mlp_off(t)
 57 |         b_raw = torch.bmm(kb, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 58 |         z_raw = torch.bmm(kz, flat).view(b, t.shape[1], h, w)
 59 |         return {
 60 |             "heatmap": F.softmax(b_raw, dim=-1),
 61 |             "offset": z_raw,
 62 |             "v_range": self.mlp_vr(t),
 63 |             "scores": self.mlp_sc(t),
 64 |         }
 65 | 
 66 | 
 67 | def _t_to_blc(t: torch.Tensor, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:
 68 |     if t.dim() != 3:
 69 |         raise ValueError(f"T must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
 70 |     if t.shape[1] == batch:  # (L,B,C)
 71 |         return t.permute(1, 0, 2)
 72 |     if t.shape[0] == batch:  # (B,L,C)
 73 |         return t
 74 |     raise ValueError(f"Cannot infer batch dim from T={tuple(t.shape)} and batch={batch}")
 75 | 
 76 | 
 77 | @torch.no_grad()
 78 | def copy_baseline_to_coord(baseline: DynamicMaskHead, coord: CoordHead):
 79 |     fd = coord.feat_dim
 80 | 
 81 |     # heat
 82 |     coord.mlp_heat[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].weight)
 83 |     coord.mlp_heat[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[0].bias)
 84 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].weight.zero_()
 85 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].bias.zero_()
 86 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].weight)
 87 |     coord.mlp_heat[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_heatmap[2].bias)
 88 | 
 89 |     # offset
 90 |     coord.mlp_off[0].weight.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].weight)
 91 |     coord.mlp_off[0].bias.copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[0].bias)
 92 |     coord.mlp_off[2].weight.zero_()
 93 |     coord.mlp_off[2].bias.zero_()
 94 |     coord.mlp_off[2].weight[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].weight)
 95 |     coord.mlp_off[2].bias[:fd].copy_(baseline.mlp_offset[2].bias)
 96 | 
 97 |     coord.mlp_vr.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_vrange.state_dict())
 98 |     coord.mlp_sc.load_state_dict(baseline.mlp_score.state_dict())
 99 | 
100 | 
101 | class BaselineHeadAdapter(nn.Module):
102 |     """[mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head.DynamicMaskHead](mask_migration/bolum2_mask_head.py:11) için ortak arayüz."""
103 | 
104 |     def __init__(self, head: DynamicMaskHead):
105 |         super().__init__()
106 |         self.head = head
107 | 
108 |     def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor):
109 |         # [mask_migration.bolum2_mask_head.DynamicMaskHead.forward()](mask_migration/bolum2_mask_head.py:45)
110 |         # hem (L,B,C) hem (B,L,C) kabul eder; burada (B,L,C) veriyoruz.
111 |         # Adaptörde bilinçli olarak (L,B,C)'ye çevirip baseline yoluyla birebir çalıştırıyoruz.
112 |         if t.dim() != 3:
113 |             raise ValueError(f"t must be 3D, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
114 |         if t.shape[0] == m.shape[0]:
115 |             t = t.permute(1, 0, 2)
116 |         out = self.head(t, m)
117 |         return {
118 |             "heatmap": out["heatmap"],
119 |             "offset": out["offset"],
120 |             "v_range": out["v_range"],
121 |             "scores": out["scores"],
122 |         }
123 | 
124 | 
125 | def init_prior(head: CoordHead, prior_prob: float = 0.01):
126 |     bias_value = -math.log((1.0 - prior_prob) / prior_prob)
127 |     with torch.no_grad():
128 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[0] = 0.0
129 |         head.mlp_sc[-1].bias[1] = float(bias_value)
130 | 
131 | 
132 | def _train_stage(
133 |     stage_name: str,
134 |     model: nn.Module,
135 |     t: torch.Tensor,
136 |     m: torch.Tensor,
137 |     gt_hm: torch.Tensor,
138 |     gt_off: torch.Tensor,
139 |     gt_vr: torch.Tensor,
140 |     gt_lbl: torch.Tensor,
141 |     gt_vm: torch.Tensor,
142 |     epochs: int,
143 |     lr: float,
144 |     dense_weight: float = 0.0,
145 | ):
146 |     optim = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
147 |     hist = []
148 | 
149 |     for ep in range(epochs):
150 |         optim.zero_grad()
151 |         out = model(t, m)
152 |         losses = compute_mask_loss(
153 |             out["heatmap"],
154 |             out["offset"],
155 |             out["v_range"],
156 |             out["scores"],
157 |             gt_hm,
158 |             gt_off,
159 |             gt_vr,
160 |             gt_lbl,
161 |             gt_vm,
162 |         )
163 | 
164 |         dense = out["offset"].new_zeros(())
165 |         total = losses["total"]
166 |         if dense_weight > 0.0:
167 |             dense = dense_offset_loss_strong(
168 |                 pred_offset=out["offset"],
169 |                 gt_offset=gt_off,
170 |                 gt_valid_mask=gt_vm,
171 |                 pred_heatmap=out["heatmap"],
172 |                 gt_heatmap=gt_hm,
173 |                 weak_mix=0.25,
174 |             )
175 |             total = total + dense_weight * dense
176 | 
177 |         total.backward()
178 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
179 |         optim.step()
180 | 
181 |         hist.append(float(total.item()))
182 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
183 |             print(
184 |                 f"[{stage_name}] Epoch {ep:3d}: total={float(total.item()):.4f} "
185 |                 f"base={float(losses['total'].item()):.4f} dense={float(dense.item()):.4f}"
186 |             )
187 | 
188 |     init_loss = hist[0]
189 |     final_loss = hist[-1]
190 |     reduction = (init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-6) * 100.0
191 |     return {
192 |         "stage": stage_name,
193 |         "init": init_loss,
194 |         "final": final_loss,
195 |         "reduction": reduction,
196 |     }
197 | 
198 | 
199 | def run(epochs: int = 120, lr: float = 1e-3, seed: int = 0, dense_weight: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
200 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
201 |     np.random.seed(seed)
202 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
203 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
204 | 
205 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
206 |     b, l, c, h, w = 1, 7, 32, 10, 26
207 | 
208 |     t = torch.randn(l, b, c, device=device)
209 |     m = torch.randn(b, c, h, w, device=device)
210 |     t_blc = _t_to_blc(t, batch=b)
211 | 
212 |     gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
213 |         [
214 |             [(150, 300), (160, 250), (170, 200), (180, 150)],
215 |             [(410, 300), (400, 250), (390, 200), (380, 150)],
216 |         ],
217 |         img_h=360,
218 |         img_w=640,
219 |         feat_h=h,
220 |         feat_w=w,
221 |         num_lanes=l,
222 |     )
223 | 
224 |     gt_hm = gt["heatmap"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
225 |     gt_off = gt["offset"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
226 |     gt_vr = gt["v_range"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
227 |     gt_lbl = gt["labels"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
228 |     gt_vm = gt["valid_mask"].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
229 | 
230 |     # ortak başlangıç ağırlığı
231 |     baseline_template = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
232 | 
233 |     # A) baseline
234 |     head_a = DynamicMaskHead(num_queries=l, feat_dim=c, feat_h=h, feat_w=w).to(device)
235 |     head_a.load_state_dict(baseline_template.state_dict(), strict=True)
236 |     stage_a = _train_stage(
237 |         stage_name="A-baseline",
238 |         model=BaselineHeadAdapter(head_a),
239 |         t=t_blc,
240 |         m=m,
241 |         gt_hm=gt_hm,
242 |         gt_off=gt_off,
243 |         gt_vr=gt_vr,
244 |         gt_lbl=gt_lbl,
245 |         gt_vm=gt_vm,
246 |         epochs=epochs,
247 |         lr=lr,
248 |         dense_weight=0.0,
249 |     )
250 | 
251 |     # B) +coord

 45 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 46 |     expansion = 1
 47 |

 66 |

254 |     def forward(self, iteration, save, viz_split, outputs, targets):
255 |         del iteration, save, viz_split
256 | 
257 |         required = ["pred_heatmap", "pred_offset", "pred_vrange", "pred_scores"]
258 |         missing = [k for k in required if k not in outputs]
259 |         if missing:

261 |

263 |         pred_off = outputs["pred_offset"]
264 |         pred_vr = outputs["pred_vrange"]

268 |         device = pred_hm.device

271 |         if len(gt_label_tensors) < bsz:

273 |         elif len(gt_label_tensors) > bsz:

282 | 
283 |         mask_losses = compute_mask_loss(
284 |             pred_hm,
285 |             pred_off,
286 |             pred_vr,
287 |             pred_sc,

291 |             gt_lbl,

293 |         )

47 | def infer_feature_hw(model, input_h: int, input_w: int, device: torch.device) -> Tuple[int, int]:
48 |     x = torch.randn(1, 3, input_h, input_w, device=device)
49 |     p = model.conv1(x)
50 |     p = model.bn1(p)
51 |     p = model.relu(p)
52 |     p = model.maxpool(p)
53 |     p = model.layer1(p)
54 |     p = model.layer2(p)
55 |     p = model.layer3(p)
56 |     p = model.layer4(p)
57 |     return int(p.shape[-2]), int(p.shape[-1])

60 | def forward_to_decoder(model, images: torch.Tensor, masks: torch.Tensor):
61 |     """
62 |     Returns:
63 |         hs:      (num_layers, B, num_queries, C)
64 |         memory:  (B, C, H, W)
65 |         weights: encoder attention-like weights
66 |     """
67 |     p = model.conv1(images)
68 |     p = model.bn1(p)
69 |     p = model.relu(p)
70 |     p = model.maxpool(p)
71 |     p = model.layer1(p)
72 |     p = model.layer2(p)
73 |     p = model.layer3(p)
74 |     p = model.layer4(p)
75 | 
76 |     pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
77 |     pos = model.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
78 |     hs, memory, weights = model.transformer(model.input_proj(p), pmasks, model.query_embed.weight, pos)
79 |     return hs, memory, weights

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 2 — GT residual-reg üretimi.
  3 | 
  4 | Hedef:
  5 |   gt_reg[lane, row] = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / feat_w
  6 | 
  7 | Burada:
  8 |   - gt_x_coarse: gt heatmap weighted-argmax (sürekli)
  9 |   - gt_x_true  : tercihen gt_offset map'ten türetilen x (varsa)
 10 | """
 11 | 
 12 | import argparse
 13 | from typing import Dict, Optional
 14 | 
 15 | import torch
 16 | 
 17 | from config import system_configs
 18 | from db.culane import CULANE
 19 | from mask_migration.bolum1_gt_mask import labels_to_mask_batch_gt, lanes_to_mask_gt
 20 | from mask_migration.common import load_system_config
 21 | 
 22 | 
 23 | def compute_gt_reg(
 24 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,     # (L,H,W)
 25 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,  # (L,H)
 26 |     feat_w: int,
 27 |     gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # (L,H,W), optional
 28 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
 29 |     if gt_heatmap.dim() != 3:
 30 |         raise ValueError(f"gt_heatmap must be (L,H,W), got {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}")
 31 |     if gt_valid_mask.dim() != 2:
 32 |         raise ValueError(f"gt_valid_mask must be (L,H), got {tuple(gt_valid_mask.shape)}")
 33 | 
 34 |     lanes, h, w = gt_heatmap.shape
 35 |     if w != feat_w:
 36 |         raise ValueError(f"feat_w mismatch: heatmap W={w}, feat_w={feat_w}")
 37 | 
 38 |     cols = torch.arange(w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
 39 |     gt_x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, w)).sum(dim=-1)  # (L,H)
 40 | 
 41 |     if gt_offset is not None:
 42 |         if gt_offset.dim() != 3 or gt_offset.shape != gt_heatmap.shape:
 43 |             raise ValueError(f"gt_offset shape must be {tuple(gt_heatmap.shape)}, got {tuple(gt_offset.shape)}")
 44 |         # gt_offset[l,r,c] = gt_x_true - c -> c=0'dan gt_x_true alınabilir.
 45 |         gt_x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
 46 |     else:
 47 |         gt_x_true = gt_x_coarse
 48 | 
 49 |     reg = (gt_x_true - gt_x_coarse) / float(max(feat_w, 1))
 50 |     reg = reg * gt_valid_mask.float()
 51 |     return reg
 52 | 
 53 | 
 54 | def _round_trip_error(
 55 |     gt_heatmap: torch.Tensor,
 56 |     gt_reg: torch.Tensor,
 57 |     gt_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
 58 |     feat_w: int,
 59 |     gt_offset: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
 60 | ) -> float:
 61 |     cols = torch.arange(feat_w, dtype=gt_heatmap.dtype, device=gt_heatmap.device)
 62 |     x_coarse = (gt_heatmap * cols.view(1, 1, feat_w)).sum(dim=-1)
 63 |     x_recovered = x_coarse + gt_reg * feat_w
 64 | 
 65 |     if gt_offset is not None:
 66 |         x_true = gt_offset[:, :, 0]
 67 |     else:
 68 |         x_true = x_coarse
 69 | 
 70 |     valid = gt_valid_mask.bool()
 71 |     if not bool(valid.any().item()):
 72 |         return 0.0
 73 |     return float(torch.abs(x_recovered[valid] - x_true[valid]).mean().item())

 92 |     )

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 1 — GT mask üretici.
  3 | 
  4 | Bu modül hem script olarak çalışır hem de eğitim/loss tarafında utility olarak kullanılır.
  5 | """
  6 | from typing import Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple
  7 | 
  8 | import numpy as np
  9 | import torch
 10 | 
 11 | 
 12 | def _to_np_label(label_tensor) -> np.ndarray:
 13 |     if isinstance(label_tensor, torch.Tensor):
 14 |         arr = label_tensor.detach().cpu().numpy()
 15 |     else:
 16 |         arr = np.asarray(label_tensor)
 17 |     if arr.ndim == 3:
 18 |         arr = arr[0]
 19 |     return arr.astype(np.float32)
 20 | 
 21 | 
 22 | def label_tensor_to_lane_points(label_tensor) -> List[List[Tuple[float, float]]]:
 23 |     """
 24 |     LSTR label format -> normalized lane points list.
 25 | 
 26 |     label row format:
 27 |       [cls, lower, upper, x_0..x_{P-1}, y_0..y_{P-1}]
 28 |     where x/y are normalized [0,1], invalids are large negative values.
 29 |     """
 30 |     arr = _to_np_label(label_tensor)
 31 |     if arr.ndim != 2:
 32 |         raise ValueError(f"Expected 2D label tensor, got shape={arr.shape}")
 33 | 
 34 |     dim = arr.shape[1]
 35 |     max_points = (dim - 3) // 2
 36 | 
 37 |     lanes = []
 38 |     for lane in arr:
 39 |         if lane[0] <= 0:
 40 |             continue
 41 |         xs = lane[3 : 3 + max_points]
 42 |         ys = lane[3 + max_points : 3 + 2 * max_points]
 43 |         valid = (xs >= 0.0) & (ys >= 0.0)
 44 |         if not np.any(valid):
 45 |             continue
 46 |         pts = [(float(x), float(y)) for x, y in zip(xs[valid], ys[valid])]
 47 |         if len(pts) >= 2:
 48 |             lanes.append(pts)
 49 |     return lanes
 50 | 
 51 | 
 52 | def lanes_to_mask_gt(
 53 |     lanes_xy_list: Sequence[Sequence[Tuple[float, float]]],
 54 |     img_h: int = 360,
 55 |     img_w: int = 640,
 56 |     feat_h: int = 12,
 57 |     feat_w: int = 20,
 58 |     num_lanes: int = 7,
 59 |     normalized: bool = False,
 60 |     sigma: float = 1.5,
 61 | ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
 62 |     """
 63 |     lanes_xy_list:
 64 |       - normalized=False: points are pixel coordinates (x,y)
 65 |       - normalized=True:  points are normalized coordinates in [0,1]
 66 |     """
 67 |     heatmap = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w, dtype=torch.float32)
 68 |     offset = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, feat_w, dtype=torch.float32)
 69 |     v_range = torch.zeros(num_lanes, 2, dtype=torch.long)
 70 |     labels = torch.zeros(num_lanes, dtype=torch.long)
 71 |     valid_mask = torch.zeros(num_lanes, feat_h, dtype=torch.bool)
 72 | 
 73 |     cols = torch.arange(feat_w, dtype=torch.float32)
 74 | 
 75 |     for lane_idx, lane_pts in enumerate(lanes_xy_list):
 76 |         if lane_idx >= num_lanes:
 77 |             break
 78 |         if lane_pts is None or len(lane_pts) < 2:
 79 |             continue
 80 | 
 81 |         labels[lane_idx] = 1
 82 |         row_to_x = {}
 83 | 
 84 |         for x_in, y_in in lane_pts:
 85 |             if normalized:
 86 |                 x_norm = float(x_in)
 87 |                 y_norm = float(y_in)
 88 |             else:
 89 |                 x_norm = float(x_in) / float(img_w)
 90 |                 y_norm = float(y_in) / float(img_h)
 91 | 
 92 |             if not (0.0 <= x_norm <= 1.0 and 0.0 <= y_norm <= 1.0):
 93 |                 continue
 94 | 
 95 |             fr = int(round(y_norm * (feat_h - 1)))
 96 |             fx = x_norm * (feat_w - 1)
 97 |             if 0 <= fr < feat_h:
 98 |                 row_to_x.setdefault(fr, []).append(fx)
 99 | 
100 |         if not row_to_x:
101 |             labels[lane_idx] = 0
102 |             continue
103 | 
104 |         rows = sorted(row_to_x.keys())
105 |         v_range[lane_idx, 0] = rows[0]
106 |         v_range[lane_idx, 1] = rows[-1]
107 | 
108 |         for fr in rows:
109 |             fx = float(np.mean(row_to_x[fr]))
110 |             valid_mask[lane_idx, fr] = True
111 | 
112 |             dist = cols - fx
113 |             row_hm = torch.exp(-0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2)
114 |             row_sum = row_hm.sum()
115 |             if row_sum > 0:
116 |                 row_hm = row_hm / row_sum
117 | 
118 |             heatmap[lane_idx, fr, :] = row_hm
119 |             offset[lane_idx, fr, :] = fx - cols
120 | 
121 |     return {
122 |         "heatmap": heatmap,
123 |         "offset": offset,
124 |         "v_range": v_range,
125 |         "labels": labels,
126 |         "valid_mask": valid_mask,
127 |     }
128 | 
129 | 
130 | def labels_to_mask_batch_gt(
131 |     label_tensors: Sequence,
132 |     feat_h: int,
133 |     feat_w: int,
134 |     num_lanes: int = 7,
135 | ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
136 |     hm, off, vr, lbl, vm = [], [], [], [], []
137 |     for lt in label_tensors:
138 |         lanes_norm = label_tensor_to_lane_points(lt)
139 |         gt = lanes_to_mask_gt(
140 |             lanes_norm,
141 |             feat_h=feat_h,
142 |             feat_w=feat_w,
143 |             num_lanes=num_lanes,
144 |             normalized=True,
145 |         )
146 |         hm.append(gt["heatmap"])
147 |         off.append(gt["offset"])
148 |         vr.append(gt["v_range"])
149 |         lbl.append(gt["labels"])
150 |         vm.append(gt["valid_mask"])
151 | 
152 |     return {
153 |         "heatmap": torch.stack(hm, dim=0),
154 |         "offset": torch.stack(off, dim=0),
155 |         "v_range": torch.stack(vr, dim=0),
156 |         "labels": torch.stack(lbl, dim=0),
157 |         "valid_mask": torch.stack(vm, dim=0),
158 |     }
159 |
