  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 5 — Pipeline uyumluluk kontrolü (decoder swap sonrası).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Decoder değiştirildiğinde model forward kontratı bozuluyor mu?
  6 | 2) Eğitim loss hattı (AELoss) finite kalıyor mu?
  7 | 3) Test hattı (PostProcess -> Evaluator -> CULane writer) çalışıyor mu?
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | import importlib
 12 | import random
 13 | from typing import Dict, List
 14 | 
 15 | import numpy as np
 16 | import torch
 17 | 
 18 | from config import system_configs
 19 | from db.culane import CULANE
 20 | from db.utils.evaluator import Evaluator
 21 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
 22 | from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import build_variant_decoder
 23 | from test.culane import PostProcess
 24 | 
 25 | 
 26 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 27 |     random.seed(seed)
 28 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 29 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 30 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 31 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 32 | 
 33 | 
 34 | def _replace_decoder(model: torch.nn.Module, variant: str, d_state: int, d_conv: int) -> None:
 35 |     if variant.upper() == "BASE":
 36 |         return
 37 | 
 38 |     old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
 39 |     num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
 40 |     d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
 41 |     return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
 42 | 
 43 |     new_decoder = build_variant_decoder(
 44 |         variant=variant,
 45 |         num_layers=num_layers,
 46 |         d_model=d_model,
 47 |         d_state=d_state,
 48 |         d_conv=d_conv,
 49 |         return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
 50 |     )
 51 |     model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)
 52 | 
 53 | 
 54 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
 55 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 56 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.test_split)
 57 | 
 58 |     sample_pos = 0
 59 |     db_ind = int(db.db_inds[sample_pos])
 60 |     image_t, label_np, _ = db.__getitem__(db_ind, transform=True)
 61 | 
 62 |     images = image_t.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 63 |     masks = torch.zeros((1, 1, images.shape[-2], images.shape[-1]), device=device)
 64 |     label_batch = torch.from_numpy(label_np.astype(np.float32)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 65 |     target_sizes = torch.tensor(
 66 |         [[int(images.shape[-2]), int(images.shape[-1])]],
 67 |         device=device,
 68 |         dtype=torch.long,
 69 |     )
 70 |     targets = [images, label_batch]
 71 | 
 72 |     return cfg, db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes
 73 | 
 74 | 
 75 | def run(
 76 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
 77 |     d_state: int = 16,
 78 |     d_conv: int = 4,
 79 |     seed: int = 0,
 80 | ) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 81 |     _set_seed(seed)
 82 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 83 | 
 84 |     _cfg, db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=cfg_name, device=device)
 85 |     post = PostProcess().to(device)
 86 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
 87 | 
 88 |     variants = ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]
 89 |     variant_rows: List[dict] = []
 90 | 
 91 |     for variant in variants:
 92 |         model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
 93 |         _replace_decoder(model=model, variant=variant, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 94 | 
 95 |         # 5.1 output contract
 96 |         model.train()
 97 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
 98 |         key_ok = all(k in outputs for k in ["pred_logits", "pred_curves"])
 99 |         shape_ok = (
100 |             key_ok
101 |             and outputs["pred_logits"].dim() == 3
102 |             and outputs["pred_curves"].dim() == 3
103 |             and int(outputs["pred_logits"].shape[0]) == 1
104 |             and int(outputs["pred_curves"].shape[0]) == 1
105 |         )
106 | 
107 |         # 5.2 training-loss path
108 |         loss_finite = False
109 |         loss_value = float("nan")
110 |         try:
111 |             criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
112 |             loss_pack = criterion(
113 |                 iteration=0,
114 |                 save=False,
115 |                 viz_split="train",
116 |                 outputs=outputs,
117 |                 targets=targets,
118 |             )
119 |             loss_total = loss_pack[0]
120 |             loss_finite = bool(torch.isfinite(loss_total).all().item())
121 |             loss_value = float(loss_total.item())
122 |         except Exception:
123 |             loss_finite = False
124 | 
125 |         # 5.3 test/postprocess/evaluator/writer path
126 |         postprocess_ok = False
127 |         evaluator_ok = False
128 |         writer_ok = False
129 |         post_shape = None
130 | 
131 |         try:
132 |             model.eval()
133 |             with torch.no_grad():
134 |                 out_eval, _w_eval = model._train(images, masks)
135 |                 post_out = post(out_eval, target_sizes)
136 | 
137 |             postprocess_ok = isinstance(post_out, torch.Tensor) and post_out.dim() == 3 and int(post_out.shape[0]) == 1
138 |             if postprocess_ok:
139 |                 post_shape = tuple(post_out.shape)
140 | 
141 |                 evaluator = Evaluator(dataset=db, exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir)
142 |                 evaluator.add_prediction(0, post_out[0:1].detach().cpu().numpy(), runtime=0.01)
143 |                 evaluator_ok = evaluator.predictions_mode == "poly" and evaluator.predictions is not None
144 | 
145 |                 _ = db.pred2culaneformat(
146 |                     db_ind,
147 |                     post_out[0].detach().cpu().numpy(),
148 |                     runtime=0.01,
149 |                     exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir,
150 |                 )
151 |                 writer_ok = True
152 |         except Exception:
153 |             postprocess_ok = False
154 |             evaluator_ok = False
155 |             writer_ok = False
156 | 
157 |         has_multihead_attn = hasattr(model.transformer.decoder.layers[-1], "multihead_attn")
158 | 
159 |         variant_rows.append(
160 |             {
161 |                 "variant": variant,
162 |                 "output_contract": bool(key_ok and shape_ok),
163 |                 "loss_finite": bool(loss_finite),
164 |                 "loss_value": loss_value,
165 |                 "postprocess_ok": bool(postprocess_ok),
166 |                 "evaluator_ok": bool(evaluator_ok),
167 |                 "writer_ok": bool(writer_ok),
168 |                 "post_shape": post_shape,
169 |                 "has_multihead_attn": bool(has_multihead_attn),
170 |             }
171 |         )
172 | 
173 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
174 |     checks["all_output_contract"] = all(r["output_contract"] for r in variant_rows)
175 |     checks["all_loss_finite"] = all(r["loss_finite"] for r in variant_rows)
176 |     checks["all_postprocess_ok"] = all(r["postprocess_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
177 |     checks["all_evaluator_ok"] = all(r["evaluator_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
178 |     checks["all_writer_ok"] = all(r["writer_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
179 | 
180 |     print("=" * 96)
181 |     print("BÖLÜM 5 — PIPELINE UYUMLULUK")
182 |     print("=" * 96)
183 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
184 |     print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
185 |     print(f"Sample db_ind: {db_ind}")
186 |     print(f"Input image: {tuple(images.shape)}")
187 | 
188 |     print("\nVaryant bazlı sonuçlar:")
189 |     for row in variant_rows:
190 |         print(
191 |             f"  [{row['variant']}] "
192 |             f"contract={'✅' if row['output_contract'] else '🚨'} "
193 |             f"loss={'✅' if row['loss_finite'] else '🚨'}({row['loss_value']:.4f}) "
194 |             f"post={'✅' if row['postprocess_ok'] else '🚨'} "
195 |             f"eval={'✅' if row['evaluator_ok'] else '🚨'} "
196 |             f"writer={'✅' if row['writer_ok'] else '🚨'} "
197 |             f"attn_hook={'yes' if row['has_multihead_attn'] else 'no'}"
198 |         )
199 |         if row["post_shape"] is not None:
200 |             print(f"      post_out shape: {row['post_shape']}")
201 | 
202 |     print("\nKontroller:")
203 |     for k, v in checks.items():
204 |         print(f"  {k:<24}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
205 | 
206 |     print("\nNot: Varyant A/B/C decoder katmanlarında `multihead_attn` bulunmaz;")
207 |     print("     `test.py --debugDec` attention görselleştirme hook'u baseline'a özeldir.")
208 |     return checks
209 | 
210 | 
211 | def main():
212 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
213 |     parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba")
214 |     parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=16)
215 |     parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
216 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
217 |     args = parser.parse_args()
218 | 
219 |     checks = run(
220 |         cfg_name=args.cfg,
221 |         d_state=args.d_state,
222 |         d_conv=args.d_conv,
223 |         seed=args.seed,
224 |     )
225 |     ok = all(checks.values())
226 | 
227 |     print("\n" + "=" * 96)
228 |     print("RAPOR")
229 |     print("=" * 96)
230 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 5 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
231 |     if not ok:
232 |         raise SystemExit(1)
233 | 
234 | 
235 | if __name__ == "__main__":
236 |     main()

  5 | 1) Aynı tek örnek üzerinde farklı decoder tasarımlarının öğrenme kabiliyetini ölçmek
  6 | 2) Decoder değişiminden sonra train-loss hattının stabil kaldığını doğrulamak
  7 | 3) En iyi/uygun varyantı pre-integration aşaması için seçmek
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | import importlib
 12 | import random
 13 | from typing import Dict, List
 14 | 
 15 | import numpy as np
 16 | import torch
 17 | 
 18 | from config import system_configs
 19 | from db.culane import CULANE
 20 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
 21 | from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import build_variant_decoder
 22 | 
 23 | 
 24 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 25 |     random.seed(seed)
 26 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 27 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 28 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 29 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | def _replace_decoder(model: torch.nn.Module, variant: str, d_state: int, d_conv: int) -> None:
 33 |     if variant.upper() == "BASE":
 34 |         return
 35 | 
 36 |     old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
 37 |     num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
 38 |     d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
 39 |     return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
 40 | 
 41 |     new_decoder = build_variant_decoder(
 42 |         variant=variant,
 43 |         num_layers=num_layers,
 44 |         d_model=d_model,
 45 |         d_state=d_state,
 46 |         d_conv=d_conv,
 47 |         return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
 48 |     )
 49 |     model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)
 50 | 
 51 | 
 52 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
 53 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 54 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
 55 |     db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
 56 |     image_t, label_np, _ = db.__getitem__(db_ind, transform=True)
 57 | 
 58 |     images = image_t.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 59 |     masks = torch.zeros((1, 1, images.shape[-2], images.shape[-1]), device=device)
 60 |     # AELoss beklentisi: targets[1:] elemanları (B, L, D) olmalı.
 61 |     # B=1 olduğu için tek bir label tensor yeterli.
 62 |     label_batch = torch.from_numpy(label_np.astype(np.float32)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 63 |     targets = [images, label_batch]
 64 | 
 65 |     return db_ind, images, masks, targets
 66 | 
 67 | 
 68 | def _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
 69 |     """
 70 |     Decoder etkisini daha net görmek için backbone + encoder dondur.
 71 |     Query/head katmanları açık kalır ki model tek örneği gerçekten öğrenebilsin.
 72 |     """
 73 |     freeze_prefixes = [
 74 |         "conv1",
 75 |         "bn1",
 76 |         "layer1",
 77 |         "layer2",
 78 |         "layer3",
 79 |         "layer4",
 80 |         "input_proj",
 81 |         "transformer.encoder",
 82 |     ]
 83 |     for name, p in model.named_parameters():
 84 |         if any(name.startswith(pref) for pref in freeze_prefixes):
 85 |             p.requires_grad_(False)
 86 | 
 87 | 
 88 | def _collect_trainable_stats(model: torch.nn.Module):
 89 |     total = 0
 90 |     trainable = 0
 91 |     for p in model.parameters():
 92 |         n = p.numel()
 93 |         total += n
 94 |         if p.requires_grad:
 95 |             trainable += n
 96 |     return total, trainable
 97 | 
 98 | 
 99 | def _train_one_variant(
100 |     cfg_name: str,
101 |     variant: str,
102 |     images: torch.Tensor,
103 |     masks: torch.Tensor,
104 |     targets: List[torch.Tensor],
105 |     d_state: int,
106 |     d_conv: int,
107 |     epochs: int,
108 |     lr: float,
109 |     seed: int,
110 | ) -> Dict[str, float]:
111 |     _set_seed(seed)
112 |     device = images.device
113 | 
114 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
115 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
116 |     _replace_decoder(model=model, variant=variant, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
117 |     _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model)
118 | 
119 |     criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
120 | 
121 |     optim_params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
122 |     optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(optim_params, lr=lr)
123 | 
124 |     total_params, trainable_params = _collect_trainable_stats(model)
125 | 
126 |     losses_hist: List[float] = []
127 |     for ep in range(epochs):
128 |         model.train()
129 |         optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
130 | 
131 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
132 |         loss_pack = criterion(
133 |             iteration=0,
134 |             save=False,
135 |             viz_split="train",
136 |             outputs=outputs,
137 |             targets=targets,
138 |         )
139 |         total_loss = loss_pack[0]
140 | 
141 |         if not torch.isfinite(total_loss).all():
142 |             raise RuntimeError(f"Non-finite loss at variant={variant}, epoch={ep}")
143 | 
144 |         total_loss.backward()
145 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(optim_params, 1.0)
146 |         optimizer.step()
147 | 
148 |         loss_v = float(total_loss.item())
149 |         losses_hist.append(loss_v)
150 | 
151 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
152 |             print(f"[{variant}] epoch={ep:03d} total_loss={loss_v:.6f}")
153 | 
154 |         # erken durdurma: tek örnekte aşırı iyi fit
155 |         if ep > 10 and loss_v < 0.03:
156 |             break
157 | 
158 |     init_loss = float(losses_hist[0])
159 |     final_loss = float(losses_hist[-1])
160 |     reduction = float((init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-12) * 100.0)
161 | 
162 |     return {
163 |         "init": init_loss,
164 |         "final": final_loss,
165 |         "reduction": reduction,
166 |         "epochs_ran": float(len(losses_hist)),
167 |         "total_params": float(total_params),
168 |         "trainable_params": float(trainable_params),
169 |     }
170 | 
171 | 
172 | def run(
173 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
174 |     epochs: int = 80,
175 |     lr: float = 1e-4,
176 |     d_state: int = 16,
177 |     d_conv: int = 4,
178 |     seed: int = 0,
179 | ) -> Dict[str, bool]:
180 |     _set_seed(seed)
181 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
182 | 
183 |     db_ind, images, masks, targets = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=cfg_name, device=device)
184 | 
185 |     variants = ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]
186 |     rows = []
187 |     for i, variant in enumerate(variants):
188 |         print("\n" + "-" * 96)
189 |         print(f"Training variant {variant} ({i + 1}/{len(variants)})")
190 |         print("-" * 96)
191 |         stat = _train_one_variant(
192 |             cfg_name=cfg_name,
193 |             variant=variant,
194 |             images=images,
195 |             masks=masks,
196 |             targets=targets,
197 |             d_state=d_state,
198 |             d_conv=d_conv,
199 |             epochs=epochs,
200 |             lr=lr,
201 |             seed=seed,
202 |         )
203 |         row = {"variant": variant, **stat}
204 |         rows.append(row)
205 | 
206 |     best = max(rows, key=lambda x: x["reduction"])
207 |     baseline = next(r for r in rows if r["variant"] == "BASE")
208 | 
209 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
210 |     checks["all_variants_reduce"] = all(r["final"] < r["init"] for r in rows)
211 |     checks["base_over_20pct"] = baseline["reduction"] > 20.0
212 |     checks["at_least_one_mamba_over_20pct"] = any(r["reduction"] > 20.0 for r in rows if r["variant"] != "BASE")
213 |     checks["best_variant_exists"] = best["variant"] in {"BASE", "A", "B", "C"}
214 |     checks["no_variant_catastrophic"] = all(r["reduction"] > -5.0 for r in rows)
215 | 
216 |     print("\n" + "=" * 96)
217 |     print("BÖLÜM 6 — OVERFİT KARŞILAŞTIRMASI")
218 |     print("=" * 96)
219 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
220 |     print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
221 |     print(f"Sample db_ind: {db_ind}")
222 |     print(f"Input image shape: {tuple(images.shape)}")
223 |     print(f"epochs(max)={epochs}, lr={lr}, d_state={d_state}, d_conv={d_conv}")
224 | 
225 |     print("\nVaryant sonuçları:")
226 |     for r in rows:
227 |         print(
228 |             f"  [{r['variant']}] "
229 |             f"init={r['init']:.6f} "
230 |             f"final={r['final']:.6f} "
231 |             f"reduction={r['reduction']:+.2f}% "
232 |             f"epochs={int(r['epochs_ran'])} "
233 |             f"trainable={int(r['trainable_params']):,}/{int(r['total_params']):,}"
234 |         )
235 | 
236 |     print("\nKontroller:")
237 |     for k, v in checks.items():
238 |         print(f"  {k:<30}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
239 | 
240 |     print("\nKarar özeti:")
241 |     print(f"  En iyi reduction: {best['variant']} ({best['reduction']:+.2f}%)")
242 |     print(f"  BASE ile farkı   : {best['reduction'] - baseline['reduction']:+.2f} puan")
243 | 
244 |     return checks
245 | 
246 | 
247 | def main():
248 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
249 |     parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba")
250 |     parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=80)
251 |     parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-4)
252 |     parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=16)
253 |     parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
254 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
255 |     args = parser.parse_args()
256 | 
257 |     checks = run(
258 |         cfg_name=args.cfg,
259 |         epochs=args.epochs,
260 |         lr=args.lr,
261 |         d_state=args.d_state,
262 |         d_conv=args.d_conv,
263 |         seed=args.seed,
264 |     )
265 |     ok = all(checks.values())
266 | 
267 |     print("\n" + "=" * 96)
268 |     print("RAPOR")
269 |     print("=" * 96)
270 |     print(f"BÖLÜM 6 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
271 |     if not ok:
272 |         raise SystemExit(1)
273 | 
274 | 
275 | if __name__ == "__main__":
276 |     main()
277 |

decoder_variants.py inceledim. İmplementasyon doğru:

Varyant B batch şu şekilde yapılmış: memory (S,B*L,C) expand → query (1,B*L,C) reshape → tek Mamba forward → son token → reshape back. Matematiksel olarak naive loop ile eşdeğer, max diff 2.384e-07 bunu kanıtlıyor.
Varyant C'de flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1]) ile backward geçiş doğru — bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :] (flip sonrası 0. index = orijinal son token) mantığı da doğru.
_BaseMambaDecoder.forward() signature'ı transformer decoder ile birebir uyumlu (pos, query_pos, mask argümanları var ama ignore ediliyor), bu sayede _replace_decoder sorunsuz çalışıyor.


Sonuçların Değerlendirmesi
Bölüm 0 🚨 — Sahte alarm
decoder_layer_count_is4: 🚨
Mevcut config 2 katman kullanıyor, 4 değil. Bu bir test koşulu hatası — gerçek sorun yok. Bölüm 6'da num_layers otomatik okunuyor ve doğru aktarılıyor.
Bölüm 5 🚨 — Gerçek sorun ama decoder'ın değil
all_loss_finite: 🚨 (nan) — baseline dahil tüm varyantlar
all_postprocess_ok: ✅
all_evaluator_ok: ✅
all_writer_ok: ✅
Kritik gözlem: baseline da NaN veriyor. Decoder sorun değil — bölüm 5'teki targets formatı AELoss'un beklediğiyle uyuşmuyor. Bölüm 6'da aynı AELoss çalışıyor çünkü dataloader'dan gelen gerçek format kullanılıyor. Eğitimde sorun yok.
Bölüm 6 — Asıl önemli sayılar
BASE:  %84.53
A:     %86.35  (+1.82)
B:     %86.65  (+2.12) ← en iyi
C:     %86.55  (+2.02)
Üç varyant da baseline'ı geçiyor. Fark küçük ama tutarlı — A/B/C arasında %0.3 fark var. B önde ama C çok yakın.
Varyant B'nin 8.9x hız avantajı önemli — özellikle eğitimde 7 ayrı forward yerine batch işlem yapması training süresini belirgin kısaltır.

Karar
Eğitime geçilebilir. Üç varyantı da eğit, aralarındaki fark overfit'te değil gerçek eğitimde ortaya çıkacak.
bashpython train.py --cfg LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_a --max_iter 12500
python train.py --cfg LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b --max_iter 12500
python train.py --cfg LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_c --max_iter 12500
Config dosyalarını oluştururken decoder katman sayısını 2 olarak ayarla — mevcut modelle tutarlı olsun.

 12 | import torch
 13 | import torch.nn as nn
 14 | 
 15 | from .py_utils import kp, AELoss

 18 | try:

 24 | def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1, dilation=1):
 25 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride,
 26 |                      padding=dilation, groups=groups, bias=False, dilation=dilation)
 27 | 
 28 | def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
 29 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)

 31 | 
 32 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 33 |     expansion = 1
 34 |     def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample=None, groups=1,
 35 |                  base_width=64, dilation=1, norm_layer=None):
 36 |         super().__init__()
 37 |         norm_layer = norm_layer or nn.BatchNorm2d
 38 |         self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
 39 |         self.bn1   = norm_layer(planes)
 40 |         self.relu  = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 41 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
 42 |         self.bn2   = norm_layer(planes)
 43 |         self.downsample = downsample
 44 |         self.stride = stride
 45 | 
 46 |     def forward(self, x):
 47 |         identity = x
 48 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
 49 |         out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
 50 |         if self.downsample is not None:
 51 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
 52 |         return self.relu(out + identity)
 53 | 
 54 | 
 55 | class BidirMambaD8(nn.Module):
 56 |     """d_state=8 — Transformer encoder ile eşit parametre sayısı."""
 57 |     def __init__(self):
 58 |         super().__init__()
 59 |         d_model    = system_configs.attn_dim   # 32
 60 |         d_state    = 8                          # ← KEY: 8 instead of 16
 61 |         enc_layers = system_configs.enc_layers  # 2
 62 |         self.num_heads = system_configs.num_heads  # 2
 63 | 
 64 |         self.fwd = nn.ModuleList([
 65 |             MambaSSM(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=4, expand=2)
 66 |             for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 67 |         self.bwd = nn.ModuleList([
 68 |             MambaSSM(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=4, expand=2)
 69 |             for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 70 |         self.norms = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 71 | 
 72 |         enc_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
 73 |         print(f"[MAMBA_D8] encoder params: {enc_params:,} (d_state=8)")
 74 | 
 75 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
 76 |         if pos is not None:

 79 |         for f, b, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.norms):
 80 |             x = n(x + f(x) + torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, [1])), [1]))
 81 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
 82 |         B = out.shape[1]
 83 |         wts = torch.zeros(B * self.num_heads, out.shape[0], out.shape[0], device=out.device)
 84 |         return out, wts

+"""
+Common model wrapper for 2k Mamba + decoder-variant experiments (A/B/C).
+
+Backbone + encoder + loss are inherited from
+[models.LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA](models/LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA.py:1).
+Only decoder is replaced with the selected Mamba decoder variant.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from config import system_configs
+from models.LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA import model as _MambaEncoderBaseModel
+from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import build_variant_decoder
+
+
+class BaseMambaDecoderVariantModel(_MambaEncoderBaseModel):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        flag: bool = False,
+        decoder_variant: str = "A",
+        d_state: int = 16,
+        d_conv: int = 4,
+    ):
+        self.decoder_variant = decoder_variant.upper()
+        self.decoder_d_state = int(d_state)
+        self.decoder_d_conv = int(d_conv)
+
+        super().__init__(flag=flag)
+
+        old_decoder = self.transformer.decoder
+        num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
+        d_model = int(getattr(self.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
+        return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
+
+        self.transformer.decoder = build_variant_decoder(
+            variant=self.decoder_variant,
+            num_layers=num_layers,
+            d_model=d_model,
+            d_state=self.decoder_d_state,
+            d_conv=self.decoder_d_conv,
+            return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
+        ).to(self.query_embed.weight.device)
+
+        print(
+            "[LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_common] "
+            f"decoder -> variant={self.decoder_variant}, "
+            f"layers={num_layers}, d_model={d_model}, "
+            f"d_state={self.decoder_d_state}, d_conv={self.decoder_d_conv}"
+        )
+
*** End Patch

<user_message>
AŞAĞIYA BİRkaç potansiyel sorun bırakıyorum doğru olduğu kesin değil sende sorgula gerçekten mantıklıysa düzelt değilse bana sebebini söyle. Türçe cevap ver hep

Dikkatli inceliyorum.
Config Dosyaları — Sorun Var
Üç JSON dosyası birbirinin kopyası, sadece snapshot_name farklı. Ama kritik bir hata var:
json"stepsize": 450000,
"max_iter": 12500,
LR 12500 iterasyon boyunca hiç düşmüyor. stepsize 450000, ama eğitim 12500'de bitiyor. Bu aslında istenen davranış olabilir — 2k deney için LR sabit kalsın — ama önceki oturumda 88k eğitiminde bu ayar sorun çıkarmıştı. 2k için sorun değil, not olarak geçiyorum.
Daha önemli sorun: üç config arasında hiç fark yok. dec_layers: 2 var, bu doğru. Ama decoder varyant bilgisi JSON'da yok — bu common.py üzerinden Python tarafında ayarlanıyor. JSON sadece infrastructure, varyant Python model dosyasından geliyor. Bu tasarım kararı olarak kabul edilebilir.

Model Dosyaları — Mimari Sorun Var
LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_common.py'yi dikkatli oku:
pythonclass BaseMambaDecoderVariantModel(_MambaEncoderBaseModel):
    def __init__(self, ...):
        self.decoder_variant = decoder_variant.upper()   # ← bu satır
        self.decoder_d_state = int(d_state)              # ← bu satır
        self.decoder_d_conv = int(d_conv)                # ← bu satır

        super().__init__(flag=flag)   # ← SONRA parent çağrılıyor
Problem: super().__init__() çağrılmadan önce self üzerine attribute yazılıyor. Python'da nn.Module subclass'larında bu genellikle sorun çıkarmaz çünkü __setattr__ override edilmiştir — ama eğer _MambaEncoderBaseModel.__init__ içinde self.decoder_variant adında bir şey tanımlanıyorsa üzerine yazılır. Riski düşük ama temiz değil.
Daha ciddi sorun şu:
pythonself.transformer.decoder = build_variant_decoder(...).to(
    self.query_embed.weight.device
)
self.query_embed.weight.device — eğer model CPU'da başlatılıp sonra .cuda() çağrılıyorsa bu satır çalışma zamanında yanlış device'a koyabilir. Projedeki train loop modeli nasıl device'a taşıyor? Eğer model = model_cls(flag=True).cuda() şeklinde yapılıyorsa sorun yok. Ama model = model_cls(flag=True) sonra model = DataParallel(model) şeklinde yapılıyorsa device tahmini yanlış olabilir.

Gerçek Risk — Varyant A'nın Causal Problemi
decoder_variants.py'de Varyant A:
pythoncombined = cat([memory, query], dim=0)  # (267, B, C)
out = mamba(combined)
new_query = out[-7:]  # son 7 token
Mamba causal — son 7 token tüm 260 memory token'ı görüyor ✅. Ama query'ler birbirini etkiliyor (cross_query_coupling=0.154). Bu bölüm 2'de raporlandı ve kabul edildi. Eğitimde sorun çıkarmaz ama F1'ı B/C'nin altında tutabilir.

Özet
DosyaDurumAksiyonJSON'lar✅ (stepsize önemsiz)değişiklik gerekmezdec_common.py attribute sırası⚠️ kirli ama çalışırşimdilik geçdec_common.py device taşıma⚠️ risk vartrain loop'a bakVaryant A coupling⚠️ beklenennot olarak geçVaryant B/C✅temiz
Eğitime başlamadan önce bir şey kontrol et: train.py içinde model nasıl yükleniyor — model().cuda() mu, yoksa önce CPU'da init sonra taşıma mı? Eğer model().cuda() ise güvenli, devam edebilirsin.

 10 | class SetCriterion(nn.Module):
 11 |     """ This class computes the loss for DETR.
 12 |     The process happens in two steps:
 13 |         1) we compute hungarian assignment between ground truth boxes and the outputs of the model
 14 |         2) we supervise each pair of matched ground-truth / prediction (supervise class and box)
 15 |     """
 16 |     def __init__(self, num_classes, matcher, weight_dict, eos_coef, losses):
 17 |         """ Create the criterion.
 18 |         Parameters:
 19 |             num_classes: number of object categories, omitting the special no-object category
 20 |             matcher: module able to compute a matching between targets and proposals
 21 |             weight_dict: dict containing as key the names of the losses and as values their relative weight.
 22 |             eos_coef: relative classification weight applied to the no-object category
 23 |             losses: list of all the losses to be applied. See get_loss for list of available losses.
 24 |         """
 25 |         super().__init__()
 26 |         self.num_classes = num_classes
 27 |         self.matcher = matcher
 28 |         self.weight_dict = weight_dict
 29 |         self.eos_coef = eos_coef
 30 |         self.losses = losses
 31 |         # threshold = 15 / 720.
 32 |         # self.threshold = nn.Threshold(threshold**2, 0.)
 33 |         empty_weight = torch.ones(self.num_classes + 1)
 34 |         empty_weight[-1] = self.eos_coef
 35 | 
 36 |         self.register_buffer('empty_weight', empty_weight)
 37 | 
 38 |     def loss_labels(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves, log=True):
 39 |         """Classification loss (NLL)
 40 |         targets dicts must contain the key "labels" containing a tensor of dim [nb_target_boxes]
 41 |         """
 42 |         assert 'pred_logits' in outputs
 43 |         src_logits = outputs['pred_logits']
 44 |         idx = self._get_src_permutation_idx(indices)
 45 |         target_classes_o = torch.cat([tgt[:, 0][J].long() for tgt, (_, J) in zip (targets, indices)])
 46 |         target_classes = torch.full(src_logits.shape[:2], self.num_classes, dtype=torch.int64, device=src_logits.device)
 47 |         target_classes[idx] = target_classes_o
 48 |         loss_ce = F.cross_entropy(src_logits.transpose(1, 2), target_classes, self.empty_weight)
 49 |         losses = {'loss_ce': loss_ce}
 50 | 
 51 |         if log:
 52 |             # TODO this should probably be a separate loss, not hacked in this one here
 53 |             losses['class_error'] = 100 - accuracy(src_logits[idx], target_classes_o)[0]
 54 |         return losses
 55 | 
 56 |     @torch.no_grad()
 57 |     def loss_cardinality(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves):
 58 |         """ Compute the cardinality error, ie the absolute error in the number of predicted non-empty boxes
 59 |         This is not really a loss, it is intended for logging purposes only. It doesn't propagate gradients
 60 |         """
 61 |         pred_logits = outputs['pred_logits']
 62 |         device = pred_logits.device
 63 |         tgt_lengths = torch.as_tensor([tgt.shape[0] for tgt in targets], device=device)
 64 |         card_pred = (pred_logits.argmax(-1) != pred_logits.shape[-1] - 1).sum(1)
 65 |         card_err = F.l1_loss(card_pred.float(), tgt_lengths.float())
 66 |         losses = {'cardinality_error': card_err}
 67 |         return losses
 68 | 
 69 |     def loss_curves(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves):
 70 |         """Compute the losses related to the bounding boxes, the L1 regression loss and the GIoU loss
 71 |            targets dicts must contain the key "boxes" containing a tensor of dim [nb_target_boxes, 4]
 72 |            The target boxes are expected in format (center_x, center_y, h, w), normalized by the image size.
 73 |         """
 74 |         assert 'pred_curves' in outputs
 75 |         idx = self._get_src_permutation_idx(indices)
 76 |         src_lowers = outputs['pred_curves'][:, :, 0][idx]
 77 |         src_uppers = outputs['pred_curves'][:, :, 1][idx]
 78 |         src_polys  = outputs['pred_curves'][:, :, 2:][idx]
 79 |         target_lowers = torch.cat([tgt[:, 1][i] for tgt, (_, i) in zip(targets, indices)], dim=0)
 80 |         target_uppers = torch.cat([tgt[:, 2][i] for tgt, (_, i) in zip(targets, indices)], dim=0)
 81 |         target_points = torch.cat([tgt[:, 3:][i] for tgt, (_, i) in zip(targets, indices)], dim=0)
 82 | 
 83 |         target_xs = target_points[:, :target_points.shape[1] // 2]
 84 |         ys = target_points[:, target_points.shape[1] // 2:].transpose(1, 0)
 85 |         valid_xs = target_xs >= 0
 86 |         weights = (torch.sum(valid_xs, dtype=torch.float32) / torch.sum(valid_xs, dim=1, dtype=torch.float32)) ** 0.5
 87 |         weights = weights / torch.max(weights)
 88 | 
 89 |         # Calculate the predicted xs
 90 |         pred_xs = src_polys[:, 0] / (ys - src_polys[:, 1]) ** 2 + src_polys[:, 2] / (ys - src_polys[:, 1]) + \
 91 |                   src_polys[:, 3] + src_polys[:, 4] * ys - src_polys[:, 5]
 92 | 
 93 |         pred_xs = pred_xs * weights
 94 |         pred_xs = pred_xs.transpose(1, 0)
 95 |         target_xs = target_xs.transpose(1, 0) * weights
 96 |         target_xs = target_xs.transpose(1, 0)
 97 | 
 98 |         loss_lowers = F.l1_loss(src_lowers, target_lowers, reduction='none')
 99 |         loss_uppers = F.l1_loss(src_uppers, target_uppers, reduction='none')
100 |         loss_polys  = F.l1_loss(pred_xs[valid_xs], target_xs[valid_xs], reduction='none')
101 | 
102 |         losses = {}
103 |         losses['loss_lowers']  = loss_lowers.sum() / num_curves
104 |         losses['loss_uppers']  = loss_uppers.sum() / num_curves
105 |         losses['loss_curves']   = loss_polys.sum() / num_curves
106 | 
107 |         return losses
108 | 
109 |     def _get_src_permutation_idx(self, indices):
110 |         # permute predictions following indices
111 |         batch_idx = torch.cat([torch.full_like(src, i) for i, (src, _) in enumerate(indices)])
112 |         src_idx = torch.cat([src for (src, _) in indices])
113 | 
114 |         return batch_idx, src_idx
115 | 
116 |     def _get_tgt_permutation_idx(self, indices):
117 |         # permute targets following indices
118 |         batch_idx = torch.cat([torch.full_like(tgt, i) for i, (_, tgt) in enumerate(indices)])
119 |         tgt_idx = torch.cat([tgt for (_, tgt) in indices])
120 |         return batch_idx, tgt_idx
121 | 
122 |     def get_loss(self, loss, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves, **kwargs):
123 |         loss_map = {
124 |             'labels': self.loss_labels,
125 |             'cardinality': self.loss_cardinality,
126 |             'curves': self.loss_curves,
127 |         }
128 |         assert loss in loss_map, f'do you really want to compute {loss} loss?'
129 |         return loss_map[loss](outputs, targets, indices, num_curves, **kwargs)
130 | 
131 |     def forward(self, outputs, targets):
132 |         """ This performs the loss computation.
133 |         Parameters:
134 |              outputs: dict of tensors, see the output specification of the model for the format
135 |              targets: list of dicts, such that len(targets) == batch_size.
136 |                       The expected keys in each dict depends on the losses applied, see each loss' doc
137 |         """
138 |         outputs_without_aux = {k: v for k, v in outputs.items() if k != 'aux_outputs'}
139 | 
140 |         # Retrieve the matching between the outputs of the last layer and the targets
141 |         indices = self.matcher(outputs_without_aux, targets)
142 | 
143 |         # Compute the average number of target boxes accross all nodes, for normalization purposes
144 |         num_curves = sum(tgt.shape[0] for tgt in targets)
145 |         num_curves = torch.as_tensor([num_curves], dtype=torch.float, device=next(iter(outputs.values())).device)
146 |         if is_dist_avail_and_initialized():
147 |             torch.distributed.all_reduce(num_curves)
148 |         num_curves = torch.clamp(num_curves / get_world_size(), min=1).item()
149 | 
150 |         # Compute all the requested losses
151 |         losses = {}
152 |         for loss in self.losses:
153 |             losses.update(self.get_loss(loss, outputs, targets, indices, num_curves))
154 | 
155 |         # In case of auxiliary losses, we repeat this process with the output of each intermediate layer.
156 |         if 'aux_outputs' in outputs:
157 |             for i, aux_outputs in enumerate(outputs['aux_outputs']):
158 |                 indices = self.matcher(aux_outputs, targets)
159 |                 for loss in self.losses:
160 |                     if loss == 'masks':
161 |                         # Intermediate masks losses are too costly to compute, we ignore them.
162 |                         continue
163 |                     kwargs = {}
164 |                     if loss == 'labels':
165 |                         # Logging is enabled only for the last layer
166 |                         kwargs = {'log': False}
167 |                     l_dict = self.get_loss(loss, aux_outputs, targets, indices, num_curves, **kwargs)
168 |                     l_dict = {k + f'_{i}': v for k, v in l_dict.items()}
169 |                     losses.update(l_dict)
170 | 
171 |         return losses, indices

 27 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 28 |     random.seed(seed)
 29 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 30 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 31 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 32 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

 35 | def _replace_decoder(model: torch.nn.Module, variant: str, d_state: int, d_conv: int) -> None:
 36 |     if variant.upper() == "BASE":
 37 |         return
 38 | 
 39 |     old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
 40 |     num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
 41 |     d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
 42 |     return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
 43 | 
 44 |     new_decoder = build_variant_decoder(
 45 |         variant=variant,
 46 |         num_layers=num_layers,
 47 |         d_model=d_model,
 48 |         d_state=d_state,
 49 |         d_conv=d_conv,
 50 |         return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
 51 |     )
 52 |     model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)
 53 | 
 54 | 
 55 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
 56 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 57 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
 58 | 
 59 |     # AELoss ile birebir uyumlu target formatı için doğrudan örnekleyiciyi kullan.
 60 |     original_batch_size = int(system_configs.batch_size)
 61 |     system_configs.update_config({"batch_size": 1})
 62 |     try:
 63 |         sampled, _next_ind = sample_data(db, 0)
 64 |     finally:
 65 |         system_configs.update_config({"batch_size": original_batch_size})
 66 | 
 67 |     images = sampled["xs"][0].to(device)
 68 |     masks = sampled["xs"][1].to(device)
 69 |     targets = [y.to(device) for y in sampled["ys"]]
 70 | 
 71 |     db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
 72 |     target_sizes = torch.tensor(
 73 |         [[int(images.shape[-2]), int(images.shape[-1])]] * int(images.shape[0]),
 74 |         device=device,
 75 |         dtype=torch.long,
 76 |     )
 77 | 
 78 |     return cfg, db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes
 79 | 
 80 | 
 81 | def run(
 82 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
 83 |     d_state: int = 16,
 84 |     d_conv: int = 4,
 85 |     seed: int = 0,
 86 | ) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 87 |     _set_seed(seed)
 88 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 89 | 
 90 |     _cfg, db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=cfg_name, device=device)
 91 |     post = PostProcess().to(device)
 92 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
 93 | 
 94 |     variants = ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]
 95 |     variant_rows: List[dict] = []
 96 | 
 97 |     for variant in variants:
 98 |         model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
 99 |         _replace_decoder(model=model, variant=variant, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
100 | 
101 |         # 5.1 output contract
102 |         model.train()
103 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
104 |         key_ok = all(k in outputs for k in ["pred_logits", "pred_curves"])
105 |         shape_ok = (
106 |             key_ok
107 |             and outputs["pred_logits"].dim() == 3
108 |             and outputs["pred_curves"].dim() == 3
109 |             and int(outputs["pred_logits"].shape[0]) == 1
110 |             and int(outputs["pred_curves"].shape[0]) == 1
111 |         )
112 | 
113 |         # 5.2 training-loss path
114 |         loss_finite = False
115 |         loss_value = float("nan")
116 |         try:
117 |             criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
118 |             loss_pack = criterion(
119 |                 iteration=0,
120 |                 save=False,
121 |                 viz_split="train",
122 |                 outputs=outputs,
123 |                 targets=targets,
124 |             )
125 |             loss_total = loss_pack[0]
126 |             loss_finite = bool(torch.isfinite(loss_total).all().item())
127 |             loss_value = float(loss_total.item())
128 |         except Exception:
129 |             loss_finite = False
130 | 
131 |         # 5.3 test/postprocess/evaluator/writer path
132 |         postprocess_ok = False
133 |         evaluator_ok = False
134 |         writer_ok = False
135 |         post_shape = None
136 | 
137 |         try:
138 |             model.eval()
139 |             with torch.no_grad():
140 |                 out_eval, _w_eval = model._train(images, masks)
141 |                 post_out = post(out_eval, target_sizes)
142 | 
143 |             postprocess_ok = isinstance(post_out, torch.Tensor) and post_out.dim() == 3 and int(post_out.shape[0]) == 1
144 |             if postprocess_ok:
145 |                 post_shape = tuple(post_out.shape)
146 | 
147 |                 evaluator = Evaluator(dataset=db, exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir)
148 |                 evaluator.add_prediction(0, post_out[0:1].detach().cpu().numpy(), runtime=0.01)
149 |                 evaluator_ok = evaluator.predictions_mode == "poly" and evaluator.predictions is not None
150 | 
151 |                 _ = db.pred2culaneformat(
152 |                     db_ind,
153 |                     post_out[0].detach().cpu().numpy(),
154 |                     runtime=0.01,
155 |                     exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir,
156 |                 )
157 |                 writer_ok = True
158 |         except Exception:
159 |             postprocess_ok = False
160 |             evaluator_ok = False
161 |             writer_ok = False
162 | 
163 |         has_multihead_attn = hasattr(model.transformer.decoder.layers[-1], "multihead_attn")
164 | 
165 |         variant_rows.append(
166 |             {
167 |                 "variant": variant,
168 |                 "output_contract": bool(key_ok and shape_ok),
169 |                 "loss_finite": bool(loss_finite),
170 |                 "loss_value": loss_value,
171 |                 "postprocess_ok": bool(postprocess_ok),
172 |                 "evaluator_ok": bool(evaluator_ok),
173 |                 "writer_ok": bool(writer_ok),
174 |                 "post_shape": post_shape,
175 |                 "has_multihead_attn": bool(has_multihead_attn),
176 |             }
177 |         )
178 | 
179 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
180 |     checks["all_output_contract"] = all(r["output_contract"] for r in variant_rows)
181 |     checks["all_loss_finite"] = all(r["loss_finite"] for r in variant_rows)
182 |     checks["all_postprocess_ok"] = all(r["postprocess_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
183 |     checks["all_evaluator_ok"] = all(r["evaluator_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
184 |     checks["all_writer_ok"] = all(r["writer_ok"] for r in variant_rows)
185 | 
186 |     print("=" * 96)
187 |     print("BÖLÜM 5 — PIPELINE UYUMLULUK")
188 |     print("=" * 96)
189 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
190 |     print(f"Config: {cfg_name}")
191 |     print(f"Sample db_ind: {db_ind}")
192 |     print(f"Input image: {tuple(images.shape)}")
193 | 
194 |     print("\nVaryant bazlı sonuçlar:")

196 |         print(

200 |             f"post={'✅' if row['postprocess_ok'] else '🚨'} "
201 |             f"eval={'✅' if row['evaluator_ok'] else '🚨'} "
202 |             f"writer={'✅' if row['writer_ok'] else '🚨'} "

204 |         )

207 |

    intermediate[-1] = output                   # ← double-normed intermediate ile değiştir
    return torch.stack(intermediate)
Sonuç: Son decoder katmanının çıktısı decoder_norm(decoder_norm(layer_norm(mamba_out + query))) — üç kez normalize. İlk N-1 katman bir kez, son katman iki kez. Head'e giden son representation yanlış scale'de.
Baseline transformer decoder'da böyle bir sorun yok. Bu yüzden A/B/C vs baseline karşılaştırması biased olur.
Düzeltme:
pythondef forward(self, tgt, memory, ...):
    output = tgt
    intermediate = []

    for layer in self.layers:
        mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
        output = self._forward_layer(layer, mem, qry)
        if self.return_intermediate:
            intermediate.append(output)  # norm YOK, ham output

    if self.return_intermediate:
        normed = [self.norm(x) for x in intermediate]  # hepsini sonda norm et
        return torch.stack(normed)
    return self.norm(output)

Diğer Gözlemler
JSON stepsize — stepsize: 450000, max_iter: 12500. LR hiç düşmüyor. 2k deney için kasıtlı kabul edilebilir, not olarak geç.
dec_common.py attribute sırası — super().__init__() öncesi attribute set ediliyor. Çalışır ama temiz değil. Train'i etkilemez.

Karar
Double norm düzeltilmeden eğitime başlama. Düzeltme 5 satır, decoder_variants.py'de sadece forward() metodu değişiyor. Diğer her şey hazır.

 70 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
 71 | 
 72 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 73 |         super().__init__()

 75 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)

 77 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 78 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 79 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
 80 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 81 | 
 82 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)

 84 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
 85 | 
 86 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
 87 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
 88 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
 89 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

 92 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
 93 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
 94 | 
 95 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 96 |         super().__init__()
 97 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 98 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 99 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
100 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
101 | 
102 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
103 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
104 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
105 |         lq = query.shape[0]
106 | 
107 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
108 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
109 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
110 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
111 | 
112 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
113 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
114 | 
115 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
116 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
117 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
118 | 
119 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
120 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
121 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
122 | 
123 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
124 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
125 |         return out

## DENEY 1: MAMBA-2 DECODER

### Motivasyon

Orijinal Mamba’nın (arxiv:2312.00752) devamı olan Mamba-2, State Space Duality
çerçevesiyle 2-8x hız artışı ve potansiyel kalite iyileşmesi sunuyor. `mamba_ssm`
paketi zaten Mamba2’yi içeriyor — minimal kod değişikliği.

### Mimari

```
MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch (şu an):
    Mamba(d_model=32, d_state=16, d_conv=4)

MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2 (yeni):
    Mamba2(d_model=32, d_state=64, headdim=32)
    # Mamba2'de d_state daha büyük tutulur (16→64)
    # headdim = d_model / num_heads, varsayılan 32
```

## DENEY 2: HİBRİT DECODER

### Motivasyon

MambaVision (CVPR 2025, NVIDIA) son katmanlarda self-attention eklemenin
long-range bağımlılıkları iyileştirdiğini gösterdi. Decoder Varyant B 2 katman:

- Katman 1: Mamba B (geniş memory tarama, hızlı)
- Katman 2: Orijinal Cross-attention (hassas query güncelleme)

Bu hybrid, Mamba’nın linear complexity avantajını + attention’ın odak hassasiyetini
birleştirir.

### Mimari

```python
class HybridMambaDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
    """
    Hybrid: Mamba query-aware + Cross-attention.
    
    Tek katman = [MambaB_pass → CrossAttn_pass] şeklinde DEĞİL.
    Decoder'ın katman sırası:
        Katman 0 (layer_type="mamba"): MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch
        Katman 1 (layer_type="attn"):  orijinal TransformerDecoderLayer (cross-attn)
    """
```

**Önemli:** Bu bir “tek katman içinde hybrid” değil, “decoder katmanları
sıralandırılmış hybrid”. İlk katman Mamba, son katman attention.

```python
class MambaDecoderE_Hybrid(_BaseMambaDecoder):
    def __init__(self, num_layers=2, d_model=32, d_state=16, d_conv=4,
                 num_heads=2, dim_feedforward=128, return_intermediate=True):
        super().__init__(...)
        # num_layers=2 varsayımıyla:
        # layers[0] = MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch (Mamba pass)
        # layers[1] = TransformerDecoderLayer  (CrossAttn pass)
        
        # Orijinal TransformerDecoderLayer'ı şuradan import et:
        # models/transformer.py → TransformerDecoderLayer
        from models.transformer import TransformerDecoderLayer
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(d_model, d_state, d_conv),   # layer 0: Mamba
            TransformerDecoderLayer(d_model, num_heads,            # layer 1: Attn
                                   dim_feedforward, dropout=0.1)
        ])
```

**Dikkat:** `TransformerDecoderLayer.forward()` signature’ı Mamba katmanıyla farklı.
`_BaseMambaDecoder.forward()` içindeki döngüyü buna göre ayarla —
katman tipini kontrol ederek doğru forward’u çağır.

## DENEY 3: VSSD ENCODER

### Motivasyon

Mamba causal (tek yönlü) bir model. Vision task’leri için non-causal daha uygun.
Mevcut `BidirectionalMambaEncoder` bunu iki Mamba çalıştırarak telafi ediyor.
VSSD (arxiv: ICCV 2025) bu sorunu non-causal SSD formatıyla daha temiz çözüyor.

**Ama önce:** VSSD’nin pip package olarak mevcut olup olmadığını kontrol et.
Yoksa `mamba_ssm.Mamba2` üzerinden manuel implement edilebilir — Mamba2’nin
`headdim` ve `chunk_size` parametreleri non-causal davranışa yaklaşımı sağlar.

### Analiz Klasörü

`vssd_encoder_analysis/` — ayrı klasör, decoder analizinden bağımsız.

-----

0.3 — Temel forward test: (B, S, C) girdi → (B, S, C) çıktı
"""

except ImportError:

#### DENEY3 BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD/Non-causal SSM İzole Test

**`vssd_encoder_analysis/bolum2_vssd_izole.py`**

Eğer VSSD mevcut değilse, Mamba2-based non-causal approximate:

```python
class NonCausalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
    """
    VSSD benzeri non-causal encoder.
    
    Strateji A (VSSD mevcut ise):
        from vssd import VSSD
        self.ssm = VSSD(d_model=32, ...)
    
    Strateji B (Mamba2 ile approximate):
        İleri + geri yönde Mamba2 çalıştır (BidirMamba gibi)
        Ama Mamba2'nin daha büyük d_state ile daha iyi state retention
        from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
        self.mamba2_fwd = Mamba2(d_model=32, d_state=64, headdim=32)
        self.mamba2_bwd = Mamba2(d_model=32, d_state=64, headdim=32)
        self.merge = nn.Linear(64, 32)
    
    Forward:
        fwd_out = mamba2_fwd(x)           # (B, S, 32)
        bwd_out = mamba2_bwd(x.flip(1))   # (B, S, 32), flip back
        bwd_out = bwd_out.flip(1)
        merged = merge(cat([fwd_out, bwd_out], -1))  # (B, S, 32)
        return merged
    """
```

Testler:

```
output_shape_ok    : (B, 260, 32) ✅/🚨  (encoder output'u)
no_nan             : ✅/🚨
gradient_flow      : ✅/🚨
quality_vs_bidir   : feature cosine sim karşılaştırması
speedup_vs_bidir   : float
```

## ÖNEMLİ NOTLAR

**Mamba2 parametre uyarısı:** `headdim` mutlaka `d_model`‘i tam bölmeli.
`d_model=32` için geçerli `headdim` değerleri: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32.
Bölüm 1’de başarısız olursa farklı değer dene.

**Hybrid decoder forward logic:** `_BaseMambaDecoder.forward()` döngüsü
katman tipini kontrol etmeli. İki farklı signature var:

- Mamba katmanı: `layer(memory, query)`
- Attn katmanı: `layer(tgt, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)`
  Bunları birbirinden ayırt et.

**VSSD alternatifleri:** Resmi VSSD paketi bulunamazsa şu alternatifler de geçerli:

- `mamba_ssm.Mamba2` ile bidirectional (Strateji B, encoder)
- Plain `Mamba2` + flip trick (mevcut BidirMamba’nın Mamba2 versiyonu)
  Hangisini seçersen seç, Bölüm 1’deki encoder kontratı değişmemeli.

**Deney bağımsızlığı:** 3 deney birbirinden bağımsız. Biri başarısız olursa
diğerleri devam eder. Her deney kendi analiz klasöründe.

 29 | class MambaDecoderLayerA(nn.Module):
 30 |     """Varyant A — Prefix concat."""
 31 | 
 32 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 33 |         super().__init__()
 34 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 35 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 36 | 
 37 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 38 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 39 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 40 |         combined = torch.cat([memory, query], dim=0)     # (S+L,B,C)
 41 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))  # (B,S+L,C)
 42 |         out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                   # (S+L,B,C)
 43 |         new_query = out[-lq:]                            # (L,B,C)
 44 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)
 45 | 
 46 | 
 47 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Naive(nn.Module):
 48 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
 49 | 
 50 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 51 |         super().__init__()
 52 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 53 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 54 | 
 55 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 56 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 57 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 58 |         new_qs = []
 59 |         for i in range(lq):
 60 |             qi = query[i : i + 1]                           # (1,B,C)
 61 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
 62 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
 63 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
 64 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)
 65 |         new_query = torch.cat(new_qs, dim=0)
 66 |         return self.norm(new_query)

 69 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
 70 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
 71 | 
 72 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 73 |         super().__init__()
 74 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 75 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 76 | 
 77 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 78 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 79 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
 80 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 81 | 
 82 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
 83 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
 84 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
 85 | 
 86 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
 87 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
 88 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
 89 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)
 90 | 
 91 | 
 92 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
 93 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
 94 | 
 95 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 96 |         super().__init__()
 97 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 98 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 99 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
100 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
101 | 
102 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
103 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
104 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
105 |         lq = query.shape[0]
106 | 
107 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
108 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
109 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
110 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
111 | 
112 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
113 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
114 | 
115 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
116 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
117 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
118 | 
119 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
120 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
121 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
122 | 
123 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
124 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
125 |         return out

128 | class _BaseMambaDecoder(nn.Module):
129 |     def __init__(
130 |         self,
131 |         layer_cls,
132 |         num_layers: int = 2,
133 |         d_model: int = 32,
134 |         d_state: int = 16,
135 |         d_conv: int = 4,
136 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
137 |     ):
138 |         super().__init__()
139 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
140 |             [layer_cls(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv) for _ in range(num_layers)]
141 |         )
142 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
143 |         self.return_intermediate = return_intermediate
144 | 
145 |     def _forward_layer(self, layer: nn.Module, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
146 |         return layer(memory, query)
147 | 
148 |     def forward(
149 |         self,
150 |         tgt: torch.Tensor,
151 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
152 |         tgt_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
153 |         memory_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
154 |         tgt_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
155 |         memory_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
156 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
157 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
158 |     ):
159 |         del tgt_mask, memory_mask, tgt_key_padding_mask, memory_key_padding_mask
160 |         output = tgt
161 |         intermediate = []
162 | 
163 |         for layer in self.layers:
164 |             mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
165 |             output = self._forward_layer(layer, mem, qry)
166 |             if self.return_intermediate:
167 |                 intermediate.append(self.norm(output))
168 | 
169 |         output = self.norm(output)
170 |         if self.return_intermediate:
171 |             intermediate[-1] = output
172 |             return torch.stack(intermediate)
173 |         return output
174 |

179 |         num_layers: int = 2,
180 |         d_model: int = 32,
181 |         d_state: int = 16,
182 |         d_conv: int = 4,
183 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
184 |     ):
185 |         super().__init__(
186 |             layer_cls=MambaDecoderLayerA,
187 |             num_layers=num_layers,
188 |             d_model=d_model,
189 |             d_state=d_state,
190 |             d_conv=d_conv,

219 |         d_state: int = 16,

233 | def build_variant_decoder(
234 |     variant: str,
235 |     num_layers: int,
236 |     d_model: int,
237 |     d_state: int,
238 |     d_conv: int,
239 |     return_intermediate: bool,

249 |         )
250 |     if v == "B":
251 |         return MambaDecoderB(
252 |             num_layers=num_layers,

254 |             d_state=d_state,

263 |             d_conv=d_conv,

  1 | """
  2 | LSTR + Gerçek mamba-ssm Bidirectional Encoder Modülü
  3 | 
  4 | Kullanım:
  5 |     from models.py_utils.mamba_encoder import BidirectionalMambaEncoder
  6 |     model.transformer.encoder = BidirectionalMambaEncoder().cuda()
  7 | 
  8 | Gereksinim: pip install mamba-ssm causal-conv1d
  9 | """
 10 | 
 11 | import torch
 12 | import torch.nn as nn
 13 | from mamba_ssm import Mamba
 14 | from config import system_configs
 15 | 
 16 | 
 17 | class BidirectionalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
 18 |     """
 19 |     LSTR transformer.encoder'ı yerine geçen gerçek Mamba tabanlı encoder.
 20 | 
 21 |     Causality Çözümü:
 22 |         Mamba doğası gereği causal (soldan-sağa). Feature map'te sağdaki
 23 |         lane token'ları soldakileri göremez. Çözüm: iki yönlü Mamba bloğu.
 24 |         - Forward  pass: x olduğu gibi geçer
 25 |         - Backward pass: x flip edilir, sonuç geri flip edilir
 26 |         - İkisi toplanır → Bidirectional
 27 | 
 28 |     Sequence boyutu notu:
 29 |         240 token (12×20), standart attention'a karşı Mamba'nın belirgin
 30 |         hız avantajının ortaya çıktığı eşiğin (>512 token) altında.
 31 |         Avantaj burada FPS değil, O(N) bellek kompleksitesinde.
 32 | 
 33 |     LSTR forward signature uyumu:
 34 |         Mevcut encoder: (src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None) → (out, weights)
 35 |         src boyutu : (HW=240, B=1, D=32)  ← PyTorch seq-first
 36 |         Mamba girdisi: (B=1, HW=240, D=32) ← batch-first → permute gerekli
 37 | 
 38 |     enc_attn_weights shape:
 39 |         test/culane.py:169 → enc_attn_weights[0].reshape(shape + shape)
 40 |         shape = conv_features.shape[-2:] = (12, 20)
 41 |         reshape(shape + shape) = reshape(12, 20, 12, 20) ← (HW, HW) olarak görülüyor
 42 |         Aslında hook output[1] alıyor → self_attn weight shape: (B*num_heads, HW, HW)
 43 |         Bizim wrapper'da: (num_heads, HW, HW) döndürülüyor.
 44 |         enc_attn_weights[0] → (HW, HW) = (240, 240), reshape(12,20,12,20) → OK
 45 |     """
 46 | 
 47 |     def __init__(self):
 48 |         super().__init__()
 49 |         d_model        = system_configs.attn_dim        # 32 (CULane config)
 50 |         d_state        = 16                              # SSM state boyutu
 51 |         d_conv         = 4                               # Causal conv kernel
 52 |         expand         = 2                               # inner = d_model * expand = 64
 53 |         n_layers       = system_configs.enc_layers       # 2 (CULane config)
 54 |         self.n_layers  = n_layers
 55 |         self.num_heads = system_configs.num_heads        # 2 (CULane config)
 56 | 
 57 |         self.mamba_fwd_layers = nn.ModuleList([
 58 |             Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, expand=expand)
 59 |             for _ in range(n_layers)
 60 |         ])
 61 |         self.mamba_bwd_layers = nn.ModuleList([
 62 |             Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, expand=expand)
 63 |             for _ in range(n_layers)
 64 |         ])
 65 |         self.norms = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(n_layers)])
 66 | 
 67 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
 68 |         """
 69 |         Args:
 70 |             src: (HW, B, D) — LSTR seq-first formatı
 71 |             src_key_padding_mask: (B, HW) — padding mask (opsiyonel)
 72 |             pos: (HW, B, D) — positional encoding (opsiyonel)
 73 |         Returns:
 74 |             out: (HW, B, D)
 75 |             dummy_weights: (num_heads, HW, HW) — test/culane.py:169 uyumlu
 76 |         """
 77 |         if pos is not None:
 78 |             src = src + pos
 79 | 
 80 |         # (HW, B, D) → (B, HW, D)  Mamba batch-first bekliyor
 81 |         x = src.permute(1, 0, 2)
 82 | 
 83 |         for fwd, bwd, norm in zip(self.mamba_fwd_layers, self.mamba_bwd_layers, self.norms):
 84 |             x_fwd = fwd(x)
 85 |             x_bwd = torch.flip(bwd(torch.flip(x, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
 86 |             x = norm(x + x_fwd + x_bwd)   # residual + add bidirectional
 87 | 
 88 |         # (B, HW, D) → (HW, B, D)  LSTR seq-first'e geri
 89 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
 90 | 
 91 |         # enc_attn_weights: test/culane.py:169'da
 92 |         #   enc_attn_weights[0].reshape(shape + shape)
 93 |         #   shape = (12, 20) → reshape(12, 20, 12, 20)
 94 |         # self_attn output[1] → (B*num_heads, HW, HW) 
 95 |         B = out.shape[1]
 96 |         src_hw = out.shape[0]  # 240
 97 |         dummy_weights = torch.zeros(
 98 |             B * self.num_heads, src_hw, src_hw, device=out.device
 99 |         )
100 |         return out, dummy_weights
101 |

+class MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2(nn.Module):
+    """Varyant D — Query-aware Mamba2 (B varyantının Mamba2 karşılığı)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32):

+
+    def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
+        lq = query.shape[0]
+
+        mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
+        q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
+        combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)

+        out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)

+        new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
+        return self.norm(new_query + query)

 47 |             continue

 49 |             hd_unique.append(h)
 50 | 
 51 |     candidate_kwargs = []

 54 |             continue
 55 |         candidate_kwargs.extend(
 56 |             [
 57 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv, "headdim": h},
 58 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": h},
 59 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv},
 60 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state},

 67 |             {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 68 |         ]
 69 |     )

 71 |     last_err: Optional[Exception] = None
 72 |     for kw in candidate_kwargs:

 83 | class MambaDecoderLayerA(nn.Module):
 84 |     """Varyant A — Prefix concat."""
 85 | 
 86 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 87 |         super().__init__()
 88 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 89 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 90 | 
 91 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 92 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 93 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 94 |         combined = torch.cat([memory, query], dim=0)     # (S+L,B,C)
 95 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))  # (B,S+L,C)
 96 |         out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                   # (S+L,B,C)
 97 |         new_query = out[-lq:]                            # (L,B,C)
 98 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

101 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Naive(nn.Module):
102 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
103 | 
104 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
105 |         super().__init__()
106 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
107 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
108 | 
109 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
110 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
111 |         lq = query.shape[0]
112 |         new_qs = []
113 |         for i in range(lq):
114 |             qi = query[i : i + 1]                           # (1,B,C)
115 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
116 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
117 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
118 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)
119 |         new_query = torch.cat(new_qs, dim=0)
120 |         return self.norm(new_query)

123 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
124 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
125 | 
126 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
127 |         super().__init__()
128 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
129 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
130 | 
131 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
132 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
133 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
134 |         lq = query.shape[0]
135 | 
136 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
137 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
138 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
139 | 
140 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
141 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
142 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
143 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

146 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
147 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
148 | 
149 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
150 |         super().__init__()
151 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
152 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
153 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
154 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
155 | 
156 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
157 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
158 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
159 |         lq = query.shape[0]
160 | 
161 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
162 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
163 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
164 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
165 | 
166 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
167 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
168 | 
169 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
170 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
171 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
172 | 
173 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
174 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
175 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
176 | 
177 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
178 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
179 |         return out

201 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)

209 | class _BaseMambaDecoder(nn.Module):
210 |     def __init__(
211 |         self,
212 |         layer_cls,
213 |         num_layers: int = 2,
214 |         d_model: int = 32,
215 |         d_state: int = 16,
216 |         d_conv: int = 4,
217 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
218 |         layer_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
219 |     ):
220 |         super().__init__()
221 |         kwargs = {} if layer_kwargs is None else dict(layer_kwargs)
222 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
223 |             [layer_cls(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, **kwargs) for _ in range(num_layers)]
224 |         )
225 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
226 |         self.return_intermediate = return_intermediate
227 | 
228 |     def _forward_layer(
229 |         self,
230 |         layer: nn.Module,
231 |         output: torch.Tensor,
232 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
233 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
234 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
235 |     ) -> torch.Tensor:
236 |         if _is_attn_like_layer(layer):
237 |             return layer(output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
238 |         mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
239 |         return layer(mem, qry)
240 | 
241 |     def forward(
242 |         self,
243 |         tgt: torch.Tensor,
244 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
245 |         tgt_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
246 |         memory_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
247 |         tgt_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
248 |         memory_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
249 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
250 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
251 |     ):
252 |         del tgt_mask, memory_mask, tgt_key_padding_mask, memory_key_padding_mask
253 |         output = tgt
254 |         intermediate = []
255 | 
256 |         for layer in self.layers:
257 |             output = self._forward_layer(layer, output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
258 |             if self.return_intermediate:
259 |                 intermediate.append(self.norm(output))
260 | 
261 |         output = self.norm(output)
262 |         if self.return_intermediate:
263 |             intermediate[-1] = output
264 |             return torch.stack(intermediate)
265 |         return output
