346 | class MambaDecoderE_Hybrid(_BaseMambaDecoder):
347 |     """Varyant E — katman sırası olarak Hybrid (MambaB -> CrossAttn)."""
348 | 
349 |     def __init__(
350 |         self,
351 |         num_layers: int = 2,
352 |         d_model: int = 32,
353 |         d_state: int = 16,
354 |         d_conv: int = 4,
355 |         num_heads: int = 2,
356 |         dim_feedforward: int = 128,
357 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
358 |         dropout: float = 0.1,
359 |     ):
360 |         super().__init__(
361 |             layer_cls=MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch,

363 |             d_model=d_model,
364 |             d_state=d_state,
365 |             d_conv=d_conv,
366 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
367 |         )
368 | 
369 |         from models.py_utils.transformer import TransformerDecoderLayer
370 | 
371 |         layers: list[nn.Module] = [
372 |             MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
373 |         ]
374 |         for _ in range(max(int(num_layers) - 1, 0)):
375 |             layers.append(
376 |                 TransformerDecoderLayer(
377 |                     d_model=d_model,
378 |                     nhead=int(num_heads),
379 |                     dim_feedforward=int(dim_feedforward),

382 |                     normalize_before=False,
383 |                 )
384 |             )

388 | def build_variant_decoder(
389 |     variant: str,
390 |     num_layers: int,
391 |     d_model: int,
392 |     d_state: int,
393 |     d_conv: int,
394 |     return_intermediate: bool,
395 |     headdim: int = 32,
396 |     num_heads: int = 2,
397 |     dim_feedforward: int = 128,
398 | ) -> nn.Module:
399 |     v = variant.upper()
400 |     if v == "A":
401 |         return MambaDecoderA(
402 |             num_layers=num_layers,
403 |             d_model=d_model,
404 |             d_state=d_state,
405 |             d_conv=d_conv,
406 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
407 |         )
408 |     if v == "B":
409 |         return MambaDecoderB(
410 |             num_layers=num_layers,
411 |             d_model=d_model,
412 |             d_state=d_state,
413 |             d_conv=d_conv,
414 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
415 |         )
416 |     if v == "C":
417 |         return MambaDecoderC(
418 |             num_layers=num_layers,
419 |             d_model=d_model,
420 |             d_state=d_state,
421 |             d_conv=d_conv,
422 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
423 |         )
424 |     if v == "D":
425 |         return MambaDecoderD(
426 |             num_layers=num_layers,
427 |             d_model=d_model,
428 |             d_state=d_state,
429 |             d_conv=d_conv,
430 |             headdim=headdim,
431 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
432 |         )
433 |     if v == "E":
434 |         return MambaDecoderE_Hybrid(
435 |             num_layers=num_layers,
436 |             d_model=d_model,
437 |             d_state=d_state,
438 |             d_conv=d_conv,
439 |             num_heads=num_heads,
440 |             dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
441 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
442 |             dropout=0.1,
443 |         )
444 |     raise ValueError(f"Unknown variant: {variant}")

+"""
+DENEY 1 BÖLÜM 1 — Mamba2 izole test.
+
+Testler:
+1.1 — Import: from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
+1.2 — (261, B, 32) girdi -> (261, B, 32) çıktı
+1.3 — (267, B, 32) girdi -> (267, B, 32) çıktı
+1.4 — Gradient flow
+1.5 — Mamba vs Mamba2 hız karşılaştırması
+1.6 — Mamba vs Mamba2 parametre sayısı oranı
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import random
+import time
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from mamba_ssm import Mamba
+
+from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import _build_mamba2
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _finite(t: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return bool(torch.isfinite(t).all().item())
+
+
+def _param_count(module: torch.nn.Module) -> int:
+    return sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters())
+
+
+def _bench(fn, warmup: int = 5, iters: int = 30) -> float:
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t1 = time.perf_counter()
+    return (t1 - t0) / float(iters)
+
+
+def run(batch: int = 2, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
+
+    # 1.1 import + build
+    mamba2: Optional[torch.nn.Module]
+    mamba2_kwargs: Optional[dict]
+    try:
+        mamba2, mamba2_kwargs = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
+        mamba2 = mamba2.to(device)
+        checks["import_ok"] = True
+    except Exception as e:
+        checks["import_ok"] = False
+        checks["error"] = str(e)
+        print("=" * 96)
+        print("DENEY 1 BÖLÜM 1 — MAMBA2 İZOLE")
+        print("=" * 96)
+        print(f"Device: {device}")
+        print(f"import_ok: 🚨 ({e})")
+        return checks
+
+    mamba1 = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=max(16, d_state // 4), d_conv=d_conv).to(device)
+
+    x261 = torch.randn(batch, 261, d_model, device=device)
+    x267 = torch.randn(batch, 267, d_model, device=device)
+
+    y261 = mamba2(x261)
+    y267 = mamba2(x267)
+
+    checks["forward_261_ok"] = tuple(y261.shape) == tuple(x261.shape)
+    checks["forward_267_ok"] = tuple(y267.shape) == tuple(x267.shape)
+    checks["no_nan_inf"] = _finite(y261) and _finite(y267)
+
+    # gradient
+    mamba2.train()
+    mamba2.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    xg = torch.randn(batch, 261, d_model, device=device, requires_grad=True)
+    yg = mamba2(xg)
+    loss = yg.pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    grad_ok = False
+    for p in mamba2.parameters():
+        if p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12:
+            grad_ok = True
+            break
+    checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (xg.grad is not None) and float(xg.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    # speed + params
+    t_m1 = _bench(lambda: mamba1(x261))
+    t_m2 = _bench(lambda: mamba2(x261))
+    speedup = float(t_m1 / max(t_m2, 1e-12))
+    p_m1 = _param_count(mamba1)
+    p_m2 = _param_count(mamba2)
+    ratio = float(p_m2 / max(p_m1, 1))
+    checks["speedup_vs_mamba1"] = speedup
+    checks["param_ratio"] = ratio
+    checks["mamba2_kwargs"] = mamba2_kwargs
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 1 BÖLÜM 1 — MAMBA2 İZOLE")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"Mamba2 kwargs: {mamba2_kwargs}")
+    print(f"x261 -> y261: {tuple(x261.shape)} -> {tuple(y261.shape)}")
+    print(f"x267 -> y267: {tuple(x267.shape)} -> {tuple(y267.shape)}")
+    print(f"Mamba1 time/iter: {t_m1*1e3:.3f} ms")
+    print(f"Mamba2 time/iter: {t_m2*1e3:.3f} ms")
+    print(f"speedup_vs_mamba1: {speedup:.3f}x")
+    print(f"param_count m1={p_m1:,}, m2={p_m2:,}, ratio={ratio:.3f}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k in ["import_ok", "forward_261_ok", "forward_267_ok", "no_nan_inf", "gradient_flow"]:
+        print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if checks[k] else '🚨'}")
+    print(f"  {'speedup_vs_mamba1':<18}: {speedup:.3f}")
+    print(f"  {'param_ratio':<18}: {ratio:.3f}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=64)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("--headdim", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(
+        batch=args.batch,
+        d_model=args.d_model,
+        d_state=args.d_state,
+        d_conv=args.d_conv,
+        headdim=args.headdim,
+        seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    hard_keys = ["import_ok", "forward_261_ok", "forward_267_ok", "no_nan_inf", "gradient_flow"]
+    ok = all(bool(checks.get(k, False)) for k in hard_keys)
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY1 BÖLÜM1 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+DENEY 1 BÖLÜM 2 — Varyant D (Query-aware Mamba2) izole test.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import random
+import time
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch, MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _has_grad(module: torch.nn.Module, eps: float = 1e-12) -> bool:
+    for p in module.parameters():
+        if p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > eps:
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _bench(fn, warmup: int = 5, iters: int = 20) -> float:
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t1 = time.perf_counter()
+    return (t1 - t0) / float(iters)
+
+
+def _toy_overfit_step(layer: torch.nn.Module, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor, steps: int = 60, lr: float = 1e-3):
+    target = torch.zeros_like(query)
+    opt = torch.optim.Adam(layer.parameters(), lr=lr)
+    hist = []
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        out = layer(memory, query)
+        loss = (out - target).pow(2).mean()
+        loss.backward()
+        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(layer.parameters(), 1.0)
+        opt.step()
+        hist.append(float(loss.item()))
+    init, final = hist[0], hist[-1]
+    red = (init - final) / max(init, 1e-12) * 100.0
+    return init, final, red
+
+
+def run(batch: int = 2, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32, num_queries: int = 7, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    s = 260
+    lq = num_queries
+    memory = torch.randn(s, batch, d_model, device=device)
+    query = torch.randn(lq, batch, d_model, device=device)
+
+    layer_b = MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=d_conv).to(device)
+    layer_d = MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim).to(device)
+
+    out_b = layer_b(memory, query)
+    out_d = layer_d(memory, query)
+
+    max_diff = float((out_b - out_d).abs().max().item())
+    mean_diff = float((out_b - out_d).abs().mean().item())
+
+    checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
+    checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(out_d.shape) == (lq, batch, d_model)
+    checks["no_nan"] = bool(torch.isfinite(out_d).all().item())
+    checks["pipeline_compat"] = tuple(out_d.shape) == tuple(out_b.shape)
+    checks["mean_diff_vs_B"] = mean_diff
+    checks["max_diff_vs_B"] = max_diff
+
+    # gradient
+    layer_d.train()
+    layer_d.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    mem_g = memory.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    qry_g = query.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    loss = layer_d(mem_g, qry_g).pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    checks["gradient_flow"] = _has_grad(layer_d) and mem_g.grad is not None and qry_g.grad is not None
+
+    # speed
+    t_b = _bench(lambda: layer_b(memory, query))
+    t_d = _bench(lambda: layer_d(memory, query))
+    checks["speedup_vs_B"] = float(t_b / max(t_d, 1e-12))
+
+    # toy overfit compare
+    b_init, b_final, b_red = _toy_overfit_step(
+        MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=d_conv).to(device),
+        memory,
+        query,
+        steps=60,
+        lr=1e-3,
+    )
+    d_init, d_final, d_red = _toy_overfit_step(
+        MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim).to(device),
+        memory,
+        query,
+        steps=60,
+        lr=1e-3,
+    )
+    checks["overfit_reduction"] = float(d_red)
+    checks["overfit_vs_B"] = float(d_red - b_red)
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 1 BÖLÜM 2 — VARYANT D (MAMBA2)")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"memory={tuple(memory.shape)} query={tuple(query.shape)}")
+    print(f"out_B={tuple(out_b.shape)} out_D={tuple(out_d.shape)}")
+    print(f"mean_diff_vs_B={mean_diff:.3e}, max_diff_vs_B={max_diff:.3e}")
+    print(f"time_B={t_b*1e3:.3f} ms, time_D={t_d*1e3:.3f} ms, speedup_vs_B={checks['speedup_vs_B']:.3f}x")
+    print(f"toy_overfit B: {b_init:.5f}->{b_final:.5f} ({b_red:.2f}%)")
+    print(f"toy_overfit D: {d_init:.5f}->{d_final:.5f} ({d_red:.2f}%)")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k in ["output_shape_ok", "no_nan", "gradient_flow", "pipeline_compat"]:
+        print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if checks[k] else '🚨'}")
+    print(f"  {'overfit_reduction':<18}: {checks['overfit_reduction']:.2f}")
+    print(f"  {'speedup_vs_B':<18}: {checks['speedup_vs_B']:.3f}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=64)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("--headdim", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-queries", type=int, default=7)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(
+        batch=args.batch,
+        d_model=args.d_model,
+        d_state=args.d_state,
+        d_conv=args.d_conv,
+        headdim=args.headdim,
+        num_queries=args.num_queries,
+        seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    hard_keys = ["output_shape_ok", "no_nan", "gradient_flow", "pipeline_compat"]
+    ok = all(bool(checks.get(k, False)) for k in hard_keys)
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY1 BÖLÜM2 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""

+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+from mamba_decoder_analysis.bolum5_uyumluluk import run as run_pipeline
+
+
+def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b", d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    # Mevcut pipeline scripti artık BASE + A/B/C döndürüyor.
+    # Deney1 için kritik olan loss/postprocess kontratları aynı olduğu için
+    # D varyantı odaklı koşum ayrı scriptte (bolum2) testlenir.
+    # Burada genel pipeline kontratını tekrar doğruluyoruz.
+    return run_pipeline(cfg_name=cfg_name, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, seed=seed)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b")
+    parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=64)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, d_state=args.d_state, d_conv=args.d_conv, seed=args.seed)
+    ok = bool(checks.get("all_output_contract", False)) and bool(checks.get("all_loss_finite", False)) and bool(checks.get("all_postprocess_ok", False))
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY1 BÖLÜM3 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")

+"""
+DENEY 2 BÖLÜM 1 — Hybrid decoder izole test.
+
+Katman sırası:
+  layer0: MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch
+  layer1: TransformerDecoderLayer (cross-attn)
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import random
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import MambaDecoderE_Hybrid, _is_attn_like_layer
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _has_grad(module: torch.nn.Module, eps: float = 1e-12) -> bool:
+    for p in module.parameters():
+        if p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > eps:
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def run(batch: int = 2, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4, num_heads: int = 2, dim_feedforward: int = 128, num_queries: int = 7, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    s = 260
+    lq = num_queries
+    memory = torch.randn(s, batch, d_model, device=device)
+    query = torch.randn(lq, batch, d_model, device=device)
+    pos = torch.randn(s, batch, d_model, device=device)
+    query_pos = torch.randn(lq, batch, d_model, device=device)
+
+    dec = MambaDecoderE_Hybrid(
+        num_layers=2,
+        d_model=d_model,
+        d_state=d_state,
+        d_conv=d_conv,
+        num_heads=num_heads,
+        dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
+        return_intermediate=True,
+        dropout=0.1,
+    ).to(device)
+
+    layer0 = dec.layers[0]
+    layer1 = dec.layers[1]
+
+    out0 = layer0(memory, query)
+    out1 = layer1(out0, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
+    out_stack = dec(query, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["mamba_layer_ok"] = tuple(out0.shape) == (lq, batch, d_model)
+    checks["crossattn_layer_ok"] = _is_attn_like_layer(layer1) and tuple(out1.shape) == (lq, batch, d_model)
+    checks["stack_output_shape_ok"] = out_stack.dim() == 4 and tuple(out_stack[-1].shape) == (lq, batch, d_model)
+    checks["no_nan"] = bool(torch.isfinite(out_stack).all().item())
+
+    # gradient check
+    dec.train()
+    dec.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    mem_g = memory.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    qry_g = query.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    out_g = dec(qry_g, mem_g, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
+    loss = out_g[-1].pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+
+    checks["gradient_mamba_layer"] = _has_grad(layer0)
+    checks["gradient_attn_layer"] = _has_grad(layer1)
+    checks["memory_gradient"] = mem_g.grad is not None and float(mem_g.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 2 BÖLÜM 1 — HYBRID İZOLE")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"memory={tuple(memory.shape)} query={tuple(query.shape)}")
+    print(f"layer0_out={tuple(out0.shape)} layer1_out={tuple(out1.shape)} stack_out={tuple(out_stack.shape)}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=16)
+    parser.add_argument("--d-conv", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-heads", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--dim-feedforward", type=int, default=128)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-queries", type=int, default=7)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(
+        batch=args.batch,
+        d_model=args.d_model,
+        d_state=args.d_state,
+        d_conv=args.d_conv,
+        num_heads=args.num_heads,
+        dim_feedforward=args.dim_feedforward,
+        num_queries=args.num_queries,
+        seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY2 BÖLÜM1 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 6 — Overfit karşılaştırması (BASE vs Decoder A/B/C).
  3 | 
  4 | Amaç:
  5 | 1) Aynı tek örnek üzerinde farklı decoder tasarımlarının öğrenme kabiliyetini ölçmek
  6 | 2) Decoder değişiminden sonra train-loss hattının stabil kaldığını doğrulamak
  7 | 3) En iyi/uygun varyantı pre-integration aşaması için seçmek
  8 | """
  9 | 
 10 | import argparse
 11 | import importlib
 12 | import random
 13 | from typing import Dict, List
 14 | 
 15 | import numpy as np
 16 | import torch
 17 | 
 18 | from config import system_configs
 19 | from db.culane import CULANE
 20 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
 21 | from mamba_decoder_analysis.decoder_variants import build_variant_decoder
 22 | 
 23 | 
 24 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 25 |     random.seed(seed)
 26 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 27 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 28 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 29 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | def _replace_decoder(model: torch.nn.Module, variant: str, d_state: int, d_conv: int) -> None:
 33 |     if variant.upper() == "BASE":
 34 |         return
 35 | 
 36 |     old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
 37 |     num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
 38 |     d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
 39 |     return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
 40 | 
 41 |     new_decoder = build_variant_decoder(
 42 |         variant=variant,
 43 |         num_layers=num_layers,
 44 |         d_model=d_model,
 45 |         d_state=d_state,
 46 |         d_conv=d_conv,
 47 |         return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
 48 |     )
 49 |     model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)
 50 | 
 51 | 
 52 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
 53 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 54 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
 55 |     db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
 56 |     image_t, label_np, _ = db.__getitem__(db_ind, transform=True)
 57 | 
 58 |     images = image_t.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 59 |     masks = torch.zeros((1, 1, images.shape[-2], images.shape[-1]), device=device)
 60 |     # AELoss beklentisi: targets[1:] elemanları (B, L, D) olmalı.
 61 |     # B=1 olduğu için tek bir label tensor yeterli.
 62 |     label_batch = torch.from_numpy(label_np.astype(np.float32)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 63 |     targets = [images, label_batch]
 64 | 
 65 |     return db_ind, images, masks, targets
 66 | 
 67 | 
 68 | def _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
 69 |     """
 70 |     Decoder etkisini daha net görmek için backbone + encoder dondur.
 71 |     Query/head katmanları açık kalır ki model tek örneği gerçekten öğrenebilsin.
 72 |     """
 73 |     freeze_prefixes = [
 74 |         "conv1",
 75 |         "bn1",
 76 |         "layer1",
 77 |         "layer2",
 78 |         "layer3",
 79 |         "layer4",
 80 |         "input_proj",
 81 |         "transformer.encoder",
 82 |     ]
 83 |     for name, p in model.named_parameters():
 84 |         if any(name.startswith(pref) for pref in freeze_prefixes):
 85 |             p.requires_grad_(False)
 86 | 
 87 | 
 88 | def _collect_trainable_stats(model: torch.nn.Module):
 89 |     total = 0
 90 |     trainable = 0
 91 |     for p in model.parameters():
 92 |         n = p.numel()
 93 |         total += n
 94 |         if p.requires_grad:
 95 |             trainable += n
 96 |     return total, trainable
 97 | 
 98 | 
 99 | def _train_one_variant(
100 |     cfg_name: str,
101 |     variant: str,
102 |     images: torch.Tensor,
103 |     masks: torch.Tensor,
104 |     targets: List[torch.Tensor],
105 |     d_state: int,
106 |     d_conv: int,
107 |     epochs: int,
108 |     lr: float,
109 |     seed: int,
110 | ) -> Dict[str, float]:
111 |     _set_seed(seed)
112 |     device = images.device
113 | 
114 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
115 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
116 |     _replace_decoder(model=model, variant=variant, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
117 |     _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model)
118 | 
119 |     criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
120 | 
121 |     optim_params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
122 |     optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(optim_params, lr=lr)
123 | 
124 |     total_params, trainable_params = _collect_trainable_stats(model)
125 | 
126 |     losses_hist: List[float] = []
127 |     for ep in range(epochs):
128 |         model.train()
129 |         optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
130 | 
131 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
132 |         loss_pack = criterion(
133 |             iteration=0,
134 |             save=False,
135 |             viz_split="train",
136 |             outputs=outputs,
137 |             targets=targets,
138 |         )
139 |         total_loss = loss_pack[0]
140 | 
141 |         if not torch.isfinite(total_loss).all():
142 |             raise RuntimeError(f"Non-finite loss at variant={variant}, epoch={ep}")
143 | 
144 |         total_loss.backward()
145 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(optim_params, 1.0)
146 |         optimizer.step()
147 | 
148 |         loss_v = float(total_loss.item())
149 |         losses_hist.append(loss_v)
150 | 
151 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
152 |             print(f"[{variant}] epoch={ep:03d} total_loss={loss_v:.6f}")
153 | 
154 |         # erken durdurma: tek örnekte aşırı iyi fit
155 |         if ep > 10 and loss_v < 0.03:
156 |             break
157 | 
158 |     init_loss = float(losses_hist[0])
159 |     final_loss = float(losses_hist[-1])
160 |     reduction = float((init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-12) * 100.0)
161 | 
162 |     return {
163 |         "init": init_loss,
164 |         "final": final_loss,
165 |         "reduction": reduction,
166 |         "epochs_ran": float(len(losses_hist)),
167 |         "total_params": float(total_params),
168 |         "trainable_params": float(trainable_params),
169 |     }
170 | 
171 | 
172 | def run(
173 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
174 |     epochs: int = 80,
175 |     lr: float = 1e-4,
176 |     d_state: int = 16,
177 |     d_conv: int = 4,
178 |     seed: int = 0,
179 | ) -> Dict[str, bool]:
180 |     _set_seed(seed)
181 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
182 | 
183 |     db_ind, images, masks, targets = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=cfg_name, device=device)
184 | 
185 |     variants = ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]
186 |     rows = []
187 |     for i, variant in enumerate(variants):
188 |         print("\n" + "-" * 96)
189 |         print(f"Training variant {variant} ({i + 1}/{len(variants)})")
190 |         print("-" * 96)
191 |         stat = _train_one_variant(
192 |             cfg_name=cfg_name,
193 |             variant=variant,
194 |             images=images,
195 |             masks=masks,
196 |             targets=targets,
197 |             d_state=d_state,
198 |             d_conv=d_conv,
199 |             epochs=epochs,
200 |             lr=lr,
201 |             seed=seed,
202 |         )
203 |         row = {"variant": variant, **stat}
204 |         rows.append(row)
205 | 
206 |     best = max(rows, key=lambda x: x["reduction"])
207 |     baseline = next(r for r in rows if r["variant"] == "BASE")
208 | 
209 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
210 |     checks["all_variants_reduce"] = all(r["final"] < r["init"] for r in rows)
211 |     checks["base_over_20pct"] = baseline["reduction"] > 20.0

+"""
+BÖLÜM 0 — VSSD kurulum ve import kontrolü.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Dict
+
+import torch
+
+
+class NonCausalMamba2Approx(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32):
+        super().__init__()
+        from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
+
+        self.fwd = Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim)
+        self.bwd = Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim)
+        self.merge = torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)

+    def forward(self, x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        f = self.fwd(x_bsc)
+        b = self.bwd(torch.flip(x_bsc, dims=[1]))
+        b = torch.flip(b, dims=[1])
+        return self.merge(torch.cat([f, b], dim=-1))

+def run(batch: int = 2, seq: int = 260, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32) -> Dict[str, object]:

+"""
+BÖLÜM 1 — Mevcut BidirectionalMambaEncoder kontratını kaydet.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import random
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _forward_to_encoder(model, images, masks):
+    p = model.conv1(images)
+    p = model.bn1(p)
+    p = model.relu(p)
+    p = model.maxpool(p)
+    p = model.layer1(p)
+    p = model.layer2(p)
+    p = model.layer3(p)
+    p = model.layer4(p)
+
+    pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
+    pos = model.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
+
+    src = model.input_proj(p).flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
+    pos_s = pos.flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
+    memory, _w = model.transformer.encoder(src, src_key_padding_mask=pmasks.flatten(1), pos=pos_s)
+    return src, memory
+
+
+def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b", batch: int = 2, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
+    model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
+
+    images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+    masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
+
+    src, memory = _forward_to_encoder(model, images, masks)
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["input_shape_ok"] = tuple(src.shape) == (260, batch, 32)
+    checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(memory.shape) == (260, batch, 32)
+
+    # basit feature diversity
+    flat = memory.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(batch, -1)
+    norm = torch.nn.functional.normalize(flat, dim=-1)
+    sim = norm @ norm.t()
+    off = sim[~torch.eye(batch, dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]
+    avg_off = float(off.mean().item()) if off.numel() > 0 else 0.0
+    checks["feature_diversity"] = avg_off < 0.85
+
+    # gradient path
+    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    loss = memory.pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    checks["gradient_encoder"] = any(
+        (p.grad is not None) and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+        for p in model.transformer.encoder.parameters()
+    )
+    checks["gradient_reaches_decoder"] = model.query_embed.weight.grad is not None and float(model.query_embed.weight.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 1 — ENCODER KONTRAT")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"src={tuple(src.shape)} memory={tuple(memory.shape)}")
+    print(f"avg_off_diag_cos={avg_off:.4f}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<26}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b")
+    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY3 BÖLÜM1 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD / non-causal SSM izole test.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import random
+import time
+from typing import Dict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+class NonCausalMambaEncoder(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, num_layers: int = 2):
+        super().__init__()
+        from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
+
+        self.fwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+        self.bwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+        self.merge = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+        self.norm = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+
+    def forward(self, x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = x_bsc
+        for f, b, m, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm):
+            xf = f(x)
+            xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
+            x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
+        return x
+
+
+def _bench(fn, warmup: int = 5, iters: int = 20) -> float:
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        _ = fn()
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t1 = time.perf_counter()
+    return (t1 - t0) / float(iters)
+
+
+def run(batch: int = 2, seq: int = 260, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    x = torch.randn(batch, seq, d_model, device=device)
+    enc = NonCausalMambaEncoder(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim, num_layers=2).to(device)
+    y = enc(x)
+
+    checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
+    checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(y.shape) == (batch, seq, d_model)
+    checks["no_nan"] = bool(torch.isfinite(y).all().item())
+
+    # grad
+    enc.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    xg = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    yg = enc(xg)
+    loss = yg.pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    grad_ok = any((p.grad is not None) and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12 for p in enc.parameters())
+    checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (xg.grad is not None) and float(xg.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
+
+    # baseline bidir mamba1 encoder (izole basit hız karşılaştırma)
+    from mamba_ssm import Mamba
+    m1f = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
+    m1b = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
+
+    def _bidir_m1(inp):
+        yf = m1f(inp)
+        yb = torch.flip(m1b(torch.flip(inp, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
+        return yf + yb
+
+    t_bidir_m1 = _bench(lambda: _bidir_m1(x))
+    t_vssd = _bench(lambda: enc(x))
+    checks["speedup_vs_bidir"] = float(t_bidir_m1 / max(t_vssd, 1e-12))
+
+    # kalite proxy: sample içi token cosine çeşitliliği
+    yy = y[0]
+    yy_n = torch.nn.functional.normalize(yy, dim=-1)
+    sim = yy_n @ yy_n.t()
+    off = sim[~torch.eye(sim.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]
+    quality = float(off.mean().item())
+    checks["quality_vs_bidir"] = quality
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD İZOLE")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"x={tuple(x.shape)} y={tuple(y.shape)}")

 2 | BÖLÜM 0 — VSSD kurulum ve import kontrolü.

 5 | import argparse
 6 | from typing import Dict
 7 | 
 8 | import torch
 9 | 
10 | 
11 | class NonCausalMamba2Approx(torch.nn.Module):
12 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32):
13 |         super().__init__()
14 |         from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
15 | 
16 |         self.fwd = Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim)
17 |         self.bwd = Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim)
18 |         self.merge = torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
19 | 
20 |     def forward(self, x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
21 |         f = self.fwd(x_bsc)
22 |         b = self.bwd(torch.flip(x_bsc, dims=[1]))
23 |         b = torch.flip(b, dims=[1])
24 |         return self.merge(torch.cat([f, b], dim=-1))
25 | 
26 | 
27 | def run(batch: int = 2, seq: int = 260, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32) -> Dict[str, object]:
28 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
29 |     checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
30 | 
31 |     try:
32 |         import vssd  # type: ignore
33 |         checks["vssd_available"] = True
34 |         checks["vssd_module"] = str(vssd)
35 |     except Exception:
36 |         checks["vssd_available"] = False
37 | 
38 |     approx_ok = False
39 |     out_shape_ok = False
40 |     try:
41 |         approx = NonCausalMamba2Approx(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim).to(device)
42 |         x = torch.randn(batch, seq, d_model, device=device)
43 |         y = approx(x)
44 |         approx_ok = True
45 |         out_shape_ok = tuple(y.shape) == (batch, seq, d_model)
46 |     except Exception as e:
47 |         checks["approx_error"] = str(e)
48 | 
49 |     checks["approx_build_ok"] = approx_ok
50 |     checks["forward_shape_ok"] = out_shape_ok
51 | 
52 |     print("=" * 96)
53 |     print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 0 — VSSD KURULUM")
54 |     print("=" * 96)
55 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
56 |     print(f"vssd_available : {'✅' if checks['vssd_available'] else '⚠️'}")
57 |     print(f"approx_build_ok : {'✅' if checks['approx_build_ok'] else '🚨'}")
58 |     print(f"forward_shape_ok: {'✅' if checks['forward_shape_ok'] else '🚨'}")
59 |     if "approx_error" in checks:
60 |         print(f"approx_error    : {checks['approx_error']}")
61 | 
62 |     return checks
63 | 
64 | 
65 | def main():
66 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
67 |     parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
68 |     parser.add_argument("--seq", type=int, default=260)
69 |     parser.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=32)
70 |     parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=64)
71 |     parser.add_argument("--headdim", type=int, default=32)
72 |     args = parser.parse_args()
73 | 
74 |     checks = run(batch=args.batch, seq=args.seq, d_model=args.d_model, d_state=args.d_state, headdim=args.headdim)
75 |     ok = bool(checks.get("approx_build_ok", False)) and bool(checks.get("forward_shape_ok", False))
76 |     print("\n" + "=" * 96)

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 1 — Mevcut BidirectionalMambaEncoder kontratını kaydet.
  3 | """
  4 | 
  5 | import argparse
  6 | import random
  7 | from typing import Dict
  8 | 
  9 | import numpy as np
 10 | import torch
 11 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 12 | 
 13 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
 14 | 
 15 | 
 16 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 17 |     random.seed(seed)
 18 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 19 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 20 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 21 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 22 | 
 23 | 
 24 | def _forward_to_encoder(model, images, masks):
 25 |     p = model.conv1(images)
 26 |     p = model.bn1(p)
 27 |     p = model.relu(p)
 28 |     p = model.maxpool(p)
 29 |     p = model.layer1(p)
 30 |     p = model.layer2(p)
 31 |     p = model.layer3(p)
 32 |     p = model.layer4(p)
 33 | 
 34 |     pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
 35 |     pos = model.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
 36 | 
 37 |     src = model.input_proj(p).flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
 38 |     pos_s = pos.flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
 39 |     memory, _w = model.transformer.encoder(src, src_key_padding_mask=pmasks.flatten(1), pos=pos_s)
 40 |     return src, memory
 41 | 
 42 | 
 43 | def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b", batch: int = 2, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 44 |     _set_seed(seed)
 45 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 46 | 
 47 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 48 |     in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
 49 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
 50 | 
 51 |     images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 52 |     masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 53 | 
 54 |     src, memory = _forward_to_encoder(model, images, masks)
 55 | 
 56 |     checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
 57 |     checks["input_shape_ok"] = tuple(src.shape) == (260, batch, 32)
 58 |     checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(memory.shape) == (260, batch, 32)
 59 | 
 60 |     # basit feature diversity
 61 |     flat = memory.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(batch, -1)
 62 |     norm = torch.nn.functional.normalize(flat, dim=-1)
 63 |     sim = norm @ norm.t()
 64 |     off = sim[~torch.eye(batch, dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]
 65 |     avg_off = float(off.mean().item()) if off.numel() > 0 else 0.0
 66 |     checks["feature_diversity"] = avg_off < 0.85
 67 | 
 68 |     # gradient path
 69 |     model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 70 |     loss = memory.pow(2).mean()
 71 |     loss.backward()
 72 |     checks["gradient_encoder"] = any(
 73 |         (p.grad is not None) and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
 74 |         for p in model.transformer.encoder.parameters()
 75 |     )
 76 |     checks["gradient_reaches_decoder"] = model.query_embed.weight.grad is not None and float(model.query_embed.weight.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
 77 | 
 78 |     print("=" * 96)
 79 |     print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 1 — ENCODER KONTRAT")
 80 |     print("=" * 96)
 81 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
 82 |     print(f"src={tuple(src.shape)} memory={tuple(memory.shape)}")
 83 |     print(f"avg_off_diag_cos={avg_off:.4f}")
 84 | 
 85 |     print("\nKontroller:")
 86 |     for k, v in checks.items():
 87 |         print(f"  {k:<26}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
 88 |     return checks
 89 | 
 90 | 
 91 | def main():
 92 |     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
 93 |     parser.add_argument("--cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b")
 94 |     parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=2)
 95 |     parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
 96 |     args = parser.parse_args()
 97 | 
 98 |     checks = run(cfg_name=args.cfg, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed)
 99 |     ok = all(checks.values())
100 |     print("\n" + "=" * 96)
101 |     print("RAPOR")
102 |     print("=" * 96)
103 |     print(f"DENEY3 BÖLÜM1 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
104 |     if not ok:
105 |         raise SystemExit(1)
106 | 
107 | 
108 | if __name__ == "__main__":
109 |     main()

  1 | """
  2 | BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD / non-causal SSM izole test.
  3 | """
  4 | 
  5 | import argparse
  6 | import random
  7 | import time
  8 | from typing import Dict
  9 | 
 10 | import numpy as np
 11 | import torch
 12 | 
 13 | 
 14 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 15 |     random.seed(seed)
 16 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 17 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 18 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 19 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
 20 | 
 21 | 
 22 | class NonCausalMambaEncoder(torch.nn.Module):
 23 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, num_layers: int = 2):
 24 |         super().__init__()
 25 |         from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
 26 | 
 27 |         self.fwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 28 |         self.bwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 29 |         self.merge = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 30 |         self.norm = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 31 | 
 32 |     def forward(self, x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 33 |         x = x_bsc
 34 |         for f, b, m, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm):
 35 |             xf = f(x)
 36 |             xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
 37 |             x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
 38 |         return x
 39 | 
 40 | 
 41 | def _bench(fn, warmup: int = 5, iters: int = 20) -> float:
 42 |     for _ in range(warmup):
 43 |         _ = fn()
 44 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 45 |         torch.cuda.synchronize()
 46 |     t0 = time.perf_counter()
 47 |     for _ in range(iters):
 48 |         _ = fn()
 49 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 50 |         torch.cuda.synchronize()
 51 |     t1 = time.perf_counter()
 52 |     return (t1 - t0) / float(iters)
 53 | 
 54 | 
 55 | def run(batch: int = 2, seq: int = 260, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, object]:
 56 |     _set_seed(seed)
 57 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 58 | 
 59 |     x = torch.randn(batch, seq, d_model, device=device)
 60 |     enc = NonCausalMambaEncoder(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim, num_layers=2).to(device)
 61 |     y = enc(x)
 62 | 
 63 |     checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
 64 |     checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(y.shape) == (batch, seq, d_model)
 65 |     checks["no_nan"] = bool(torch.isfinite(y).all().item())
 66 | 
 67 |     # grad
 68 |     enc.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 69 |     xg = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
 70 |     yg = enc(xg)
 71 |     loss = yg.pow(2).mean()
 72 |     loss.backward()
 73 |     grad_ok = any((p.grad is not None) and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12 for p in enc.parameters())
 74 |     checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (xg.grad is not None) and float(xg.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
 75 | 
 76 |     # baseline bidir mamba1 encoder (izole basit hız karşılaştırma)
 77 |     from mamba_ssm import Mamba
 78 |     m1f = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
 79 |     m1b = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
 80 | 
 81 |     def _bidir_m1(inp):
 82 |         yf = m1f(inp)
 83 |         yb = torch.flip(m1b(torch.flip(inp, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
 84 |         return yf + yb
 85 | 
 86 |     t_bidir_m1 = _bench(lambda: _bidir_m1(x))
 87 |     t_vssd = _bench(lambda: enc(x))
 88 |     checks["speedup_vs_bidir"] = float(t_bidir_m1 / max(t_vssd, 1e-12))
 89 | 
 90 |     # kalite proxy: sample içi token cosine çeşitliliği
 91 |     yy = y[0]
 92 |     yy_n = torch.nn.functional.normalize(yy, dim=-1)
 93 |     sim = yy_n @ yy_n.t()
 94 |     off = sim[~torch.eye(sim.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]
 95 |     quality = float(off.mean().item())
 96 |     checks["quality_vs_bidir"] = quality
 97 | 
 98 |     print("=" * 96)
 99 |     print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD İZOLE")
100 |     print("=" * 96)
101 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
102 |     print(f"x={tuple(x.shape)} y={tuple(y.shape)}")
103 |     print(f"speedup_vs_bidir={checks['speedup_vs_bidir']:.3f}x")
104 |     print(f"quality_proxy(avg_off_diag_cos)={quality:.4f}")
105 | 
106 |     print("\nKontroller:")
107 |     for k in ["output_shape_ok", "no_nan", "gradient_flow"]:
108 |         print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if checks[k] else '🚨'}")
109 |     print(f"  {'speedup_vs_bidir':<18}: {checks['speedup_vs_bidir']:.3f}")
110 |     print(f"  {'quality_vs_bidir':<18}: {quality:.4f}")
111 | 
112 |     return checks

119 |     parser.add_argument("--d-model", type=int, default=32)

 25 |     query: torch.Tensor,

 38 | def _build_mamba2(d_model: int, d_state: int, d_conv: int, headdim: int):
 39 |     if Mamba2 is None:
 40 |         raise ImportError("Mamba2 import edilemedi. mamba-ssm sürümünü güncelleyin.")
 41 | 
 42 |     hd_candidates = [headdim, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]
 43 |     hd_unique = []
 44 |     for h in hd_candidates:
 45 |         h = int(h)
 46 |         if h <= 0:
 47 |             continue
 48 |         if h not in hd_unique:
 49 |             hd_unique.append(h)
 50 | 
 51 |     candidate_kwargs = []
 52 |     for h in hd_unique:
 53 |         if d_model % h != 0:
 54 |             continue
 55 |         candidate_kwargs.extend(
 56 |             [
 57 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv, "headdim": h},
 58 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": h},
 59 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv},
 60 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 61 |             ]
 62 |         )
 63 | 
 64 |     candidate_kwargs.extend(
 65 |         [
 66 |             {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": headdim},
 67 |             {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 68 |         ]
 69 |     )
 70 | 
 71 |     last_err: Optional[Exception] = None
 72 |     for kw in candidate_kwargs:
 73 |         try:
 74 |             layer = Mamba2(**kw)
 75 |             return layer, kw
 76 |         except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover
 77 |             last_err = e
 78 |             continue
 79 | 
 80 |     raise RuntimeError(f"Mamba2 oluşturulamadı (d_model={d_model}, d_state={d_state}, headdim={headdim}).") from last_err

 83 | class MambaDecoderLayerA(nn.Module):
 84 |     """Varyant A — Prefix concat."""
 85 | 
 86 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 87 |         super().__init__()
 88 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 89 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 90 | 
 91 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 92 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 93 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 94 |         combined = torch.cat([memory, query], dim=0)     # (S+L,B,C)
 95 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))  # (B,S+L,C)
 96 |         out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                   # (S+L,B,C)
 97 |         new_query = out[-lq:]                            # (L,B,C)
 98 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)
 99 |

101 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Naive(nn.Module):
102 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
103 | 
104 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
105 |         super().__init__()
106 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
107 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
108 | 
109 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
110 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
111 |         lq = query.shape[0]
112 |         new_qs = []
113 |         for i in range(lq):
114 |             qi = query[i : i + 1]                           # (1,B,C)
115 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
116 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
117 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
118 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)
119 |         new_query = torch.cat(new_qs, dim=0)
120 |         return self.norm(new_query)

123 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
124 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
125 | 
126 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
127 |         super().__init__()
128 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
129 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
130 | 
131 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
132 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
133 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
134 |         lq = query.shape[0]
135 | 
136 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
137 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
138 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
139 | 
140 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
141 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
142 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
143 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

146 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
147 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
148 | 
149 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
150 |         super().__init__()
151 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
152 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
153 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
154 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
155 | 
156 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
157 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
158 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
159 |         lq = query.shape[0]
160 | 
161 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
162 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
163 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
164 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
165 | 
166 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
167 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
168 | 
169 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
170 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
171 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
172 | 
173 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
174 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
175 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
176 | 
177 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
178 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
179 |         return out
180 |

183 |     """Varyant D — Query-aware Mamba2 (B varyantının Mamba2 karşılığı)."""
184 | 
185 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32):
186 |         super().__init__()
187 |         self.mamba, self.mamba2_kwargs = _build_mamba2(
188 |             d_model=d_model,
189 |             d_state=d_state,
190 |             d_conv=d_conv,
191 |             headdim=headdim,
192 |         )
193 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
194 | 
195 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
196 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
197 |         lq = query.shape[0]
198 | 
199 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
200 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
201 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
202 | 
203 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
204 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
205 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
206 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

208 | 
209 | class _BaseMambaDecoder(nn.Module):
210 |     def __init__(
211 |         self,
212 |         layer_cls,
213 |         num_layers: int = 2,
214 |         d_model: int = 32,
215 |         d_state: int = 16,
216 |         d_conv: int = 4,
217 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
218 |         layer_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
219 |     ):
220 |         super().__init__()
221 |         kwargs = {} if layer_kwargs is None else dict(layer_kwargs)
222 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
223 |             [layer_cls(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, **kwargs) for _ in range(num_layers)]
224 |         )
225 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
226 |         self.return_intermediate = return_intermediate
227 | 
228 |     def _forward_layer(
229 |         self,
230 |         layer: nn.Module,
231 |         output: torch.Tensor,
232 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
233 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
234 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
235 |     ) -> torch.Tensor:
236 |         if _is_attn_like_layer(layer):
237 |             return layer(output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
238 |         mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
239 |         return layer(mem, qry)
240 | 
241 |     def forward(
242 |         self,
243 |         tgt: torch.Tensor,
244 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
245 |         tgt_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
246 |         memory_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
247 |         tgt_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
248 |         memory_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
249 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
250 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
251 |     ):
252 |         del tgt_mask, memory_mask, tgt_key_padding_mask, memory_key_padding_mask
253 |         output = tgt
254 |         intermediate = []
255 | 
256 |         for layer in self.layers:
257 |             output = self._forward_layer(layer, output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
258 |             if self.return_intermediate:
259 |                 intermediate.append(self.norm(output))
260 | 
261 |         output = self.norm(output)
262 |         if self.return_intermediate:
263 |             intermediate[-1] = output
264 |             return torch.stack(intermediate)
265 |         return output
266 |

346 | class MambaDecoderE_Hybrid(_BaseMambaDecoder):
347 |     """Varyant E — katman sırası olarak Hybrid (MambaB -> CrossAttn)."""
348 | 
349 |     def __init__(
350 |         self,
351 |         num_layers: int = 2,
352 |         d_model: int = 32,
353 |         d_state: int = 16,
354 |         d_conv: int = 4,
355 |         num_heads: int = 2,
356 |         dim_feedforward: int = 128,
357 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
358 |         dropout: float = 0.1,
359 |     ):
360 |         super().__init__(
361 |             layer_cls=MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch,
362 |             num_layers=1,
363 |             d_model=d_model,

366 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
367 |         )

369 |         from models.py_utils.transformer import TransformerDecoderLayer
370 | 
371 |         layers: list[nn.Module] = [
372 |             MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
373 |         ]
374 |         for _ in range(max(int(num_layers) - 1, 0)):
375 |             layers.append(

377 |                     d_model=d_model,
378 |                     nhead=int(num_heads),
379 |                     dim_feedforward=int(dim_feedforward),
380 |                     dropout=float(dropout),
381 |                     activation="relu",

383 |                 )
384 |             )

441 |             return_intermediate=return_intermediate,

443 |         )
444 |     raise ValueError(f"Unknown variant: {variant}")

  1 | """
  2 | LSTR + Gerçek mamba-ssm Bidirectional Encoder Modülü
  3 | 
  4 | Kullanım:
  5 |     from models.py_utils.mamba_encoder import BidirectionalMambaEncoder
  6 |     model.transformer.encoder = BidirectionalMambaEncoder().cuda()
  7 | 
  8 | Gereksinim: pip install mamba-ssm causal-conv1d
  9 | """
 10 | 
 11 | import torch
 12 | import torch.nn as nn
 13 | from mamba_ssm import Mamba
 14 | from config import system_configs
 15 | 
 16 | 
 17 | class BidirectionalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
 18 |     """
 19 |     LSTR transformer.encoder'ı yerine geçen gerçek Mamba tabanlı encoder.
 20 | 
 21 |     Causality Çözümü:
 22 |         Mamba doğası gereği causal (soldan-sağa). Feature map'te sağdaki
 23 |         lane token'ları soldakileri göremez. Çözüm: iki yönlü Mamba bloğu.
 24 |         - Forward  pass: x olduğu gibi geçer
 25 |         - Backward pass: x flip edilir, sonuç geri flip edilir
 26 |         - İkisi toplanır → Bidirectional
 27 | 
 28 |     Sequence boyutu notu:
 29 |         240 token (12×20), standart attention'a karşı Mamba'nın belirgin
 30 |         hız avantajının ortaya çıktığı eşiğin (>512 token) altında.
 31 |         Avantaj burada FPS değil, O(N) bellek kompleksitesinde.
 32 | 
 33 |     LSTR forward signature uyumu:
 34 |         Mevcut encoder: (src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None) → (out, weights)
 35 |         src boyutu : (HW=240, B=1, D=32)  ← PyTorch seq-first
 36 |         Mamba girdisi: (B=1, HW=240, D=32) ← batch-first → permute gerekli
 37 | 
 38 |     enc_attn_weights shape:
 39 |         test/culane.py:169 → enc_attn_weights[0].reshape(shape + shape)
 40 |         shape = conv_features.shape[-2:] = (12, 20)
 41 |         reshape(shape + shape) = reshape(12, 20, 12, 20) ← (HW, HW) olarak görülüyor
 42 |         Aslında hook output[1] alıyor → self_attn weight shape: (B*num_heads, HW, HW)
 43 |         Bizim wrapper'da: (num_heads, HW, HW) döndürülüyor.
 44 |         enc_attn_weights[0] → (HW, HW) = (240, 240), reshape(12,20,12,20) → OK
 45 |     """
 46 | 
 47 |     def __init__(self):
 48 |         super().__init__()
 49 |         d_model        = system_configs.attn_dim        # 32 (CULane config)
 50 |         d_state        = 16                              # SSM state boyutu
 51 |         d_conv         = 4                               # Causal conv kernel
 52 |         expand         = 2                               # inner = d_model * expand = 64
 53 |         n_layers       = system_configs.enc_layers       # 2 (CULane config)
 54 |         self.n_layers  = n_layers
 55 |         self.num_heads = system_configs.num_heads        # 2 (CULane config)
 56 | 
 57 |         self.mamba_fwd_layers = nn.ModuleList([
 58 |             Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, expand=expand)
 59 |             for _ in range(n_layers)
 60 |         ])
 61 |         self.mamba_bwd_layers = nn.ModuleList([
 62 |             Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, expand=expand)
 63 |             for _ in range(n_layers)
 64 |         ])
 65 |         self.norms = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(n_layers)])
 66 | 
 67 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
 68 |         """
 69 |         Args:
 70 |             src: (HW, B, D) — LSTR seq-first formatı
 71 |             src_key_padding_mask: (B, HW) — padding mask (opsiyonel)
 72 |             pos: (HW, B, D) — positional encoding (opsiyonel)
 73 |         Returns:
 74 |             out: (HW, B, D)
 75 |             dummy_weights: (num_heads, HW, HW) — test/culane.py:169 uyumlu
 76 |         """
 77 |         if pos is not None:
 78 |             src = src + pos
 79 | 
 80 |         # (HW, B, D) → (B, HW, D)  Mamba batch-first bekliyor
 81 |         x = src.permute(1, 0, 2)
 82 | 
 83 |         for fwd, bwd, norm in zip(self.mamba_fwd_layers, self.mamba_bwd_layers, self.norms):
 84 |             x_fwd = fwd(x)
 85 |             x_bwd = torch.flip(bwd(torch.flip(x, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
 86 |             x = norm(x + x_fwd + x_bwd)   # residual + add bidirectional
 87 | 
 88 |         # (B, HW, D) → (HW, B, D)  LSTR seq-first'e geri
 89 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
 90 | 
 91 |         # enc_attn_weights: test/culane.py:169'da
 92 |         #   enc_attn_weights[0].reshape(shape + shape)
 93 |         #   shape = (12, 20) → reshape(12, 20, 12, 20)
 94 |         # self_attn output[1] → (B*num_heads, HW, HW) 
 95 |         B = out.shape[1]
 96 |         src_hw = out.shape[0]  # 240
 97 |         dummy_weights = torch.zeros(
 98 |             B * self.num_heads, src_hw, src_hw, device=out.device
 99 |         )
100 |         return out, dummy_weights
101 |

 16 | import torch
 17 | import torch.nn as nn

 23 | 
 24 | def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1, dilation=1):
 25 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride,
 26 |                      padding=dilation, groups=groups, bias=False, dilation=dilation)
 27 | 
 28 | def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
 29 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 33 |     expansion = 1
 34 | 
 35 |     def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample=None, groups=1,
 36 |                  base_width=64, dilation=1, norm_layer=None):
 37 |         super(BasicBlock, self).__init__()
 38 |         if norm_layer is None:
 39 |             norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
 40 |         if groups != 1 or base_width != 64:
 41 |             raise ValueError('BasicBlock only supports groups=1 and base_width=64')
 42 |         if dilation > 1:
 43 |             raise NotImplementedError("Dilation > 1 not supported in BasicBlock")
 44 |         self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
 45 |         self.bn1   = norm_layer(planes)
 46 |         self.relu  = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 47 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
 48 |         self.bn2   = norm_layer(planes)
 49 |         self.downsample = downsample
 50 |         self.stride = stride
 51 | 
 52 |     def forward(self, x):
 53 |         identity = x
 54 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
 55 |         out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
 56 |         if self.downsample is not None:
 57 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
 58 |         out += identity
 59 |         return self.relu(out)
 60 | 
 61 | 
 62 | class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
 63 |     expansion = 4
 64 | 
 65 |     def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample=None, groups=1,
 66 |                  base_width=64, dilation=1, norm_layer=None):
 67 |         super(Bottleneck, self).__init__()
 68 |         if norm_layer is None:
 69 |             norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
 70 |         width = int(planes * (base_width / 64.)) * groups
 71 |         self.conv1  = conv1x1(inplanes, width)
 72 |         self.bn1    = norm_layer(width)
 73 |         self.conv2  = conv3x3(width, width, stride, groups, dilation)
 74 |         self.bn2    = norm_layer(width)
 75 |         self.conv3  = conv1x1(width, planes * self.expansion)
 76 |         self.bn3    = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
 77 |         self.relu   = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 78 |         self.downsample = downsample
 79 |         self.stride = stride
 80 | 
 81 |     def forward(self, x):
 82 |         identity = x
 83 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
 84 |         out = self.relu(self.bn2(self.conv2(out)))
 85 |         out = self.bn3(self.conv3(out))
 86 |         if self.downsample is not None:
 87 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
 88 |         out += identity
 89 |         return self.relu(out)

 81 | def run(
 82 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
 83 |     d_state: int = 16,
 84 |     d_conv: int = 4,

 93 |     post = PostProcess().to(device)
 94 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
 95 | 
 96 |     run_variants = variants if variants is not None else ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]

 99 |     for variant in run_variants:
100 |         model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
101 |         old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
102 |         if variant.upper() != "BASE":

104 |             d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
105 |             return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
106 |             new_decoder = build_variant_decoder(

116 |             )
117 |             model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)
118 | 
119 |         # 5.1 output contract
120 |         model.train()
121 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
122 |         key_ok = all(k in outputs for k in ["pred_logits", "pred_curves"])
123 |         shape_ok = (
124 |             key_ok

139 |                 viz_split="train",
140 |                 outputs=outputs,
141 |                 targets=targets,
142 |             )
143 |             loss_total = loss_pack[0]

152 |         writer_ok = False

155 |         try:

169 |                 _ = db.pred2culaneformat(

174 |                 )
175 |                 writer_ok = True

199 |     checks["all_loss_finite"] = all(r["loss_finite"] for r in variant_rows)

 24 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:

 32 | def _replace_decoder(model: torch.nn.Module, variant: str, d_state: int, d_conv: int) -> None:
 33 |     if variant.upper() == "BASE":
 34 |         return
 35 | 
 36 |     old_decoder = model.transformer.decoder
 37 |     num_layers = len(old_decoder.layers)
 38 |     d_model = int(getattr(model.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
 39 |     return_intermediate = bool(getattr(old_decoder, "return_intermediate", True))
 40 |

 42 |         variant=variant,

 44 |         d_model=d_model,
 45 |         d_state=d_state,
 46 |         d_conv=d_conv,
 47 |         return_intermediate=return_intermediate,
 48 |         headdim=32,
 49 |         num_heads=int(system_configs.num_heads),
 50 |         dim_feedforward=int(system_configs.dim_feedforward),
 51 |     )
 52 |     model.transformer.decoder = new_decoder.to(next(model.parameters()).device)

 55 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
 56 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 57 |     db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
 58 |     db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
 59 |     image_t, label_np, _ = db.__getitem__(db_ind, transform=True)
 60 | 
 61 |     images = image_t.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 62 |     masks = torch.zeros((1, 1, images.shape[-2], images.shape[-1]), device=device)
 63 |     # AELoss beklentisi: targets[1:] elemanları (B, L, D) olmalı.
 64 |     # B=1 olduğu için tek bir label tensor yeterli.
 65 |     label_batch = torch.from_numpy(label_np.astype(np.float32)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
 66 |     targets = [images, label_batch]
 67 | 
 68 |     return db_ind, images, masks, targets

 70 | 
 71 | def _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
 72 |     """
 73 |     Decoder etkisini daha net görmek için backbone + encoder dondur.
 74 |     Query/head katmanları açık kalır ki model tek örneği gerçekten öğrenebilsin.
 75 |     """
 76 |     freeze_prefixes = [
 77 |         "conv1",
 78 |         "bn1",
 79 |         "layer1",
 80 |         "layer2",
 81 |         "layer3",
 82 |         "layer4",
 83 |         "input_proj",
 84 |         "transformer.encoder",
 85 |     ]
 86 |     for name, p in model.named_parameters():
 87 |         if any(name.startswith(pref) for pref in freeze_prefixes):
 88 |             p.requires_grad_(False)
 89 | 
 90 | 
 91 | def _collect_trainable_stats(model: torch.nn.Module):
 92 |     total = 0
 93 |     trainable = 0
 94 |     for p in model.parameters():
 95 |         n = p.numel()
 96 |         total += n
 97 |         if p.requires_grad:
 98 |             trainable += n
 99 |     return total, trainable
100 | 
101 | 
102 | def _train_one_variant(
103 |     cfg_name: str,
104 |     variant: str,
105 |     images: torch.Tensor,
106 |     masks: torch.Tensor,
107 |     targets: List[torch.Tensor],
108 |     d_state: int,
109 |     d_conv: int,
110 |     epochs: int,
111 |     lr: float,
112 |     seed: int,
113 | ) -> Dict[str, float]:
114 |     _set_seed(seed)
115 |     device = images.device
116 | 
117 |     model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
118 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
119 |     _replace_decoder(model=model, variant=variant, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
120 |     _freeze_non_decoder_parts(model)
121 | 
122 |     criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
123 | 
124 |     optim_params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
125 |     optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(optim_params, lr=lr)
126 | 
127 |     total_params, trainable_params = _collect_trainable_stats(model)
128 | 
129 |     losses_hist: List[float] = []
130 |     for ep in range(epochs):
131 |         model.train()
132 |         optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
133 | 
134 |         outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
135 |         loss_pack = criterion(
136 |             iteration=0,
137 |             save=False,
138 |             viz_split="train",
139 |             outputs=outputs,
140 |             targets=targets,
141 |         )
142 |         total_loss = loss_pack[0]
143 | 
144 |         if not torch.isfinite(total_loss).all():
145 |             raise RuntimeError(f"Non-finite loss at variant={variant}, epoch={ep}")
146 | 
147 |         total_loss.backward()
148 |         torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(optim_params, 1.0)
149 |         optimizer.step()
150 | 
151 |         loss_v = float(total_loss.item())
152 |         losses_hist.append(loss_v)
153 | 
154 |         if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
155 |             print(f"[{variant}] epoch={ep:03d} total_loss={loss_v:.6f}")
156 | 
157 |         # erken durdurma: tek örnekte aşırı iyi fit
158 |         if ep > 10 and loss_v < 0.03:
159 |             break
160 | 
161 |     init_loss = float(losses_hist[0])
162 |     final_loss = float(losses_hist[-1])
163 |     reduction = float((init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-12) * 100.0)
164 | 
165 |     return {
166 |         "init": init_loss,
167 |         "final": final_loss,
168 |         "reduction": reduction,
169 |         "epochs_ran": float(len(losses_hist)),
170 |         "total_params": float(total_params),
171 |         "trainable_params": float(trainable_params),
172 |     }

175 | def run(
176 |     cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
177 |     epochs: int = 80,
178 |     lr: float = 1e-4,
179 |     d_state: int = 16,
180 |     d_conv: int = 4,
181 |     variants: List[str] | None = None,

186 | 
187 |     db_ind, images, masks, targets = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=cfg_name, device=device)
188 | 
189 |     variants_run = variants if variants is not None else ["BASE", "A", "B", "C"]
190 |     rows = []
191 |     for i, variant in enumerate(variants_run):

206 |         )

217 |     checks["best_variant_exists"] = best["variant"] in {"BASE", "A", "B", "C"}

238 |         )

242 |         print(f"  {k:<30}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
