  1 | """
  2 | LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA_D8 — Mamba d_state=8 ile parametre eşitliği ablation
  3 | 
  4 | Ablation amacı: Transformer encoder ile parametre sayısını eşitlemek.
  5 | d_state=8 → Mamba encoder ~25,400 param ≈ Transformer encoder ~25,400 param
  6 | 
  7 | Karşılaştırma:
  8 |   Transformer encoder: ~25,400 (d_model=32, 2-layer self_attn+FFN)
  9 |   Mamba d_state=16   : ~39,800 (+57% encoder, +1.9% total) — ana deney
 10 |   Mamba d_state=8    : ~25,400 (eşit encoder param)        — bu deney
 11 | """
 12 | import torch
 13 | import torch.nn as nn
 14 | 
 15 | from .py_utils import kp, AELoss
 16 | from config import system_configs
 17 | 
 18 | try:
 19 |     from mamba_ssm import Mamba as MambaSSM
 20 | except ImportError:
 21 |     raise ImportError("pip install mamba-ssm causal-conv1d --no-build-isolation")
 22 | 
 23 | 
 24 | def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1, dilation=1):
 25 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride,
 26 |                      padding=dilation, groups=groups, bias=False, dilation=dilation)
 27 | 
 28 | def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
 29 |     return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)
 30 | 
 31 | 
 32 | class BasicBlock(nn.Module):
 33 |     expansion = 1
 34 |     def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, downsample=None, groups=1,
 35 |                  base_width=64, dilation=1, norm_layer=None):
 36 |         super().__init__()
 37 |         norm_layer = norm_layer or nn.BatchNorm2d
 38 |         self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
 39 |         self.bn1   = norm_layer(planes)
 40 |         self.relu  = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
 41 |         self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
 42 |         self.bn2   = norm_layer(planes)
 43 |         self.downsample = downsample
 44 |         self.stride = stride
 45 | 
 46 |     def forward(self, x):
 47 |         identity = x
 48 |         out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
 49 |         out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
 50 |         if self.downsample is not None:
 51 |             identity = self.downsample(x)
 52 |         return self.relu(out + identity)
 53 | 
 54 | 
 55 | class BidirMambaD8(nn.Module):
 56 |     """d_state=8 — Transformer encoder ile eşit parametre sayısı."""
 57 |     def __init__(self):
 58 |         super().__init__()
 59 |         d_model    = system_configs.attn_dim   # 32
 60 |         d_state    = 8                          # ← KEY: 8 instead of 16
 61 |         enc_layers = system_configs.enc_layers  # 2
 62 |         self.num_heads = system_configs.num_heads  # 2
 63 | 
 64 |         self.fwd = nn.ModuleList([
 65 |             MambaSSM(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=4, expand=2)
 66 |             for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 67 |         self.bwd = nn.ModuleList([
 68 |             MambaSSM(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=4, expand=2)
 69 |             for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 70 |         self.norms = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(enc_layers)])
 71 | 
 72 |         enc_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
 73 |         print(f"[MAMBA_D8] encoder params: {enc_params:,} (d_state=8)")
 74 | 
 75 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
 76 |         if pos is not None:
 77 |             src = src + pos
 78 |         x = src.permute(1, 0, 2)  # (HW,B,D) → (B,HW,D)
 79 |         for f, b, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.norms):
 80 |             x = n(x + f(x) + torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, [1])), [1]))
 81 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
 82 |         B = out.shape[1]
 83 |         wts = torch.zeros(B * self.num_heads, out.shape[0], out.shape[0], device=out.device)
 84 |         return out, wts

+"""
+DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 3 — Encoder swap pipeline testi (BASE vs VSSD).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Encoder değişiminden sonra model output contract korunuyor mu?
+2) AELoss hattı finite kalıyor mu?
+3) PostProcess -> Evaluator -> CULane writer zinciri bozulmadan çalışıyor mu?
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib
+import random
+from typing import Dict, List
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from config import system_configs
+from db.culane import CULANE
+from db.utils.evaluator import Evaluator
+from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
+from sample.culane import sample_data
+from test.culane import PostProcess
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
+
+    original_batch_size = int(system_configs.batch_size)
+    system_configs.update_config({"batch_size": 1})
+    try:
+        sampled, _ = sample_data(db, 0)
+    finally:
+        system_configs.update_config({"batch_size": original_batch_size})
+
+    images = sampled["xs"][0].to(device)
+    masks = sampled["xs"][1].to(device)
+    targets = [y.to(device) for y in sampled["ys"]]
+
+    db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
+    target_sizes = torch.tensor(
+        [[int(images.shape[-2]), int(images.shape[-1])]] * int(images.shape[0]),
+        device=device,
+        dtype=torch.long,
+    )
+    return db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes
+
+
+def _run_one_cfg(
+    cfg_name: str,
+    db: CULANE,
+    db_ind: int,
+    images: torch.Tensor,
+    masks: torch.Tensor,
+    targets: List[torch.Tensor],
+    target_sizes: torch.Tensor,
+    post: PostProcess,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
+    model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
+
+    model.train()
+    outputs, enc_weights = model._train(images, masks)
+
+    key_ok = all(k in outputs for k in ["pred_logits", "pred_curves"])
+    shape_ok = (
+        key_ok
+        and outputs["pred_logits"].dim() == 3
+        and outputs["pred_curves"].dim() == 3
+        and int(outputs["pred_logits"].shape[0]) == 1
+        and int(outputs["pred_curves"].shape[0]) == 1
+    )
+
+    weights_ok = (
+        isinstance(enc_weights, torch.Tensor)
+        and enc_weights.dim() == 3
+        and int(enc_weights.shape[-1]) == int(enc_weights.shape[-2])
+        and bool(torch.isfinite(enc_weights).all().item())
+    )
+
+    loss_finite = False
+    loss_value = float("nan")
+    try:
+        criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
+        loss_pack = criterion(
+            iteration=0,
+            save=False,
+            viz_split="train",
+            outputs=outputs,
+            targets=targets,
+        )
+        loss_total = loss_pack[0]
+        loss_finite = bool(torch.isfinite(loss_total).all().item())
+        loss_value = float(loss_total.item())
+    except Exception:
+        loss_finite = False
+
+    postprocess_ok = False
+    evaluator_ok = False
+    writer_ok = False
+    post_shape = None
+    try:
+        model.eval()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            out_eval, _ = model._train(images, masks)
+            post_out = post(out_eval, target_sizes)
+
+        postprocess_ok = isinstance(post_out, torch.Tensor) and post_out.dim() == 3 and int(post_out.shape[0]) == 1
+        if postprocess_ok:
+            post_shape = tuple(post_out.shape)
+
+            evaluator = Evaluator(dataset=db, exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir)
+            evaluator.add_prediction(0, post_out[0:1].detach().cpu().numpy(), runtime=0.01)
+            evaluator_ok = evaluator.predictions_mode == "poly" and evaluator.predictions is not None
+
+            _ = db.pred2culaneformat(
+                db_ind,
+                post_out[0].detach().cpu().numpy(),
+                runtime=0.01,
+                exp_dir=system_configs.result_dir,
+            )
+            writer_ok = True
+    except Exception:
+        postprocess_ok = False
+        evaluator_ok = False
+        writer_ok = False
+
+    return {
+        "cfg": cfg_name,
+        "encoder_type": type(model.transformer.encoder).__name__,
+        "output_contract": bool(key_ok and shape_ok),
+        "weights_contract": bool(weights_ok),
+        "loss_finite": bool(loss_finite),
+        "loss_value": float(loss_value),
+        "postprocess_ok": bool(postprocess_ok),
+        "evaluator_ok": bool(evaluator_ok),
+        "writer_ok": bool(writer_ok),
+        "post_shape": post_shape,
+    }
+
+
+def run(
+    base_cfg: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
+    vssd_cfg: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_vssd",
+    seed: int = 0,
+) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    db, db_ind, images, masks, targets, target_sizes = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=base_cfg, device=device)
+    post = PostProcess().to(device)
+
+    rows = []
+    for cfg_name in [base_cfg, vssd_cfg]:
+        rows.append(
+            _run_one_cfg(
+                cfg_name=cfg_name,
+                db=db,
+                db_ind=db_ind,
+                images=images,
+                masks=masks,
+                targets=targets,
+                target_sizes=target_sizes,
+                post=post,
+                device=device,
+            )
+        )
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["all_output_contract"] = all(r["output_contract"] for r in rows)
+    checks["all_weights_contract"] = all(r["weights_contract"] for r in rows)
+    checks["all_loss_finite"] = all(r["loss_finite"] for r in rows)
+    checks["all_postprocess_ok"] = all(r["postprocess_ok"] for r in rows)
+    checks["all_evaluator_ok"] = all(r["evaluator_ok"] for r in rows)
+    checks["all_writer_ok"] = all(r["writer_ok"] for r in rows)
+    checks["vssd_encoder_present"] = any(
+        (r["cfg"] == vssd_cfg) and ("NonCausalMambaEncoder" in str(r["encoder_type"]))
+        for r in rows
+    )
+
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 3 — ENCODER SWAP PIPELINE")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"base_cfg={base_cfg}, vssd_cfg={vssd_cfg}")
+    print(f"sample_db_ind={db_ind}, input={tuple(images.shape)}")
+
+    print("\nModel bazlı sonuçlar:")
+    for r in rows:
+        print(
+            f"  [{r['cfg']}] encoder={r['encoder_type']} "
+            f"contract={'✅' if r['output_contract'] else '🚨'} "
+            f"weights={'✅' if r['weights_contract'] else '🚨'} "
+            f"loss={'✅' if r['loss_finite'] else '🚨'}({r['loss_value']:.4f}) "
+            f"post={'✅' if r['postprocess_ok'] else '🚨'} "
+            f"eval={'✅' if r['evaluator_ok'] else '🚨'} "
+            f"writer={'✅' if r['writer_ok'] else '🚨'}"
+        )
+        if r["post_shape"] is not None:
+            print(f"      post_out shape: {r['post_shape']}")
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<24}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--base-cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba")
+    parser.add_argument("--vssd-cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_vssd")
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(base_cfg=args.base_cfg, vssd_cfg=args.vssd_cfg, seed=args.seed)
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY3 BÖLÜM3 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 4 — Overfit karşılaştırma (BASE encoder vs VSSD encoder).
+
+Amaç:
+1) Aynı tek örnekte encoder swap'in öğrenilebilirliğe etkisini ölçmek
+2) VSSD encoder'ın gradient ve loss stabilitesini doğrulamak
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib
+import random
+from typing import Dict, List
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from config import system_configs
+from db.culane import CULANE
+from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config
+
+
+def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    np.random.seed(seed)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+
+
+def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):
+    cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
+    db = CULANE(cfg["db"], system_configs.train_split)
+    db_ind = int(db.db_inds[0])
+    image_t, label_np, _ = db.__getitem__(db_ind, transform=True)
+
+    images = image_t.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    masks = torch.zeros((1, 1, images.shape[-2], images.shape[-1]), device=device)
+    label_batch = torch.from_numpy(label_np.astype(np.float32)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    targets = [images, label_batch]
+
+    return db_ind, images, masks, targets
+
+
+def _freeze_non_encoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """
+    Encoder etkisini izole etmek için backbone + decoder + head'i dondur.
+    Sadece encoder trainable bırakılır.
+    """
+    for p in model.parameters():
+        p.requires_grad_(False)
+    for p in model.transformer.encoder.parameters():
+        p.requires_grad_(True)
+
+
+def _collect_trainable_stats(model: torch.nn.Module):
+    total = 0
+    trainable = 0
+    for p in model.parameters():
+        n = p.numel()
+        total += n
+        if p.requires_grad:
+            trainable += n
+    return total, trainable
+
+
+def _train_one_variant(
+    cfg_name: str,
+    images: torch.Tensor,
+    masks: torch.Tensor,
+    targets: List[torch.Tensor],
+    epochs: int,
+    lr: float,
+    seed: int,
+) -> Dict[str, float | str]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = images.device
+
+    model_module = importlib.import_module(f"models.{cfg_name}")
+    model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
+    _freeze_non_encoder_parts(model)
+
+    criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
+    optim_params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
+    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(optim_params, lr=lr)
+
+    total_params, trainable_params = _collect_trainable_stats(model)
+
+    losses_hist: List[float] = []
+    for ep in range(epochs):
+        model.train()
+        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+
+        outputs, _weights = model._train(images, masks)
+        loss_pack = criterion(
+            iteration=0,
+            save=False,
+            viz_split="train",
+            outputs=outputs,
+            targets=targets,
+        )
+        total_loss = loss_pack[0]
+
+        if not torch.isfinite(total_loss).all():
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Non-finite loss at cfg={cfg_name}, epoch={ep}")
+
+        total_loss.backward()
+        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(optim_params, 1.0)
+        optimizer.step()
+
+        loss_v = float(total_loss.item())
+        losses_hist.append(loss_v)
+
+        if ep % 20 == 0 or ep == epochs - 1:
+            print(f"[{cfg_name}] epoch={ep:03d} total_loss={loss_v:.6f}")
+
+        if ep > 10 and loss_v < 0.05:
+            break
+
+    init_loss = float(losses_hist[0])
+    final_loss = float(losses_hist[-1])
+    reduction = float((init_loss - final_loss) / max(init_loss, 1e-12) * 100.0)
+
+    return {
+        "cfg": cfg_name,
+        "encoder_type": type(model.transformer.encoder).__name__,
+        "init": init_loss,
+        "final": final_loss,
+        "reduction": reduction,
+        "epochs_ran": float(len(losses_hist)),
+        "total_params": float(total_params),
+        "trainable_params": float(trainable_params),
+    }
+
+
+def run(
+    base_cfg: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba",
+    vssd_cfg: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_vssd",
+    epochs: int = 80,
+    lr: float = 1e-4,
+    seed: int = 0,
+) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    _set_seed(seed)
+    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+
+    db_ind, images, masks, targets = _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name=base_cfg, device=device)
+
+    rows = []
+    for cfg_name in [base_cfg, vssd_cfg]:
+        print("\n" + "-" * 96)
+        print(f"Training encoder variant: {cfg_name}")
+        print("-" * 96)
+        rows.append(
+            _train_one_variant(
+                cfg_name=cfg_name,
+                images=images,
+                masks=masks,
+                targets=targets,
+                epochs=epochs,
+                lr=lr,
+                seed=seed,
+            )
+        )
+
+    base_row = next(r for r in rows if r["cfg"] == base_cfg)
+    vssd_row = next(r for r in rows if r["cfg"] == vssd_cfg)
+
+    checks: Dict[str, bool] = {}
+    checks["base_reduces"] = bool(base_row["final"] < base_row["init"])
+    checks["vssd_reduces"] = bool(vssd_row["final"] < vssd_row["init"])
+    checks["base_over_20pct"] = bool(base_row["reduction"] > 20.0)
+    checks["vssd_over_20pct"] = bool(vssd_row["reduction"] > 20.0)
+    checks["vssd_not_catastrophic"] = bool(vssd_row["reduction"] > -5.0)
+    checks["vssd_encoder_present"] = "NonCausalMambaEncoder" in str(vssd_row["encoder_type"])
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 4 — OVERFİT KARŞILAŞTIRMA")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"Device: {device}")
+    print(f"base_cfg={base_cfg}, vssd_cfg={vssd_cfg}")
+    print(f"sample_db_ind={db_ind}, input={tuple(images.shape)}")
+    print(f"epochs(max)={epochs}, lr={lr}")
+
+    print("\nSonuçlar:")
+    for r in rows:
+        print(
+            f"  [{r['cfg']}] encoder={r['encoder_type']} "
+            f"init={r['init']:.6f} final={r['final']:.6f} "
+            f"reduction={r['reduction']:+.2f}% epochs={int(r['epochs_ran'])} "
+            f"trainable={int(r['trainable_params']):,}/{int(r['total_params']):,}"
+        )
+
+    print("\nKontroller:")
+    for k, v in checks.items():
+        print(f"  {k:<22}: {'✅' if v else '🚨'}")
+
+    print("\nKarar özeti:")
+    print(f"  VSSD - BASE reduction farkı: {float(vssd_row['reduction']) - float(base_row['reduction']):+.2f} puan")
+
+    return checks
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--base-cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba")
+    parser.add_argument("--vssd-cfg", type=str, default="LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_vssd")
+    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=80)
+    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-4)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    checks = run(
+        base_cfg=args.base_cfg,
+        vssd_cfg=args.vssd_cfg,
+        epochs=args.epochs,
+        lr=args.lr,
+        seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    ok = all(checks.values())
+
+    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
+    print("RAPOR")
+    print("=" * 96)
+    print(f"DENEY3 BÖLÜM4 sonucu: {'✅' if ok else '🚨'}")
+    if not ok:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+

+"""
+2k Mamba + VSSD-style non-causal encoder deneyi.
+
+Taban model:
+  [models.LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA](models/LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA.py:1)
+
+Bu dosya sadece encoder'ı non-causal Mamba2 bloğu ile değiştirir.
+Decoder/head/loss hattı korunur.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+from config import system_configs
+from models.LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA import model as _BaseMambaModel
+from models.LSTR_CULANE_MAMBA import loss  # noqa: F401
+
+try:
+    from mamba_ssm import Mamba2  # type: ignore
+except Exception:
+    Mamba2 = None
+
+
+def _build_mamba2(d_model: int, d_state: int, d_conv: int, headdim: int) -> Tuple[nn.Module, Dict[str, int]]:
+    if Mamba2 is None:
+        raise ImportError("Mamba2 import edilemedi. `mamba-ssm` sürümünü güncelleyin.")
+
+    hd_candidates = [int(headdim), 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]
+    unique_hd = []
+    for h in hd_candidates:
+        if h > 0 and h not in unique_hd:
+            unique_hd.append(h)
+
+    candidate_kwargs = []
+    for h in unique_hd:
+        if d_model % h != 0:
+            continue
+        candidate_kwargs.extend(
+            [
+                {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv, "headdim": h},
+                {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": h},
+                {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv},
+                {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
+            ]
+        )
+
+    candidate_kwargs.extend(
+        [
+            {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": int(headdim)},
+            {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
+        ]
+    )
+
+    last_err: Optional[Exception] = None
+    for kw in candidate_kwargs:
+        try:
+            layer = Mamba2(**kw)
+            return layer, kw
+        except Exception as e:
+            last_err = e
+            continue
+
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        f"Mamba2 oluşturulamadı (d_model={d_model}, d_state={d_state}, d_conv={d_conv}, headdim={headdim})"
+    ) from last_err
+
+
+class NonCausalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """
+    LSTR encoder imzasına uyumlu non-causal Mamba2 encoder.
+
+    Girdi/çıktı imzası:
+      [models.py_utils.transformer.TransformerEncoder.forward()](models/py_utils/transformer.py:78)
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        d_model: int = 32,
+        d_state: int = 64,
+        d_conv: int = 4,
+        headdim: int = 32,
+        num_layers: int = 2,
+        num_heads: int = 2,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads = int(num_heads)
+
+        self.fwd = nn.ModuleList()
+        self.bwd = nn.ModuleList()
+        self.merge = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
+        self.norm = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
+
+        chosen_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None
+        for _ in range(int(num_layers)):
+            layer_fwd, kw = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
+            layer_bwd, _ = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
+            self.fwd.append(layer_fwd)
+            self.bwd.append(layer_bwd)
+            if chosen_kwargs is None:
+                chosen_kwargs = {k: int(v) for k, v in kw.items() if isinstance(v, int)}
+
+        self.mamba2_kwargs = chosen_kwargs or {}
+
+    def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
+        del src_key_padding_mask
+        if pos is not None:
+            src = src + pos
+
+        # (S, B, C) -> (B, S, C)
+        x = src.permute(1, 0, 2)
+
+        for f, b, m, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm):
+            xf = f(x)
+            xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
+            x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
+
+        # (B, S, C) -> (S, B, C)
+        out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
+
+        # test/culane debug hook uyumu için attention-like placeholder
+        bsz = out.shape[1]
+        seq = out.shape[0]
+        weights = torch.zeros(bsz * self.num_heads, seq, seq, device=out.device, dtype=out.dtype)
+        return out, weights
+
+
+class model(_BaseMambaModel):
+    def __init__(self, flag=False):
+        super().__init__(flag=flag)
+
+        d_model = int(getattr(self.transformer, "d_model", system_configs.attn_dim))
+        enc_layers = int(system_configs.enc_layers)
+        num_heads = int(system_configs.num_heads)
+
+        self.transformer.encoder = NonCausalMambaEncoder(
+            d_model=d_model,
+            d_state=64,
+            d_conv=4,
+            headdim=32,
+            num_layers=enc_layers,
+            num_heads=num_heads,
+        )
+
+        print(
+            "[LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_vssd] encoder -> NonCausalMambaEncoder "
+            f"(layers={enc_layers}, d_model={d_model}, kwargs={self.transformer.encoder.mamba2_kwargs})"
+        )
+

 39 |     if Mamba2 is None:
 40 |         raise ImportError("Mamba2 import edilemedi. mamba-ssm sürümünü güncelleyin.")

 42 |     hd_candidates = [headdim, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]

 44 |     for h in hd_candidates:
 45 |         h = int(h)
 46 |         if h <= 0:
 47 |             continue
 48 |         if h not in hd_unique:
 49 |             hd_unique.append(h)

 51 |     candidate_kwargs = []
 52 |     for h in hd_unique:
 53 |         if d_model % h != 0:
 54 |             continue
 55 |         candidate_kwargs.extend(
 56 |             [
 57 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv, "headdim": h},
 58 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": h},
 59 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv},
 60 |                 {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 61 |             ]
 62 |         )
 63 | 
 64 |     candidate_kwargs.extend(
 65 |         [
 66 |             {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": headdim},
 67 |             {"d_ssm": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 68 |         ]
 69 |     )
 70 | 
 71 |     last_err: Optional[Exception] = None
 72 |     for kw in candidate_kwargs:
 73 |         try:
 74 |             layer = Mamba2(**kw)
 75 |             return layer, kw
 76 |         except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover
 77 |             last_err = e

 83 | class MambaDecoderLayerA(nn.Module):
 84 |     """Varyant A — Prefix concat."""
 85 | 
 86 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
 87 |         super().__init__()
 88 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
 89 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
 90 | 
 91 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 92 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
 93 |         lq = query.shape[0]
 94 |         combined = torch.cat([memory, query], dim=0)     # (S+L,B,C)
 95 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))  # (B,S+L,C)
 96 |         out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                   # (S+L,B,C)
 97 |         new_query = out[-lq:]                            # (L,B,C)
 98 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

101 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Naive(nn.Module):
102 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
103 | 
104 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
105 |         super().__init__()
106 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
107 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
108 | 
109 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
110 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
111 |         lq = query.shape[0]
112 |         new_qs = []
113 |         for i in range(lq):
114 |             qi = query[i : i + 1]                           # (1,B,C)
115 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
116 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
117 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
118 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)
119 |         new_query = torch.cat(new_qs, dim=0)
120 |         return self.norm(new_query)

123 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
124 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
125 | 
126 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
127 |         super().__init__()
128 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
129 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
130 | 
131 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
132 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
133 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
134 |         lq = query.shape[0]
135 | 
136 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
137 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
138 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
139 | 
140 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
141 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
142 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
143 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)
144 | 
145 | 
146 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
147 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
148 | 
149 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
150 |         super().__init__()
151 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
152 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
153 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
154 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
155 | 
156 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
157 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
158 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
159 |         lq = query.shape[0]
160 | 
161 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
162 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
163 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
164 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
165 | 
166 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
167 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
168 | 
169 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
170 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
171 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
172 | 
173 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
174 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
175 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
176 | 
177 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
178 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
179 |         return out

182 | class MambaDecoderLayerD_Mamba2(nn.Module):
183 |     """Varyant D — Query-aware Mamba2 (B varyantının Mamba2 karşılığı)."""
184 | 
185 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32):
186 |         super().__init__()
187 |         self.mamba, self.mamba2_kwargs = _build_mamba2(
188 |             d_model=d_model,
189 |             d_state=d_state,
190 |             d_conv=d_conv,
191 |             headdim=headdim,
192 |         )
193 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
194 | 
195 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
196 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
197 |         lq = query.shape[0]
198 | 
199 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
200 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
201 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
202 | 
203 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
204 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
205 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
206 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

208 | 
209 | class _BaseMambaDecoder(nn.Module):
210 |     def __init__(
211 |         self,
212 |         layer_cls,
213 |         num_layers: int = 2,
214 |         d_model: int = 32,
215 |         d_state: int = 16,
216 |         d_conv: int = 4,
217 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
218 |         layer_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
219 |     ):
220 |         super().__init__()
221 |         kwargs = {} if layer_kwargs is None else dict(layer_kwargs)
222 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
223 |             [layer_cls(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, **kwargs) for _ in range(num_layers)]
224 |         )
225 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
226 |         self.return_intermediate = return_intermediate
227 | 
228 |     def _forward_layer(
229 |         self,
230 |         layer: nn.Module,
231 |         output: torch.Tensor,
232 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
233 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
234 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
235 |     ) -> torch.Tensor:
236 |         if _is_attn_like_layer(layer):
237 |             return layer(output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
238 |         mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
239 |         return layer(mem, qry)
240 | 
241 |     def forward(
242 |         self,
243 |         tgt: torch.Tensor,
244 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
245 |         tgt_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
246 |         memory_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
247 |         tgt_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
248 |         memory_key_padding_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
249 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
250 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
251 |     ):
252 |         del tgt_mask, memory_mask, tgt_key_padding_mask, memory_key_padding_mask
253 |         output = tgt
254 |         intermediate = []
255 | 
256 |         for layer in self.layers:
257 |             output = self._forward_layer(layer, output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
258 |             if self.return_intermediate:
259 |                 intermediate.append(self.norm(output))

+def _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """
+    causal_conv1d CUDA kernel için gerekli stride hizalamasını sağlar.
+    Bazı ortamlarda stride(2) % 8 != 0 olduğunda Mamba2 runtime hatası verir.

+    padded = torch.empty(

+        dtype=x_bsc.dtype,
+    )
+    padded[..., ::8] = x_bsc

 29 | def _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 30 |     if (x_bsc.stride(0) % 8 == 0) and (x_bsc.stride(2) % 8 == 0):
 31 |         return x_bsc
 32 | 
 33 |     bsz, seq, ch = x_bsc.shape
 34 |     padded = torch.empty((bsz, seq, ch * 8), device=x_bsc.device, dtype=x_bsc.dtype)
 35 |     padded[..., ::8] = x_bsc

 39 | def _build_mamba2(d_model: int, d_state: int, d_conv: int, headdim: int) -> Tuple[nn.Module, Dict[str, int]]:
 40 |     if Mamba2 is None:
 41 |         raise ImportError("Mamba2 import edilemedi. `mamba-ssm` sürümünü güncelleyin.")
 42 | 
 43 |     def _with_mem_eff_priority(base_kw: Dict[str, int]) -> list[dict]:
 44 |         return [
 45 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": False, "sequence_parallel": False},
 46 |             {**base_kw, "sequence_parallel": False},
 47 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": False},
 48 |             dict(base_kw),
 49 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": True},
 50 |         ]
 51 | 
 52 |     hd_candidates = [int(headdim), 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]
 53 |     unique_hd = []
 54 |     for h in hd_candidates:
 55 |         if h > 0 and h not in unique_hd:
 56 |             unique_hd.append(h)
 57 | 
 58 |     candidate_kwargs = []

 61 |             continue

 63 |             {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv, "headdim": h},
 64 |             {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "headdim": h},
 65 |             {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state, "d_conv": d_conv},
 66 |             {"d_model": d_model, "d_state": d_state},
 67 |         ]:
 68 |             candidate_kwargs.extend(_with_mem_eff_priority(base_kw))
 69 |

 90 | class NonCausalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
 91 |     """
 92 |     LSTR encoder imzasına uyumlu non-causal Mamba2 encoder.
 93 | 
 94 |     Girdi/çıktı imzası:
 95 |       [models.py_utils.transformer.TransformerEncoder.forward()](models/py_utils/transformer.py:78)
 96 |     """
 97 | 
 98 |     def __init__(
 99 |         self,
100 |         d_model: int = 32,
101 |         d_state: int = 64,
102 |         d_conv: int = 4,
103 |         headdim: int = 32,
104 |         num_layers: int = 2,
105 |         num_heads: int = 2,
106 |     ):
107 |         super().__init__()
108 |         self.num_heads = int(num_heads)
109 | 
110 |         self.fwd = nn.ModuleList()
111 |         self.bwd = nn.ModuleList()
112 |         self.merge = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
113 |         self.norm = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
114 | 
115 |         chosen_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None
116 |         for _ in range(int(num_layers)):
117 |             layer_fwd, kw = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
118 |             layer_bwd, _ = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
119 |             self.fwd.append(layer_fwd)
120 |             self.bwd.append(layer_bwd)
121 |             if chosen_kwargs is None:
122 |                 chosen_kwargs = {k: int(v) for k, v in kw.items() if isinstance(v, int)}
123 | 
124 |         self.mamba2_kwargs = chosen_kwargs or {}
125 |         self.fallback_fwd = nn.ModuleList()
126 |         self.fallback_bwd = nn.ModuleList()
127 |         for _ in range(int(num_layers)):
128 |             self.fallback_fwd.append(nn.Identity())
129 |             self.fallback_bwd.append(nn.Identity())
130 |         self.runtime_fallback_used = False
131 |         self._warned_runtime_fallback = False
132 | 
133 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
134 |         del src_key_padding_mask
135 |         if pos is not None:
136 |             src = src + pos
137 | 
138 |         # (S, B, C) -> (B, S, C)
139 |         x = src.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()
140 |         x = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x)
141 | 
142 |         for i, (f, b, m, n) in enumerate(zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm)):
143 |             try:
144 |                 xf = f(x)
145 |                 xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1]).contiguous()), dims=[1])
146 |             except RuntimeError as e:

148 |                     raise
149 |                 if isinstance(self.fallback_fwd[i], nn.Identity):
150 |                     self.fallback_fwd[i] = __import__("mamba_ssm").Mamba(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
151 |                         d_model=x.shape[-1], d_state=16, d_conv=4
152 |                     ).to(x.device)
153 |                     self.fallback_bwd[i] = __import__("mamba_ssm").Mamba(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
154 |                         d_model=x.shape[-1], d_state=16, d_conv=4
155 |                     ).to(x.device)
156 |                 if not self._warned_runtime_fallback:
157 |                     warnings.warn(
158 |                         "VSSD encoder Mamba2 runtime stride kısıtına takıldı; Mamba(v1) fallback ile devam ediyor.",
159 |                         RuntimeWarning,
160 |                     )
161 |                     self._warned_runtime_fallback = True
162 |                 self.runtime_fallback_used = True
163 |                 xf = self.fallback_fwd[i](x)
164 |                 xb = torch.flip(self.fallback_bwd[i](torch.flip(x, dims=[1]).contiguous()), dims=[1])
165 |             x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
166 | 
167 |         # (B, S, C) -> (S, B, C)
168 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
169 | 
170 |         # test/culane debug hook uyumu için attention-like placeholder
171 |         bsz = out.shape[1]
172 |         seq = out.shape[0]
173 |         weights = torch.zeros(bsz * self.num_heads, seq, seq, device=out.device, dtype=out.dtype)
174 |         return out, weights

```

Ama decoder **random init** ile başlıyor ve frozen. Encoder değişince decoder'ın random ağırlıkları artık encoder feature'larıyla uyumsuz. Loss artması VSSD'nin kötü olduğunu değil, izolasyon stratejisinin yanlış kurgulandığını gösteriyor. Baseline da sadece encoder eğitilince %5.01 düşüyor — bu da zaten çok az. Bu test encoder kalitesini ölçmüyor.

---

## 🚨 Sorun 3 — Deney 3 Bölüm 1 Mantıksal Hata
```
gradient_reaches_decoder: 🚨
```

Bu test yanlış kurgulanmış. `memory.pow(2).mean().backward()` çağrısı encoder çıktısı üzerinden backward yapıyor. `query_embed` encoder'a bağlı değil — decoder'a bağlı. Encoder çıktısından backward yaparsan `query_embed`'e gradient gitmez, bu beklenen davranış. Test başarısız olması bir hata değil.

 32 | def _prepare_single_sample(cfg_name: str, device: torch.device):

 46 | def _freeze_non_encoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
 47 |     """
 48 |     Encoder etkisini izole etmek için backbone + decoder + head'i dondur.
 49 |     Sadece encoder trainable bırakılır.
 50 |     """
 51 |     for p in model.parameters():
 52 |         p.requires_grad_(False)

 57 | def _collect_trainable_stats(model: torch.nn.Module):
 58 |     total = 0
 59 |     trainable = 0
 60 |     for p in model.parameters():
 61 |         n = p.numel()
 62 |         total += n
 63 |         if p.requires_grad:
 64 |             trainable += n
 65 |     return total, trainable

 68 | def _train_one_variant(

 82 |     _freeze_non_encoder_parts(model)
 83 | 
 84 |     criterion = model_module.loss().to(device)
 85 |     optim_params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
 86 |     optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(optim_params, lr=lr)

 89 |

  4 | 
  5 | import argparse

 10 | import torch
 11 | import torch.nn.functional as F
 12 | 
 13 | from mask_migration.common import build_model_from_cfg, load_system_config

 16 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:

 24 | def _forward_to_encoder(model, images, masks):
 25 |     p = model.conv1(images)
 26 |     p = model.bn1(p)
 27 |     p = model.relu(p)
 28 |     p = model.maxpool(p)
 29 |     p = model.layer1(p)
 30 |     p = model.layer2(p)
 31 |     p = model.layer3(p)
 32 |     p = model.layer4(p)
 33 | 
 34 |     pmasks = F.interpolate(masks[:, 0, :, :][None], size=p.shape[-2:]).to(torch.bool)[0]
 35 |     pos = model.position_embedding(p, pmasks)
 36 | 
 37 |     src = model.input_proj(p).flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
 38 |     pos_s = pos.flatten(2).permute(2, 0, 1)
 39 |     memory, _w = model.transformer.encoder(src, src_key_padding_mask=pmasks.flatten(1), pos=pos_s)
 40 |     return src, memory
 41 |

 43 | def run(cfg_name: str = "LSTR_CULANE_2k_mamba_dec_b", batch: int = 2, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, bool]:
 44 |     _set_seed(seed)
 45 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 46 | 
 47 |     cfg = load_system_config(cfg_name)
 48 |     in_h, in_w = cfg["db"]["input_size"]
 49 |     model = build_model_from_cfg(cfg_name, flag=True, device=device, eval_mode=False)
 50 | 
 51 |     images = torch.randn(batch, 3, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 52 |     masks = torch.zeros(batch, 1, in_h, in_w, device=device)
 53 |

 58 |     checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(memory.shape) == (260, batch, 32)

 63 |     sim = norm @ norm.t()
 64 |     off = sim[~torch.eye(batch, dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]

-def _freeze_non_encoder_parts(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:

+def _freeze_parts_for_stage(model: torch.nn.Module, stage: str = "encoder_only") -> None:
+    """
+    stage='encoder_only' : sadece encoder trainable
+    stage='encoder_decoder_head' : encoder + decoder + query/class/curve head trainable
+    """
+    for p in model.parameters():
+        p.requires_grad_(False)
+
+    if stage == "encoder_only":
+        for p in model.transformer.encoder.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        return
+
+    if stage == "encoder_decoder_head":
+        for p in model.transformer.encoder.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        for p in model.transformer.decoder.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        for p in model.query_embed.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        for p in model.class_embed.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        for p in model.specific_embed.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        for p in model.shared_embed.parameters():
+            p.requires_grad_(True)
+        return
+
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown stage: {stage}")

 35 | def _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 36 |     """
 37 |     causal_conv1d CUDA kernel için gerekli stride hizalamasını sağlar.
 38 |     Bazı ortamlarda stride(2) % 8 != 0 olduğunda Mamba2 runtime hatası verir.
 39 |     """
 40 |     if (x_bsc.stride(0) % 8 == 0) and (x_bsc.stride(2) % 8 == 0):
 41 |         return x_bsc
 42 | 
 43 |     bsz, seq, ch = x_bsc.shape
 44 |     padded = torch.empty(
 45 |         (bsz, seq, ch * 8),
 46 |         device=x_bsc.device,
 47 |         dtype=x_bsc.dtype,
 48 |     )
 49 |     padded[..., ::8] = x_bsc
 50 |     return padded[..., ::8]

 61 |     def _with_mem_eff_priority(base_kw: dict[str, int]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 62 |         # Öncelik: Triton stride kısıtına takılmamak için önce memory-efficient path kapalı dene.
 63 |         # Bazı mamba-ssm sürümlerinde bu argüman olmayabilir; candidate loop zaten güvenli şekilde fallback yapar.
 64 |         return [
 65 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": False, "sequence_parallel": False},
 66 |             {**base_kw, "sequence_parallel": False},
 67 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": False},
 68 |             dict(base_kw),
 69 |             {**base_kw, "use_mem_eff_path": True},

112 | class MambaDecoderLayerA(nn.Module):
113 |     """Varyant A — Prefix concat."""
114 | 
115 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
116 |         super().__init__()
117 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
118 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
119 | 
120 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
121 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
122 |         lq = query.shape[0]
123 |         combined = torch.cat([memory, query], dim=0)     # (S+L,B,C)
124 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))  # (B,S+L,C)
125 |         out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                   # (S+L,B,C)
126 |         new_query = out[-lq:]                            # (L,B,C)
127 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

131 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
132 | 
133 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
134 |         super().__init__()

138 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
139 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
140 |         lq = query.shape[0]

144 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
145 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
146 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
147 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)

152 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
153 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
154 | 
155 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
156 |         super().__init__()
157 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
158 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
159 | 
160 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
161 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
162 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
163 |         lq = query.shape[0]
164 | 
165 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
166 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
167 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
168 | 
169 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
170 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
171 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
172 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

175 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
176 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
177 | 
178 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
179 |         super().__init__()
180 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
181 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
182 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
183 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
184 | 
185 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
186 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
187 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
188 |         lq = query.shape[0]
189 | 
190 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
191 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
192 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
193 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
194 | 
195 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
196 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
197 | 
198 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
199 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
200 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
201 | 
202 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
203 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
204 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
205 | 
206 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
207 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
208 |         return out

212 |     """Varyant D — Query-aware Mamba2 (B varyantının Mamba2 karşılığı)."""
213 | 
214 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32):
215 |         super().__init__()

217 |             d_model=d_model,

222 |         self.mamba_fallback = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=max(16, int(d_state // 4)), d_conv=d_conv)
223 |         self.runtime_fallback_used = False
224 |         self._warned_runtime_fallback = False
225 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
226 | 
227 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
228 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
229 |         lq = query.shape[0]
230 | 
231 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
232 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
233 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
234 | 
235 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                            # (B*L,S+1,C)
236 |         combined_bsc = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(combined_bsc)
237 |         try:
238 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined_bsc)                                            # (B*L,S+1,C)
239 |         except RuntimeError as e:

241 |                 raise
242 |             if not self._warned_runtime_fallback:
243 |                 warnings.warn(
244 |                     "Mamba2 runtime stride kısıtına takıldı; Varyant D bu oturumda Mamba(v1) fallback ile devam ediyor.",
245 |                     RuntimeWarning,
246 |                 )
247 |                 self._warned_runtime_fallback = True
248 |             self.runtime_fallback_used = True
249 |             out_bsc = self.mamba_fallback(combined_bsc.contiguous())
250 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
251 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
252 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

255 | class _BaseMambaDecoder(nn.Module):
256 |     def __init__(
257 |         self,
258 |         layer_cls,
259 |         num_layers: int = 2,
260 |         d_model: int = 32,
261 |         d_state: int = 16,
262 |         d_conv: int = 4,
263 |         return_intermediate: bool = True,
264 |         layer_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
265 |     ):
266 |         super().__init__()
267 |         kwargs = {} if layer_kwargs is None else dict(layer_kwargs)
268 |         self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
269 |             [layer_cls(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, **kwargs) for _ in range(num_layers)]
270 |         )
271 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
272 |         self.return_intermediate = return_intermediate
273 | 
274 |     def _forward_layer(
275 |         self,
276 |         layer: nn.Module,
277 |         output: torch.Tensor,
278 |         memory: torch.Tensor,
279 |         pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
280 |         query_pos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
281 |     ) -> torch.Tensor:
282 |         if _is_attn_like_layer(layer):
283 |             return layer(output, memory, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
284 |         mem, qry = _prep_with_pos(memory, output, pos=pos, query_pos=query_pos)
285 |         return layer(mem, qry)
286 |

    def forward(self, u, seqlen=None, seq_idx=None, cu_seqlens=None, inference_params=None):
        """
        u: (batch, seqlen, hidden_dim) if seqlen=None.
            If seqlen is not None, u is (batch * seqlen, hidden_dim). This is so that when we
            split u during sequence parallel, we split the batch * seqlen dimension
            (in case batch is small).
        Returns: same shape as u
        """
        seqlen_og = seqlen
        if seqlen is None:
            batch, seqlen, dim = u.shape
        else:
            batch_seqlen, dim = u.shape
            batch = batch_seqlen // seqlen

        conv_state, ssm_state = None, None
        if inference_params is not None:
            inference_batch = cu_seqlens.shape[0] - 1 if cu_seqlens is not None else batch
            conv_state, ssm_state = self._get_states_from_cache(inference_params, inference_batch)
            if inference_params.seqlen_offset > 0:
                # The states are updated inplace
                out, _, _ = self.step(u, conv_state, ssm_state)
                return out

        zxbcdt = self.in_proj(u)  # (B, L, d_in_proj) or (B * L, d_in_proj)
        if seqlen_og is not None:
            zxbcdt = rearrange(zxbcdt, "(b l) d -> b l d", l=seqlen)
        # If the model is loaded in fp16, without the .float() here, A might be -inf
        A = -torch.exp(self.A_log.float())  # (nheads) or (d_inner, d_state)
        dt_limit_kwargs = {} if self.dt_limit == (0.0, float("inf")) else dict(dt_limit=self.dt_limit)
        if self.use_mem_eff_path and inference_params is None:
            out = mamba_split_conv1d_scan_combined(
                zxbcdt,
                rearrange(self.conv1d.weight, "d 1 w -> d w"),
                self.conv1d.bias,
                self.dt_bias,
                A,
                D=rearrange(self.D, "(h p) -> h p", p=self.headdim) if self.D_has_hdim else self.D,
                chunk_size=self.chunk_size,
                seq_idx=seq_idx,
                activation=self.activation,
                rmsnorm_weight=self.norm.weight if self.rmsnorm else None,
                rmsnorm_eps=self.norm.eps if self.rmsnorm else 1e-6,
                outproj_weight=self.out_proj.weight,
                outproj_bias=self.out_proj.bias,
                headdim=None if self.D_has_hdim else self.headdim,
                ngroups=self.ngroups,
                norm_before_gate=self.norm_before_gate,
                **dt_limit_kwargs,
            )
            if seqlen_og is not None:
                out = rearrange(out, "b l d -> (b l) d")
            if self.process_group is not None:
                reduce_fn = reduce_scatter if self.sequence_parallel else all_reduce
                out = reduce_fn(out, self.process_group)
        else:
            d_mlp = (zxbcdt.shape[-1] - 2 * self.d_ssm - 2 * self.ngroups * self.d_state - self.nheads) // 2
            z0, x0, z, xBC, dt = torch.split(
                zxbcdt,
                [d_mlp, d_mlp, self.d_ssm, self.d_ssm + 2 * self.ngroups * self.d_state, self.nheads],
                dim=-1
            )
            if conv_state is not None:
                if cu_seqlens is None:
                    # If we just take xBC[:, :, -self.d_conv :], it will error if seqlen < self.d_conv
                    # Instead F.pad will pad with zeros if seqlen < self.d_conv, and truncate otherwise.
                    xBC_t = rearrange(xBC, "b l d -> b d l")
                    conv_state.copy_(F.pad(xBC_t, (self.d_conv - xBC_t.shape[-1], 0)))  # Update state (B D W)
                else:
                    assert causal_conv1d_varlen_states is not None, "varlen inference requires causal_conv1d package"
                    assert batch == 1, "varlen inference only supports batch dimension 1"
                    conv_varlen_states = causal_conv1d_varlen_states(
                        xBC.squeeze(0), cu_seqlens, state_len=conv_state.shape[-1]
                    )
                    conv_state.copy_(conv_varlen_states)
            assert self.activation in ["silu", "swish"]
            if causal_conv1d_fn is None or self.activation not in ["silu", "swish"]:
                assert seq_idx is None, "varlen conv1d requires the causal_conv1d package"
                xBC = self.act(
                    self.conv1d(xBC.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)[:, -(self.dconv - 1):]
                )  # (B, L, self.d_ssm + 2 * ngroups * d_state)
            else:
                xBC = causal_conv1d_fn(
                    xBC.transpose(1, 2),
                    rearrange(self.conv1d.weight, "d 1 w -> d w"),
                    bias=self.conv1d.bias,
                    activation=self.activation,
                    seq_idx=seq_idx,
                ).transpose(1, 2)
            x, B, C = torch.split(xBC, [self.d_ssm, self.ngroups * self.d_state, self.ngroups * self.d_state], dim=-1)
            y = mamba_chunk_scan_combined(
                rearrange(x, "b l (h p) -> b l h p", p=self.headdim),
                dt,
                A,
                rearrange(B, "b l (g n) -> b l g n", g=self.ngroups),
                rearrange(C, "b l (g n) -> b l g n", g=self.ngroups),
                chunk_size=self.chunk_size,
                D=rearrange(self.D, "(h p) -> h p", p=self.headdim) if self.D_has_hdim else self.D,
                z=rearrange(z, "b l (h p) -> b l h p", p=self.headdim) if not self.rmsnorm else None,
                dt_bias=self.dt_bias,
                dt_softplus=True,
                seq_idx=seq_idx,
                cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
                **dt_limit_kwargs,
                return_final_states=ssm_state is not None,
                return_varlen_states=cu_seqlens is not None and inference_params is not None,
            )
            if ssm_state is not None:
                y, last_state, *rest = y
                if cu_seqlens is None:
                    ssm_state.copy_(last_state)
                else:
                    varlen_states = rest[0]
                    ssm_state.copy_(varlen_states)
            y = rearrange(y, "b l h p -> b l (h p)")
            if self.rmsnorm:
                y = self.norm(y, z)
            if d_mlp > 0:
                y = torch.cat([F.silu(z0) * x0, y], dim=-1)
            if seqlen_og is not None:
                y = rearrange(y, "b l d -> (b l) d")
            out = self.out_proj(y)
        return out

 90 | class NonCausalMambaEncoder(nn.Module):
 91 |     """
 92 |     LSTR encoder imzasına uyumlu non-causal Mamba2 encoder.
 93 | 
 94 |     Girdi/çıktı imzası:
 95 |       [models.py_utils.transformer.TransformerEncoder.forward()](models/py_utils/transformer.py:78)
 96 |     """
 97 | 
 98 |     def __init__(
 99 |         self,
100 |         d_model: int = 32,
101 |         d_state: int = 64,
102 |         d_conv: int = 4,
103 |         headdim: int = 32,
104 |         num_layers: int = 2,
105 |         num_heads: int = 2,
106 |     ):
107 |         super().__init__()
108 |         self.num_heads = int(num_heads)
109 | 
110 |         self.fwd = nn.ModuleList()
111 |         self.bwd = nn.ModuleList()
112 |         self.merge = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
113 |         self.norm = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(int(num_layers))])
114 | 
115 |         chosen_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None
116 |         for _ in range(int(num_layers)):
117 |             layer_fwd, kw = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
118 |             layer_bwd, _ = _build_mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv, headdim=headdim)
119 |             self.fwd.append(layer_fwd)
120 |             self.bwd.append(layer_bwd)
121 |             if chosen_kwargs is None:
122 |                 chosen_kwargs = {k: int(v) for k, v in kw.items() if isinstance(v, int)}
123 | 
124 |         self.mamba2_kwargs = chosen_kwargs or {}
125 |         self.fallback_fwd = nn.ModuleList()
126 |         self.fallback_bwd = nn.ModuleList()
127 |         for _ in range(int(num_layers)):
128 |             self.fallback_fwd.append(nn.Identity())
129 |             self.fallback_bwd.append(nn.Identity())
130 |         self.runtime_fallback_used = False
131 |         self._warned_runtime_fallback = False
132 | 
133 |     def forward(self, src, src_key_padding_mask=None, pos=None):
134 |         del src_key_padding_mask
135 |         if pos is not None:
136 |             src = src + pos
137 | 
138 |         # (S, B, C) -> (B, S, C)
139 |         x = src.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()
140 |         x = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x)
141 | 
142 |         for i, (f, b, m, n) in enumerate(zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm)):
143 |             try:
144 |                 xf = f(x)
145 |                 xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1]).contiguous()), dims=[1])
146 |             except RuntimeError as e:
147 |                 if "causal_conv1d with channel last layout requires strides" not in str(e):
148 |                     raise
149 |                 if isinstance(self.fallback_fwd[i], nn.Identity):
150 |                     self.fallback_fwd[i] = __import__("mamba_ssm").Mamba(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
151 |                         d_model=x.shape[-1], d_state=16, d_conv=4
152 |                     ).to(x.device)
153 |                     self.fallback_bwd[i] = __import__("mamba_ssm").Mamba(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
154 |                         d_model=x.shape[-1], d_state=16, d_conv=4
155 |                     ).to(x.device)
156 |                 if not self._warned_runtime_fallback:
157 |                     warnings.warn(
158 |                         "VSSD encoder Mamba2 runtime stride kısıtına takıldı; Mamba(v1) fallback ile devam ediyor.",
159 |                         RuntimeWarning,
160 |                     )
161 |                     self._warned_runtime_fallback = True
162 |                 self.runtime_fallback_used = True
163 |                 xf = self.fallback_fwd[i](x)
164 |                 xb = torch.flip(self.fallback_bwd[i](torch.flip(x, dims=[1]).contiguous()), dims=[1])
165 |             x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
166 | 
167 |         # (B, S, C) -> (S, B, C)
168 |         out = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
169 | 
170 |         # test/culane debug hook uyumu için attention-like placeholder
171 |         bsz = out.shape[1]
172 |         seq = out.shape[0]
173 |         weights = torch.zeros(bsz * self.num_heads, seq, seq, device=out.device, dtype=out.dtype)
174 |         return out, weights
175 |

130 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Naive(nn.Module):
131 |     """Varyant B — Naive loop referansı."""
132 | 
133 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
134 |         super().__init__()
135 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
136 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
137 | 
138 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
139 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
140 |         lq = query.shape[0]
141 |         new_qs = []
142 |         for i in range(lq):
143 |             qi = query[i : i + 1]                           # (1,B,C)
144 |             combined = torch.cat([memory, qi], dim=0)       # (S+1,B,C)
145 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2)) # (B,S+1,C)
146 |             out = out_bsc.permute(1, 0, 2)                  # (S+1,B,C)
147 |             new_qs.append(out[-1:] + qi)
148 |         new_query = torch.cat(new_qs, dim=0)
149 |         return self.norm(new_query)

152 | class MambaDecoderLayerB_Batch(nn.Module):
153 |     """Varyant B — Batch optimize (eğitimde kullanılacak)."""
154 | 
155 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
156 |         super().__init__()
157 |         self.mamba = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
158 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
159 | 
160 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
161 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
162 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
163 |         lq = query.shape[0]
164 | 
165 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
166 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
167 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
168 | 
169 |         out_bsc = self.mamba(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))                                 # (B*L,S+1,C)
170 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
171 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
172 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

175 | class MambaDecoderLayerC(nn.Module):
176 |     """Varyant C — Bidirectional query-aware."""
177 | 
178 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 16, d_conv: int = 4):
179 |         super().__init__()
180 |         self.mamba_fwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
181 |         self.mamba_bwd = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, d_conv=d_conv)
182 |         self.linear_merge = nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model)
183 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
184 | 
185 |     def forward_branches(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor):
186 |         # memory: (S,B,C), query: (L,B,C)
187 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
188 |         lq = query.shape[0]
189 | 
190 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
191 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
192 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
193 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                           # (B*L,S+1,C)
194 | 
195 |         fwd_all = self.mamba_fwd(combined_bsc)
196 |         fwd_last = fwd_all[:, -1, :]                                                     # (B*L,C)
197 | 
198 |         bwd_in = torch.flip(combined_bsc, dims=[1])
199 |         bwd_all = self.mamba_bwd(bwd_in)
200 |         bwd_last = bwd_all[:, 0, :]                                                      # (B*L,C)
201 | 
202 |         merged = self.linear_merge(torch.cat([fwd_last, bwd_last], dim=-1))             # (B*L,C)
203 |         new_q = merged.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                  # (L,B,C)
204 |         return self.norm(new_q + query), fwd_last, bwd_last
205 | 
206 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
207 |         out, _fwd, _bwd = self.forward_branches(memory, query)
208 |         return out

214 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, d_conv: int = 4, headdim: int = 32):
215 |         super().__init__()

217 |             d_model=d_model,

219 |             d_conv=d_conv,
220 |             headdim=headdim,
221 |         )
222 |         self.mamba_fallback = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=max(16, int(d_state // 4)), d_conv=d_conv)
223 |         self.runtime_fallback_used = False
224 |         self._warned_runtime_fallback = False
225 |         self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
226 | 
227 |     def forward(self, memory: torch.Tensor, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
228 |         s, bsz, ch = memory.shape
229 |         lq = query.shape[0]
230 | 
231 |         mem_exp = memory.unsqueeze(2).expand(s, bsz, lq, ch).reshape(s, bsz * lq, ch)  # (S,B*L,C)
232 |         q_flat = query.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(bsz * lq, ch).unsqueeze(0)              # (1,B*L,C)
233 |         combined = torch.cat([mem_exp, q_flat], dim=0)                                  # (S+1,B*L,C)
234 | 
235 |         combined_bsc = combined.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()                            # (B*L,S+1,C)
236 |         combined_bsc = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(combined_bsc)
237 |         try:
238 |             out_bsc = self.mamba(combined_bsc)                                            # (B*L,S+1,C)
239 |         except RuntimeError as e:
240 |             if "causal_conv1d with channel last layout requires strides" not in str(e):
241 |                 raise
242 |             if not self._warned_runtime_fallback:
243 |                 warnings.warn(
244 |                     "Mamba2 runtime stride kısıtına takıldı; Varyant D bu oturumda Mamba(v1) fallback ile devam ediyor.",
245 |                     RuntimeWarning,
246 |                 )
247 |                 self._warned_runtime_fallback = True
248 |             self.runtime_fallback_used = True
249 |             out_bsc = self.mamba_fallback(combined_bsc.contiguous())
250 |         new_q_flat = out_bsc[:, -1, :]                                                  # (B*L,C)
251 |         new_query = new_q_flat.view(bsz, lq, ch).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous()         # (L,B,C)
252 |         return self.norm(new_query + query)

  2 | BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD / non-causal SSM izole test.

 16 | def _set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
 17 |     random.seed(seed)
 18 |     np.random.seed(seed)
 19 |     torch.manual_seed(seed)
 20 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 21 |         torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

 24 | class NonCausalMambaEncoder(torch.nn.Module):
 25 |     def __init__(self, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, num_layers: int = 2):
 26 |         super().__init__()
 27 |         from mamba_ssm import Mamba2
 28 | 
 29 |         self.fwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 30 |         self.bwd = torch.nn.ModuleList([Mamba2(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 31 |         self.merge = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.Linear(d_model * 2, d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 32 |         self.norm = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.LayerNorm(d_model) for _ in range(num_layers)])
 33 | 
 34 |     def forward(self, x_bsc: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 35 |         x = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x_bsc.contiguous())
 36 |         for f, b, m, n in zip(self.fwd, self.bwd, self.merge, self.norm):
 37 |             xf = f(x)
 38 |             xb = torch.flip(b(torch.flip(x, dims=[1]).contiguous()), dims=[1])
 39 |             x = n(x + m(torch.cat([xf, xb], dim=-1)))
 40 |         return x
 41 | 
 42 | 
 43 | def _bench(fn, warmup: int = 5, iters: int = 20) -> float:
 44 |     for _ in range(warmup):
 45 |         _ = fn()
 46 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 47 |         torch.cuda.synchronize()
 48 |     t0 = time.perf_counter()
 49 |     for _ in range(iters):
 50 |         _ = fn()
 51 |     if torch.cuda.is_available():
 52 |         torch.cuda.synchronize()
 53 |     t1 = time.perf_counter()
 54 |     return (t1 - t0) / float(iters)
 55 |

 57 | def run(batch: int = 2, seq: int = 260, d_model: int = 32, d_state: int = 64, headdim: int = 32, seed: int = 0) -> Dict[str, object]:
 58 |     _set_seed(seed)
 59 |     device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 60 | 
 61 |     x = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(torch.randn(batch, seq, d_model, device=device).contiguous())
 62 |     enc = NonCausalMambaEncoder(d_model=d_model, d_state=d_state, headdim=headdim, num_layers=2).to(device)
 63 |     y = enc(x)
 64 | 
 65 |     checks: Dict[str, object] = {}
 66 |     checks["output_shape_ok"] = tuple(y.shape) == (batch, seq, d_model)
 67 |     checks["no_nan"] = bool(torch.isfinite(y).all().item())
 68 | 
 69 |     # grad
 70 |     enc.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 71 |     xg = _ensure_stride8_channel_last(x.detach().clone().contiguous()).requires_grad_(True)
 72 |     yg = enc(xg)
 73 |     loss = yg.pow(2).mean()
 74 |     loss.backward()
 75 |     grad_ok = any((p.grad is not None) and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and float(p.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12 for p in enc.parameters())
 76 |     checks["gradient_flow"] = grad_ok and (xg.grad is not None) and float(xg.grad.abs().mean().item()) > 1e-12
 77 | 
 78 |     # baseline bidir mamba1 encoder (izole basit hız karşılaştırma)
 79 |     from mamba_ssm import Mamba
 80 |     m1f = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
 81 |     m1b = Mamba(d_model=d_model, d_state=16, d_conv=4).to(device)
 82 | 
 83 |     def _bidir_m1(inp):
 84 |         yf = m1f(inp)
 85 |         yb = torch.flip(m1b(torch.flip(inp, dims=[1])), dims=[1])
 86 |         return yf + yb
 87 | 
 88 |     t_bidir_m1 = _bench(lambda: _bidir_m1(x))
 89 |     t_vssd = _bench(lambda: enc(x))
 90 |     checks["speedup_vs_bidir"] = float(t_bidir_m1 / max(t_vssd, 1e-12))
 91 | 
 92 |     # kalite proxy: sample içi token cosine çeşitliliği
 93 |     yy = y[0]
 94 |     yy_n = torch.nn.functional.normalize(yy, dim=-1)
 95 |     sim = yy_n @ yy_n.t()
 96 |     off = sim[~torch.eye(sim.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=sim.device)]
 97 |     quality = float(off.mean().item())
 98 |     checks["quality_vs_bidir"] = quality
 99 | 
100 |     print("=" * 96)
101 |     print("DENEY 3 BÖLÜM 2 — VSSD İZOLE")
102 |     print("=" * 96)
103 |     print(f"Device: {device}")
104 |     print(f"x={tuple(x.shape)} y={tuple(y.shape)}")
105 |     print(f"speedup_vs_bidir={checks['speedup_vs_bidir']:.3f}x")
106 |     print(f"quality_proxy(avg_off_diag_cos)={quality:.4f}")
107 | 
108 |     print("\nKontroller:")
109 |     for k in ["output_shape_ok", "no_nan", "gradient_flow"]:
110 |         print(f"  {k:<18}: {'✅' if checks[k] else '🚨'}")
111 |     print(f"  {'speedup_vs_bidir':<18}: {checks['speedup_vs_bidir']:.3f}")
112 |     print(f"  {'quality_vs_bidir':<18}: {quality:.4f}")
113 | 
114 |     return checks
